turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, Juhee — it's me. Is this a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yeah, it's fine. What's up?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: How have you been lately? The baby's doing well, right?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, yeah, she's doing great. You've got a lot on right now, haven't you? It's been ages since I've seen you.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Tell me about it — this project has me all over the place. Anyway, it's nothing urgent, I just wanted to run something by you, no rush.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? What is it? Go ahead, don't worry about it.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: So the thing is, I'm putting together some material on smart transport systems at the moment, and part of it's about using self-driving sensor data.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I think I saw that on the news — you mean the thing that links up with the traffic lights?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, exactly, that. But I was curious how it would come across from an ordinary person's point of view — turns out I need the perspective of someone on the office side.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, so that's why you got in touch with me. Sure, send the material over and I'll have a read.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Thank you. It's not urgent at all, so just take your time whenever you get a chance.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, yeah, got it. I'll look at it this weekend if I get a spare moment.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I'll email it over then. Thank you — this is going to help a lot.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, don't mention it. Let's grab a coffee sometime and catch up properly.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Sounds good, see you soon. Take care!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You too, take care!

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's me. My number changed, so I'm calling from this one.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? Sorry, who is this? Hang on a second.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, sorry — it's Kim Gangyong. Remember that time we went hiking and you twisted your ankle, and someone carried you down on his back? That was me.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, right, it's you! I wasn't sure even hearing your voice. I'll save the number.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yeah, it's been a while. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Not bad. Been busy, lots of counselling work lately. You? How's the jewellery work going?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Work's so-so. But my mum's knees have been bad lately, so I've been taking her to the hospital a fair bit.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh no. Look after her properly. And don't push yourself too hard either.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yeah. Oh — actually, I called about something else.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: What is it? Just say it.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: So I've actually been seeing someone, and I'm going to propose. I want to make the ring myself, but I'm stuck on the design.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Whoa, congratulations! It's not urgent though, right? You've got time to think it over.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: No, no rush, I just wanted your take on it too. Whether simple is better, or something more elaborate.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You'd know her taste better than me, but if she's got smallish hands I think a simple line would look nice.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yeah? I'll keep that in mind. Thanks for hearing me out.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure. If it works out, you'd better show me the invitation. Let's talk again soon.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hey, Mincheol, it's me. You're free today, right?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, we had a light load today so I finished early.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Good. How's your health? Blood sugar all right these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Not too bad. I'm keeping up with the medication. How about you, how are things with the kids?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Good. My second one is completely hooked on games these days. Watching over his shoulder, I've gotten curious myself.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, I bought my kids a console back when they were little too. They are fun, I'll give them that.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I'm taking my time looking into it — you said a while back you had one you were selling. What brand was that?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that was a PlayStation. But if you're not in a hurry, you'd probably be better off looking at the newer ones.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: No hurry, it's just that the kid keeps pestering me, so I thought I'd look into it. Take your time getting back to me.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Then next time I get a chance I'll put together the shop names and price ranges and text them to you.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Thanks, Mincheol.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure. Your boy'll be thrilled.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Right, take care of yourself, and let's get a meal sometime.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Will do. Take care.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hello, Yeseop? It's Jeonguk. Is this a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's fine. Is something up?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: No, nothing — I just thought I'd hear your voice, it's been a while. The weather must be lovely in Jeju right now?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's gorgeous. I was out playing badminton just yesterday. Isn't it a bit chilly in Seoul?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: It's a bit chilly here, yes. Anyway, it's nothing urgent, but there's been a lot in the news about prices lately and I got curious.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that — I saw it too. The electricity bill really went up this month.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Right, the news said it's because of energy prices. Do you notice it when you're processing the company expenses too?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, definitely. Our overheads went up a bit this quarter as well. It's not an urgent problem though, so I'm working through it slowly.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I see. On my end, the people coming in for consultations are worrying a lot about the economy lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I suppose everyone's got much the same worry. It'll get better bit by bit, though.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: We can hope. Anyway, I've confirmed all's well with you, so that's good enough. Let's get a meal sometime.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, sounds good! Give me a call if you're ever in Seoul. Take care!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello, Sujin! It's me. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, hello! It's been a while. How are things at work these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as ever, just hectic. How's your health, Sujin? You mentioned you were managing your blood sugar.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ah, that — I've been being careful lately. How about you, Gangjin, how are things?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'm doing fine. Actually, I've gotten interested in skincare lately — as you get older you start worrying about your skin.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, really? A lot of men are into skincare these days. What do you use?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just whatever, nothing special... But I hear custom-made cosmetics are a thing now — have you heard of that?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, that! I was interested so I looked it up. Apparently they analyse your skin type and formulate the ingredients to match. Pretty amazing, isn't it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh, that is amazing. I was thinking of trying it, but I hear it's a bit pricey.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: It is, but they say it's worth it for people with sensitive skin. Personally I find buying clothes more fun these days.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that's right, you've got such refined taste in clothes, Sujin. What's in style at the moment?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oversized fits with some colour to them are popular lately. How about Incheon — is it a bit different over there?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Around here comfortable is king, haha. Honestly, cutting back on drinking and smoking is more pressing for me than clothes, and it's not going well.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Tell me about it — I'm in no position to talk either. Let's both look after our health.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, exactly. It was lovely talking today. I'll be in touch again soon!

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, yes. Get home safe, and let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, it's me. My phone screen cracked, so I'm calling from a coworker's phone right now.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, your voice sounded a bit different, you gave me a fright. Is that really you, Mingyu? What was the name of that bakery we went to together last time?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Oh, that one — the place in front of the cathedral. Where you bought two cream buns because you said they were good.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: That's right, that's it. Your voice sounds a bit hoarse, though. Everything all right lately?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's just a bit of a cold, that's all. How about you, Mum — how's the job hunting going?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: I had one interview but haven't heard back yet. Anyway, is there something you called about?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's nothing much — the materials payment got settled late this month, so my pay's coming in a bit late. I'm a little short on my card bill, so could you lend me 300,000 won for a few days?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh dear, really? If it's urgent, shall I send it right now?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: No, it's not urgent. Take your time — this evening or tomorrow is fine.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Still, I think it'd be better to talk face to face. Shall we switch to a video call for a moment?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yeah, sure. Hang on a sec, I'll try a video call from this phone.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, I can see you now — it really is my son. So where should I send it?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: The same account you sent to last time, the Woori Bank one.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, I'll send it later when I go by the bank. Make sure you're eating properly.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yeah, and you watch out for colds too, Mum. I'll call again soon. Thanks.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's me. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hey, long time. How's the studying going?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: So-so. I managed to pass the written test somehow, but I'm worried about the interview...

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, you passed the written? Nice one. When's the interview, then?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Next Thursday. Actually, that's why I called — I've got a bit of a favour to ask.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, what is it? Go ahead.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: You know my dog? I've got to be away from home for a day or two for the interview, and I haven't really got anywhere to leave him...

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that sweet little thing? But I'm in Jeju — would that even work?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: No, I don't mean leaving him with you — I just wondered if you knew a pet sitter or something. It's not urgent, you can take your time looking.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's what you meant. Hang on — I think one of my customers a while back did pet sitting. Let me have a look.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Really? Thank you. But there's no rush at all, I've got a few days.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Got it, I'll ring you as soon as I find it. What was the dog's name again — Cookie?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's right, Cookie. You remembered.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course. You sent me a photo back then. Anyway, good luck with the interview prep, and don't feel any pressure — I'll get back to you when I get back to you.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thanks. I'll be in touch again soon.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, it's me. I'm calling from the shop's number so it'll look unfamiliar, but it's really me, Hyeonjin.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, what's this number? You startled me. But hearing your voice, it really is you.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, remember how when I was little I always used to tip my rice into the jjamppong broth? Do you remember that? Now that I've said that, you're sure it's me, right?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh goodness, that's right, you absolutely loved that. Now I'm certain, haha.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: How've you been? I hear you're busy with stage work these days.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yeah, it's a fairly big production this time, so it's hectic. How about you, are cars selling?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: So-so. I did sign a few this month, though. Do you still go to the sauna, Mum?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Every weekend. So what did you call about? Doesn't seem like it's just to say hello.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Oh, it's nothing much — I'm a bit short on rent this time. It's not urgent, sometime next week is fine.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, is that so? How much do you need?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 500,000 or so. There's no rush, so just see what you can do whenever it suits you.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, I'll check my account this weekend and let you know. It's not urgent, so let's take it slow.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Thanks, Mum. Just get back to me later when you've got time.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Will do. Make sure you eat properly. I'm hanging up now.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Hey, it's me. I changed my number recently.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? Who's this? Don't recognise the number — it's not saved.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's Jihun, the one working at the industrial complex in Pyeongtaek. Remember at that work dinner ages ago, when I only drank beer instead of soju and you teased me about it?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, right — you couldn't even mix a somaek, just sipped away at your beer, haha. Got you now. I'll save the number.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yeah, yeah. How have you been? Still doing your bakery tours?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course, still going all over Seongnam every weekend. How about you, is the plant work manageable?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's manageable, but a bit tough. Anyway, I'm planning to take an online course for a bookkeeping certificate.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that's good. Having a certificate helps.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: The thing is, my card's hit its limit this month, so the payment won't go through. I was wondering if you could pay for it on your card instead.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: How much is it?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Around 200,000 won. Actually, I think it'd be better to talk face to face — can we do a video call?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, sure. Give me a second, I'll switch over.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Been a while since I've seen your face. It's me, right?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, that's you all right — you're looking well. It's not urgent though, is it? I've got a deadline at work today, so can I look at it around this evening?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yeah, yeah, not urgent at all. Take your time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'll check this evening then, and when you pay me back later — you know my usual account — just send it there.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yeah, thank you! I'll get in touch later then.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, long time no see — it's Gyeongsu. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it really has been a while. Good to hear your voice.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, do you remember that time we went fishing and you dropped your shoe in the water?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that! That was when we went to the Taehwa River. You teased me about that for years.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's it, that's the one. The voice and all — it's definitely you, heh heh.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: How are things with you these days? Kids doing well?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: My boy's decided to get married. That's had me run off my feet.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Congratulations — your son's getting married. You must be pleased.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: The line's breaking up a bit, though. Could we switch to a video call?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, let's do that. Hang on, I'll call you on video.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: The deposit for the wedding hall went out a bit sooner than I expected, so I was wondering if you could lend me about 1,000,000 won. It's not urgent — anytime within this month is fine.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That much, sure, of course I'll help. The account's still the same one you used before, right? Should I send it there?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yeah, that's right, still using that same account. Thanks, really — I'll pay you straight back once my son's wedding is over and things settle down.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Take your time paying it back, there's no rush. I'll send it next week.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thanks, really. I'll call again once the wedding date is set.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, see you then. Pass on my congratulations to your boy.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hello, it's Gisu — is this a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's fine. It's been a while — how have you been?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yeah, I'm getting by. How's the restaurant these days? Busy?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's ticking along. Today's a bit quiet so I've got some time. How's your dog, Gisu?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: He's doing well — taking him out for walks is what keeps me going these days. Anyway, I saw something interesting and thought I'd call.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? What is it? Now I'm curious.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Have you seen the news about delivery robots? There's one called Newbie that's started a trial run in an apartment complex.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, I caught a bit of that on the news. But does it really go around on its own, with nobody with it?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, apparently it finds its way with sensors and cameras, and even takes the lift. I've always liked robotics, so I found it fascinating.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Wow, that is something. It'll be a while before it's commercialised though, won't it?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: It's still at the trial stage, so it'll take a bit. But watching these things come out one by one, it feels a lot like when smartphones first appeared.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, everyone was amazed back then too. The world really does change fast.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Tell me about it. Anyway, I just wanted to share that. Let's get a meal sometime when you're free.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, sounds good, let's talk again. And enjoy your time with the dog!

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Hello, is this Kim Okyeon? It's Bae Jongsik, from the wholesale side over in Mapo.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, Jongsik! What's the occasion? It's been ages.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Do you remember me? Back at that work dinner, I was talking about badminton and you said you did dancesport.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's right, that's right. I was bragging about entering a competition, haha. You still remember that.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Of course, it was a good time. How's your health these days? My body isn't what it used to be.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: My shoulder's been giving me trouble with age too, but dancing does take the stress off. How are things with your children?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Good — I went on a bit of a restaurant tour with my kid recently. That's about my one pleasure these days.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That sounds lovely. Anyway, what did you call about today?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Ah, the thing is, we've got an event next month and we need some temporary help for just a few days. It's not urgent, so you can take your time asking around.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, in that case I'll ask around and see if anyone I know has the time.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, yes, no need to rush. Just letting me know roughly sometime this week is plenty.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll look into it and get back to you.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Thank you, Okyeon. Next time we meet, dinner's on me.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, yes, sounds good. Look after your health, and see you soon.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello, Nabin! It's me. Is this a good time?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's fine. What's the occasion, you actually calling and everything

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I just wanted to hear your voice, it's been a while. How's work, are you busy?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Don't get me started, I've been swamped preparing training material. It's eased off a bit now, though

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's a relief. Anyway, nothing urgent, I just wanted to talk about summer holidays.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, good — I was just wondering where to go this summer myself

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeosu keeps catching my eye lately. There's the sea, and plenty to eat

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yeosu is lovely. I'm near Yeongam so I get down south a lot — I'd recommend giving Wando a go too

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Wando? What's it known for?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: The waters are clean so the seafood is genuinely fresh, and Myeongsasimni beach is beautiful. Lovely for a slow walk

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that sounds good. I don't actually have to decide in a hurry, so I'll look at a few things and then pick

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I'll take my time thinking about it too, then. Let's talk again

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, sounds good. We'll talk more when I see you at work next week

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, get home safe, and let's talk again!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hey, Woojae, it's me. Nothing much going on?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, no, same as always for me. Have you been busy lately?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: So-so. Work's much the same every month. Are you eating properly?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, I've been going to the gym and trying to eat better, but it's not going well. How's your health these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ugh, don't ask, this belly won't budge. Anyway, nothing urgent, I was just curious about something so I called.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, go ahead. What's it about?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: So you said you're taking that certification course. How is it, is it any use?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ah, the distribution manager one? There's more theory than I expected. But it connects with what I've picked up doing field surveys, so it is interesting.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yeah? It was like that for me too when I did my accounting certificate. These days though I'm more worried about sending my kid to after-school classes. Why do they pile so much on right from kindergarten?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, really? I don't know much about that side of things yet... They say education costs a lot for kids these days — is that true?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You have no idea. But it's not something I have to decide right away, so I'm looking into it slowly. No point stressing about it.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I see. I suppose I'll have those worries too once I get married — it's a bit scary already, heh heh.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, you've got plenty of time, no need to think about it yet. When's the certification exam?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Next month. I've still got some room, though, so I'm not cramming.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, prepare well then, and let's get a meal sometime when you're free.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, see you next time. Get home safe!

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Hello, is this Sangsu's phone? It's Kim Yuna from the office. The number looks unfamiliar, doesn't it? My phone broke, so I'm calling from my sister's.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, I knew from your voice. Just to check, though — you gave me a nickname at that last work dinner. What was it again?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Ah, that — I called you the gukbap shop owner, because you always buy everyone dinner. Haha, right?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's it, that's it — it's definitely you, Yuna. So what's up at this hour?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: I just wondered how you were doing. You must be busy with the company project these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, getting by. The kids are on holiday, so it must be even more hectic on your end?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Don't get me started — why do the class fees keep going up. Which reminds me, do you know of any side work that'd be doable on weekends?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Side work? What kind are you thinking — something from home?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, I have to watch the kids so going out is hard. Something on the computer, or phone-based support work, would be ideal.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, in that case I think I heard the team next to mine is hiring for remote data entry, but I'm not certain, I'd have to check.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Oh, really? That sounds like it'd be good.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: If it's not urgent, I'll look into it properly after this weekend and get back to you — better that I check it's solid before I tell you.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Of course, it's not urgent. I'd be grateful if you'd look into it in your own time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll check and text you. Enjoy the time with your kids.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Thank you, Sangsu. I'll buy you a meal next time. Take care.

victim_persona.occupation: Former electronics product development engineer and researcher, currently job-seeking

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's me, Chanhui. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, Chanhui! It's been ages — good to hear your voice. How are things?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: So-so, haha. I'm swamped with job hunting. Are you still looking at research institutes?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, I keep applying but it's not working out. Hey, this is really you, right? What did you do for the talent show at orientation that time?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Ah, that — I sang a trot song with the lyrics rewritten, and it completely bombed, haha

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, right, that was genuinely funny. So what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: So I'm preparing for the civil service exam at the moment, and our study group decided to do a bulk order for the textbooks. I'm a bit short on money, though... could you possibly lend me some?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Out of the blue? How much do you need?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: About 30,000 won. I'm working a part-time job this month so I can pay you back right away.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Okay, got it. My memory of the account number is a bit hazy, though — could you read it out again?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Then let me show you on screen over a video call for a second, that'd be more accurate.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, sure, let's do video.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's it — it's the same account as before. I'll send it this evening.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Thank you! I'll buy you a meal next time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, let's meet up soon. Good luck with the exam prep!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello — oh, Nayeong, it's me.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Getting by, you know. The weather in Ganghwa has turned quite chilly lately.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Same here in Songpa. It's cold morning and evening.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Is work going all right? I hear marketing's been tough lately too.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, it's busy, but actually my nephew's on holiday and he's asked me to find him a part-time job.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, is that so? How long is he thinking?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: He said about two weeks would do.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Well, there's a traffic-marshalling spot at our construction site — it's not hard work. Shall I pass it on?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Oh, that'd be great. Who should he contact?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'll give you the site manager's number, so have your nephew ring him directly. It's not urgent, so no rush looking into it.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: All right, thank you. My nephew will be pleased.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's nothing. Let's talk again soon — take care of yourself.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, thank you. Let's get a meal sometime.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hey, Yeongwon, how've you been? We haven't been in touch at all lately

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I'm doing well. Nothing much going on with you either?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Same as always for me. Sitting in the security office, the day goes by quick

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: At least the weather's cooled off a bit lately, that's something

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Right, right. Anyway, did you see the news? There's another fuss about free subway rides for seniors

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that — I saw it too. Every local government's talking about the deficits

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: But it's hard to turn round and tell older people to pay, so it's a tricky one

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True. There's talk of adjusting the age threshold, though — what do you think about that?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hmm, there's something to that, but when I think of my own mother I can't say it so easily

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's fair. It doesn't seem like something to decide in a hurry — it needs time and discussion

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Exactly. Not that it's ours to decide, haha — we're just chatting

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True. Anyway, what have you been doing on weekends? You said you were looking into a workshop

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ah, that — still just looking into it. I really do want to open one someday

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I hope it works out. You've got my support

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Thanks. Let's get a meal sometime. Take care

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, take care

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, son, it's fine. The ship came in today so I've been resting.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: That's good. The weather's been all over the place — how are you feeling?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'm all right, more or less. My joints have been aching a bit lately, though. Well, at my age.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, really? Have you been to the doctor?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: No, it's not that bad. It comes with the work, that's all.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Still, get a check-up. When was the last time you had one, Mum?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hmm... around this time last year, I think. It has been a while.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Then get one when you next have the time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll book it for my next day off. Thanks for thinking of me.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: And I'll send you some red ginseng and vitamins. Make sure you eat properly too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You don't have to, really, what's all this. But I'll take it gratefully.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Same address, right? ●● District, ●● Neighbourhood, Unit ●●● — is that right?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, that's right, send it there.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Got it, Mum. Get some rest today. I'll call again next week.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, son. You eat properly too. You work so hard.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Hello, is this Han Seonghui? It's Jeong Areum — I used to work with you in the accounting team. I'm not sure if you remember me.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh my, I knew straight away from your voice. I remember us making instant noodles together on those late shifts.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: That's right, that's right, you remember. How have you been? I think this is the first time I've been in touch since you moved down to Daegu.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I'm doing well. How about you, Areum? Still busy with work in Bundang?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Don't get me started, I'm run ragged with my child's classes. At least I still play badminton every weekend, so I can breathe a bit.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's impressive you keep up the exercise. I've had a lot of work lately so I haven't managed even that.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Anyway, the old team is thinking of getting together for a dinner. I wanted to see if you'd be up for coming.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, that sounds nice. Are you collecting a contribution for it?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, yes, a small amount each, keeping it modest. You know the account we used to collect dues in before — just send it there.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll send it there then. How much is everyone chipping in?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: 50,000 won each.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Fine, I'll send it to the old account. I'm busy right now, so I'll do it in the evening when I've got a moment.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, thank you. I'll text you the venue.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, understood. Let's be in touch again.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Hey, it's me.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Huh? Did you change your phone? This is a number I don't know.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yeah, the screen broke last week so I got a new line.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Hearing your voice, it's you all right. I nearly got confused there, though.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: How've you been? Are you still going out to play badminton?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Yes, twice a week. How about you — you said you were looking to get back into work, is that going well?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: So-so. There's a practicum for the social worker certificate, and the registration fee is a bit steep. That's why I called.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Oh, is that right? How much do you need?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 300,000 won. It's not urgent, anytime within this month is fine. I'm a bit embarrassed to bring it up with my husband.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: All right — try calling me on video. Let's talk face to face, it's been a while.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yeah, good idea. I'll call now.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Oh, it really is you — good to see your face. So the account, the same one I sent to over the holidays last time, right?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's the one. Thanks. And there's no rush sending it.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: All right, I'll put it in tomorrow while I'm at the bank. When you get the certificate and land a job, you can buy me a meal.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Of course I will. Thanks. I'll call again soon.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, Jinseong! It's me — been a while, hasn't it?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it really has. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Not bad. Now the kid's off at school I've got a bit of time. Are you swamped with work these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't ask — it's spring, so landscaping is chaos right now. Still, it's manageable.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just look after yourself while you're at it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, thanks. So what did you call about today?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, nothing much — have you seen the stuff about LoL esports marketing lately? Hanwha Life Esports' slogan is 'Super Dive', apparently.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You watch LoL? Super Dive? What's that supposed to mean?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: In League of Legends it means taking the risk and diving into enemy territory. So they're saying they're going aggressively for the title this year.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh, that's interesting. I only watch football these days, so I didn't know much about esports.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: You do like football. Is the K League worth watching at the moment?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, my team's on a great run so I'm enjoying it. I'll give esports a look if I get the time.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Sure, I'll fill you in if there's anything worth watching for. Good talking today.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, let's talk again. Stay well.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's me — Kim Chaeseong, the one who lived in Jinju. Been a while, hasn't it?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it really has been. How've you been? Good to hear your voice.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yeah, getting by. Are you still doing the farm machinery work in Okcheon?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, still at it. I think you said you were training to be a florist — is that going well?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, that's right — that's actually why I called. I'm in a certification class now, and I'm a bit short on the course fee.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, is that so? Hey, what was your nickname back in our club — do you remember?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Ah, that — I was 'Scissorhands'. I got that after the flower arranging contest.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's it, Scissorhands. Haha, it really is good to hear from you. Shall we talk face to face, though? Let's switch to video.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, sure. One moment, I'll call right now.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, good to see your face. So how short are you on the course fee?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: About 300,000 won. I'll pay you back as soon as my dad's pay comes in next month.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: If it's not urgent, take your time paying it back — don't feel any pressure.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Thank you. Where should I send it back to, though? Let me know the account.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: The same KB Bank account you used to send the club dues to is still there — send it to that one.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: All right, I'll send it later. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure. Get that certificate, and make me a bouquet sometime. Take care.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Hey! It's me, Lee Hyesu. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh my, it's you! It's been ages. Good to hear your voice.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: I know, right? Are you doing well? Has the little one grown a lot?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, she's starting to talk more now. How's the used car work going for you?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's so-so. But I've been flat out preparing for a trading company licence. I'll need it if I'm ever going to run my own business.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? You've been saying that since way back — that you wanted to be your own boss. Same dream, still going.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Right, haha. The course is a bit expensive, though, and I'm short on this month's fee. It's not urgent, but I wondered if you could lend me a little.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, is that so? There's a lot of phone scams like this going around these days, apparently... let me just check it's really you. We sold something together at the school festival back then — what was it?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Ah, that? Tteokbokki. You burned the spicy batch and we had to throw the whole lot out.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's right, that was so embarrassing. It's definitely you, haha.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: That's put your mind at ease, right? If you're still worried, shall I show you my face over video?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, that'd be good — let me see your face for a second.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, yes, one moment... Can you see me? It's me, right? It's not urgent, so take your time thinking it over and send it whenever suits you later.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, seeing your face settles it. The account's the same one I sent to before, right?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, that's right, I'm still using that same account. Thank you — I'll definitely pay you back once I get the licence.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, pay it back whenever. I'm rooting for you to get that licence and become the boss. I'll send it once I've got the baby down.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Thank you. I'll buy you a coffee next time. Take care.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hello, it's me.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, Miyeon. What's up at this hour?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I just got bored after dinner. Nothing much going on with you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as always for me. I took my mother to the hospital.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, how's your mother's health?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: She's fine, nothing to worry much about. Anyway, is something up?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, nothing much, and it's not urgent — I just felt like talking about hair salons.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hair salons? Why, out of nowhere — did something happen?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Salon prices have gone up so much lately. A perm easily runs over 150,000 won.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Heh, that expensive? I just pay 15,000 won for a cut at the local barber.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: It's cheaper for men, though. For women even just a cut is 40,000 won.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I see. So do you go to the salon often?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: About once every two months. Lately I've been doing face masks at home to save money.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: My mother used to put cucumber slices on her face back in the day — I suppose that works too.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Right, apparently it's cheap and it works. I should try it sometime.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, save where you can, take it easy. Let's talk again sometime

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Seyeong! Have you had lunch?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, just now. I got to take my time with it today.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: How've you been? You've been looking well.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, so-so. I've been walking up Surisan on weekends lately. Trying to lose a bit of weight.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, nice. I'm worried about my belly lately. Maybe it's all the Japanese places I go to in Asan.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Japanese food is great, haha. But it can be salty, so you should be careful.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Exactly. Anyway, nothing urgent, I'm just curious — does eating lots of vegetables really make you feel better?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Definitely. My lungs aren't great from smoking, so I've been trying to get vegetables and fruit in lately.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, really? How often do you eat them?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I try for two or three times a day, but it's not easy. Too busy.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: When I stay up all night gaming I end up eating nothing but takeaway. I need to sort that out.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I should cut back on cigarettes and play more badminton myself. Exercising definitely does make you feel lighter.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Let me play badminton with you sometime. I'm a complete beginner, though.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sounds good. I'll give you a call if I'm free at the weekend.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Sure, sure, let's talk again

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, let's talk again later. Take care.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Oh, hello. It's Kim Danbi. Do you remember me sitting next to you at the Changwon plant dinner last time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, of course — you're the one who polished off a whole bottle of soju on your own, right? Heh heh

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: That's right, I was completely drunk that night. You've got a good memory.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: How have you been? Busy out doing sales?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, getting by. I went to the hot springs with my parents at the weekend — got a bit of a rest.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That must have been nice. I've been climbing Muhaksan a lot lately — even just that gives me energy.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: I see. Anyway, we've taken on a new part-timer at the warehouse, and I wondered if you could look over the contract.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, in that case of course I'll look at it. Is it urgent?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: No, no, it's not urgent — anytime this week is fine. Take your time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Then I'll have a look after work today. Could you email it over?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, yes, I'll send it right now. Thank you, and sorry for always asking you these things.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Not at all, I'm used to this sort of thing, it's fine. Let's get a meal sometime.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Sounds good, let's find a time soon. Do check the email, then. Take care!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, take care.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. My voice sounds a bit odd, doesn't it? I've got a bit of a cold and my throat's gone hoarse.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: It does, you sound like a completely different person. Are you all right?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yeah, I'm fine, but... I had a bit of a fender bender on the way home from work earlier.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: An accident? Are you hurt anywhere? Hang on, though — is this really you, Hyeonjeong? Back when I went fishing I asked you to buy me something. What was it?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Oh, you asked me to get earthworm bait and I was completely grossed out — don't you remember I got it from the convenience store?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Haha, that's right, that's right. Your voice just threw me for a second. So was the accident bad?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Not too bad, but the bumper's gone so I've left it at the garage. The quote came out higher than I expected, though.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Right, let me see your face — can you switch to a video call? Your voice sounds odd, so seeing you would put my mind at rest.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yeah, sure, I'll switch now, hang on.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, it really is you — looks like it's just your throat that's swollen. That's a relief. How much do you need?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 500,000 won should do it, but it's not urgent, so there's no rush sending it.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right. Same account I used for the tuition fees last time, yes? Should I send it there?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, I'm still using that account. Thanks, Dad.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Don't mention it. Look after yourself, and don't rush the accident paperwork — take your time with it.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yeah, got it. I'll call again this evening. Take care.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, get home safe.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Hello, Dad? It's me, Seulgi.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Huh? What's this number — Seulgi? It's an unfamiliar number.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Oh, my phone's battery died so I'm calling from a coworker's phone.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, I see. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, just now. How are you doing these days, Dad?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Same as ever. So what's going on?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Well, the thing is, I took a bit of a fall on the stairs yesterday and went to the hospital.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What? Are you badly hurt? Where did you hurt yourself?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I sprained my ankle. It's nothing major, but the physiotherapy costs came to a bit.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Right. Your voice sounds a bit unfamiliar, though. This really is Seulgi, isn't it? What was the name of the dog we had when you were little?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It was Choco, Dad. If you don't believe me, shall I show you my face later?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: No, that's all right, I can tell from your voice it's you. How much did it come to?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 150,000 won. It's not urgent, so send it whenever suits you.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, I'll send it later. Watch that ankle.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, thank you, Dad. I'll get in touch again once my phone's fixed.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's me, Jiseong. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? Jiseong? It's been a while — this number's unfamiliar, what's up?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Oh, my phone broke, so I borrowed a coworker's to call.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I see. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yeah, getting by. Is work going all right for you these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same old. So what did you call for?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Well, I'm trying to enrol in a CCTV control operator certification course, and I'm a bit short on the fee.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah? Just to check, though — what was the club event called when we first met?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It was the club MT, the one in Haeundae. If you don't believe me, shall I show you my face over video?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, let's do that — switch over for a sec.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, one moment... (switches to video call) It's me, right?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, that's you — seeing your face settles it. How much do you need?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: About 200,000 won. It's not urgent, so send it whenever suits you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, I'll send it to the account you used for the donations before, yes?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, that's right, that account is fine.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Got it, I'll send it later. Good luck with the exam.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Thank you! I'll get in touch again once my phone's fixed.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's me, Jewon.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? Jewon! It's been a while — how've you been?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yeah, getting by. How have you been doing?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Me, just getting on with it. So what's this about, all of a sudden?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: You just came to mind. Teaching the kids at the kindergarten has been fun lately.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Oh, but the thing is, I'm trying to register for an advanced early childhood education workshop and the cost is a bit tight.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah? Just to check, though — where was it we first met?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It was the department seminar. Remember I was late because I was printing my presentation and had to run?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, right, I remember. Just to be sure, though — can we do a video call?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, one moment... (switches to video call) It's me, right?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, that's you. Good to see you. So how much do you need?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: About 150,000 won. It's not urgent, so there's no rush sending it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, no need to hurry. Which account should I send it to?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: The account you used to send the club dues to before is fine.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, I know that account. Got it.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Thank you. I'll buy you a meal next time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure. Enjoy the workshop.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Hello, is this No Sangsu? It's Kim Cheolsu — we used to work together.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Kim Cheolsu? Oh... it's been a while. What's the occasion?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: So, my phone broke, so I'm calling from a different number.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I see. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, getting by. You're still at the company in Gwacheon?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, still there. So what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Do you remember when we inspected the switchboard in our building and had to buy a part in a hurry? I paid for it on your behalf.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, right, the breaker part. I was rushed off my feet going into a meeting that day so I asked you to get it for me.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: That's right, you remember exactly.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: How much should I send you?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: It came to about 80,000 won. I'll send you a photo of the receipt.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll send it within this week.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, thank you. There's no rush sending it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'll send it to the account we used for settling up back then, right?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, that's right, that account is fine.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Understood, I'll send it later.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Thank you. I'll be in touch again.

victim_persona.occupation: Other construction, electrical and production managers

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's me, Jeon Minsu, the one working at the care home. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it really has been a while. Are you still working in Namyangju?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, yes, same as ever. Do you remember me, though? I came to help out with your class at the school festival back then — I fell over and you put a plaster on me.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, right, that! You were on the verge of tears insisting you were fine. I remember, haha.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: I'm preparing for the social worker certificate at the moment, and the placement registration fee and textbook costs came out sooner than I'd budgeted for. I'd rather not bring it up with my parents, so I've shamelessly called you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, is that so? How much do you need? Doing this on voice alone feels a bit off, though — shall we switch to a video call?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, sure, one moment, I'll call on video.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, it really is you, Minsu — seeing your face settles it. It's not urgent though, is it? I can check things over and send it in my own time?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, yes, it's not urgent — anytime this week is fine. Take your time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Then the account you gave me last time — I send it there, right?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, that's right, that's the account. You've saved me.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's nothing. Prepare well for the exam. Buy me a meal once you've got the certificate.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: I definitely will. Thank you. Take care!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello — oh, Taehyeon, it's me. I called thinking you might have a bit of free time today.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, hello. I was busy sorting out the warehouse today, but I'm having a bit of a rest now.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, how's your body holding up? You said your back had been bad lately.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ah, that — it's got a bit better with the hospital visits. How about you? I hear you've had a lot of call-outs lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't ask — there've been a lot of accidents because of the weather. Haha.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Exactly. You take care too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, by the way, I hear your boy's seeing someone? I caught a bit of it last time.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ah, yes, yes — he's been seeing a young woman from the same company for a while now. He says he'll introduce her before long.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that's good news. How old is she?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Twenty-nine, he says, and apparently she's got a good head on her shoulders. Though I don't know whether young people these days are even thinking about marriage.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: These days everyone seems to prefer dating for a long time over marrying. Look at my daughter — years now, just dating.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's right, it's different from our day. Still, as long as he's met a good person that's enough — nothing to rush about.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly, marriage can happen whenever. Let me know when your boy introduces her.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, will do — I'll let you know once a date's set. And you look after yourself too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, and you mind that back, Taehyeon. Let's get a meal sometime.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, yes, let's see each other soon. I'll hang up now.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's me, Jian! It's been a while, hasn't it?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? The voice is familiar... are you the one who went to the coin karaoke place with me at the festival?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, that's me! You grabbed my mic and sang, remember?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, right, it's you! It really has been ages. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Getting by. I'm swamped with job hunting these days — I've been working part-time over in Seomyeon.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, the job market is so rough right now. What are you preparing for?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: I'm trying to get a marketing certificate — the one you studied for before you joined your company. I was wondering if I could get the materials for it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that? I do have notes I put together back then, but they're files on my computer so I'd have to dig them out.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: If it's any trouble you really don't have to... Could I just ask how you went about studying?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: No, no trouble at all. If it's not urgent I'll sort them out this weekend and send them — you can go through them at your own pace.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Really? Thank you!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, and get in touch again if anything comes up while you're studying. Let me know once the exam date is set.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, will do! I feel a lot better thanks to you. Next time you come over to Seomyeon, dinner's on me.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sounds good, let's find a time. And good luck with the job hunt!

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's me — have you got a minute to talk?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Yeah, it's fine. What's the occasion, calling at this hour

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I just wanted to hear your voice. How's the factory work going lately?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Same as always. The volume's high so it's a bit hard. How's the coating work for you?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I'm getting by too. Actually, I called because I've got a favour to ask

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: What is it? Go ahead

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I've fallen behind on my nail salon bill — could you lend me about 200,000 won? I'll pay you back as soon as I'm paid

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Oh, is that so? What was the name of that nail salon again, the one you went to in Jinhae

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Oh, that place? Nainail, the one where the owner has really deft hands

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: That's it, that's it. I'd like to talk face to face though — shall we switch to a video call?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Oh, sure. Hang on, I'll turn the camera on

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Hey, you're looking well. The money's not urgent so I can send it in my own time — I probably won't have a moment until this evening

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Thanks. So you can send it to the same account as last time, right?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Yeah, still using that one, the number hasn't changed. I'll send it this evening

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Okay, got it. They're rerunning the Lim Young-woong concert this evening — watch that and take it easy

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Haha, maybe I will. All right, take care and let's talk again

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hey, Jisu, it's me. Have you been doing all right?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. Same as always for me — the kitchen's absolutely killing us lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I know, the weather's turned suddenly cold. Is it like that in Yeosu too?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, when the sea wind blows here it gets much colder. How's Daegu?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's no joke here either — my hands freeze solid standing guard, haha.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That must be hard. Nothing urgent, so let's take our time — I've got a bit of room today too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's right, nothing to rush about. So which do you prefer, Jisu — winter or summer?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Spring or autumn, definitely. The kitchen gets so hot that summer is genuinely unbearable.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, of course, you're in front of the burners all day. I still find winter better, since the security office has a heater.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I'm jealous, haha. For us, even with the air conditioning on, it's useless in front of the burners in summer.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You really do have it hard. At least it's cooling off now, so you'll get a bit of a breather.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, exactly, evenings are bearable these days. You look after yourself too — if it's cold at night you'll catch a cold.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Thanks. You watch out for colds too, Jisu. Let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, yes. Get home safe.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, Jiin, it's me. How've you been

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. What's brought this on, calling and all

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: You just came to mind. How's school these days, busy?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't ask, it's exam period and it's chaos. How about you, are you keeping well?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I'm getting by. Nothing urgent, I just called to see how you were

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, nothing to rush. Take your time

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: My parents have been going to the hospital a lot lately, and it's been playing on my mind

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh dear, what's wrong with them? Is it serious?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Nothing major, it's their joints. Getting back and forth seems to be hard on them

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Well, that's a relief. They must feel reassured having you there looking after them

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Being around, you end up doing this and that. Though I think I'll need to start looking for work soon

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't rush that — go by how you're feeling, what with your parents to think of as well

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right. Nothing urgent about it, so I'll look around slowly

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Good thinking. Call again if anything comes up

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yeah, thanks. I'll be in touch again — take care

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, give my regards to your parents, and look after yourself

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hello, Director Gangseok? It's Jang Pilsu.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, Jang Pilsu, it's been a while. How are you keeping?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, getting by well enough. The weather's turned a bit chilly over in Okjeong.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's not that cold here in Busan yet. Are you eating properly?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Of course — I'm still doing restaurant tours every weekend. Nothing urgent, so there's no need to rush the call.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, good. So what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, nothing much — I wondered whether you'd seen the new film that's out. Apparently everyone's talking about it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that one? Haven't seen it yet. The only comic I follow these days is One Piece.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: You watch One Piece as well? I don't really know it — my kids are completely hooked on animated films these days.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's kids for you. Though a lot of adults watch animation these days too.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's right — I took the kids to the cinema and found myself completely absorbed without realising.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Is that so? Then I should watch one myself sometime. There are plenty of cinemas in Busan.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, do give it a go. I'll be in touch again, then.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, and you look after your health, Jang Pilsu. Let's get a meal sometime.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hey, Jeongsuk, it's me. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. I'm doing all right. How's the site work these days?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Same as ever. The heat makes it a bit rough. Are things busy in the school kitchen?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's hectic with the summer holidays coming up. So what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Well, I've been seeing news about new safety sensor technology on site lately. They said there's something similar on the food side, so you came to mind.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: What sort of thing?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: A sensor that detects refrigeration temperature and hygiene conditions in real time — I thought it might be good for somewhere like a school kitchen.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that would be handy. But is there something you want me to do?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I was wondering if you could ask whoever's in charge whether the school kitchen could look into bringing that sort of technology in.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I can do that, but I'd have to look into it myself first, so I can't give you an answer straight away.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: It's not urgent at all, so take your time looking into it. I was only asking for reference anyway.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll quietly ask the dietitian sometime next week then.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Thanks. And if you come across any good information, let me know too — I'm curious whether we could apply it at our site.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Got it, I'll look into it and get back to you. Take care at work.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: All right, thanks. Let's get a meal sometime.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hey, Bak Ganghyeok, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's fine. It's been a while — how have you been?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Getting by, you know. What with the weather, my body's been creaking a bit.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Are you unwell somewhere? Don't push yourself, take your time telling me — it's not urgent.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Thanks, haha. So the thing is, I had a health check-up recently and my cholesterol came back a bit high.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh dear, that's something you need to keep an eye on. Are you eating anything in particular these days?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Just eating as I always have. But with age it seems even that becomes a problem.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I've been trying to cut back on greasy food myself, and it's not easy. Let's talk it through slowly over a meal.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Right, we should. I've been trying to at least go for a walk in the evenings too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's a good idea. Being a train driver, I sit for so long that I don't get enough exercise either.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I know. At our age, looking after your body really is the most important thing.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly. Let's neither of us overdo it — stay healthy and we'll be seeing each other for a long time.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Right, let's get a meal sometime when you're free. Take care of yourself.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, look after yourself. I'll be in touch again.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hello, Oh Huiyeon? It's Bak Seunggeon — is this a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's fine. What's this about?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: How's work at the factory these days, are you busy?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'm all right. The children have got colds so it's a bit hectic, but it's fine. How about you?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: We've had a lot of volume so it was busy, but it's eased off now. Anyway, it's not urgent, I just wanted to ask you something.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, go ahead. Take your time.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Our department is having a dinner next week, and as a thank-you we'd like to send some snacks to the childcare centre where you work. I was wondering what would be good.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Goodness, that's very kind... Hmm, the children like things like jellies and yoghurt. But some of them have allergies, so you'd need to check the ingredient labels.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ah, of course, we'll have to be careful about that. I'll get a few kinds of jellies then and send them over.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, lovely! But there's no need to rush — we've got another snack event next month, so you could time it for then.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ah, I'll prepare it for then in that case. Thanks for letting me know.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Not at all, I'm the one who should be thanking you for thinking of us.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: No, no, I'm the grateful one. I'll be in touch again next week, then.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, understood. Take care!

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, Lee Seungyeon, it's me. Is this a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, yes, it's fine — it's the children's nap time so I'm free for a bit.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's good. How's the weather in Jindo these days? It's still a bit chilly here in Chungbuk.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's warmed up a bit here. So what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ah, nothing in particular. It's not urgent, I just called for a proper chat. My nephew is enlisting soon.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Where's he going?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: The army, at Nonsan, apparently. It brought back memories, so I've been helping him get things together.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I see. And where did you serve, back then?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I served out my full term in the army as a sergeant, up in Gangwon. Maybe it was the risk management side of things, but I remember the training being especially tough.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Goodness, that must have been hard. My son will probably go next year, and I'm already worrying about it.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: When the time comes, just ask me. There's a lot to sort out.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I really will — that's reassuring. And please pass on my best to your nephew.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, I'll tell him. I only called to say hello, so let's talk again another time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, yes, thank you. Take care.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hey, Gwanghui, it's me. How's business these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. I'm just working at the factory, same as ever.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Right. Are you keeping well? The weather's been all over the place.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, so-so. Are things busy for you at the market these days?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Busy, yes, but in the evenings I end up resting and hunting for something to watch. There are a lot of comics being made into films these days, aren't there?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: There are, loads of them lately. I suppose having the source material makes them easier to produce.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Exactly. Did you know, though? DP was originally a comic too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? I had no idea. Where was it serialised?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: On a site called Lezhin Comics, apparently. Not even a particularly famous platform, and it was a huge hit.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's surprising. I tend to stick to action films rather than that sort of thing.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: So is there anything you've enjoyed? Something you rewatch a lot.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Tazza, New World — if they're on TV I end up watching them again.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: You do like noir, then. I like that sort of thing too, but these days I only watch animation because I'm watching with the kids.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, that must be fun in its own way. If the kids enjoy it, that's what counts.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Right. It's been good talking today — let's get a meal sometime when you're free.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I'll be in touch then. Look after your health.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hey, Sujin, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, yeah, I have. What's the occasion, calling at this hour

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I just finished early today. Is the security work manageable these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Getting by, you know. It does get a bit cold doing rounds at night. How about the factory, still busy?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Busy, but it always is. Oh, that's right — I went to the hairdresser's today

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? What did you have done, a cut?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yeah, just trimmed it short and covered the grey a bit. I've been getting so many white hairs lately

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's a worry for me too. I'd been meaning to ask what dye you use

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I just go to the local salon and let them handle it. Nothing complicated about it

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I see. I do it myself at home and it always comes out patchy, which drives me mad

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Haha, it is surprisingly tricky. It's easier to just go to the salon, even if it costs a bit

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You're right, I should go next time. What have you planted in the vegetable patch lately?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I put in some lettuce and chillies. I'll pick some and bring them round before long

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, lovely. I'll enjoy them, thank you

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: All right, let's talk again soon. Take care of yourself

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, you too. Keep well

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hello, is this Kim Seungcheol? Sorry to call at dinner time — have you got a moment?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, yes, it's fine, I've just eaten and I'm resting. What's this about?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Nothing in particular, I just wondered how you've been. Is the kitchen work manageable?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, same as ever. I've got a bit more breathing room lately, so I've been playing badminton in the evenings.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ah, that's good, getting some exercise. I've been feeling a bit sluggish lately and I was thinking of trying something different.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I see. I started because I was feeling heavy too. It's not urgent, so take your time thinking about it — there's no need to lock something in.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Right, haha. Actually, that reminds me — you know the Seoul Foundation for Arts and Culture performance programme? Do you know it?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that one? I've heard the name but I don't really know what it is.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: The Seoul Foundation for Arts and Culture runs it, and they put on free performances in places like Daehangno and Mullae-dong. I went once with my daughter.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that's nice. Is it similar to Seoul Stage 11, then? I think I heard about that in passing once.

turns.speaker: Coworker
