turns.text: That's it! It turns out it's part of the same thing. Looks like they're running some this month too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Shall we go together sometime, then? It'd be nice to bring the kids along.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Sounds good, I'll let you know once the dates are out. No need to lock anything in — we'll find a time that suits.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That would work nicely. Thanks for telling me, I'll have a look myself too.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Do that. Let's talk again. Enjoy your evening and get some rest.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, take care. See you next time.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's me. My number's changed, so I'm calling from a new one.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Huh? It came up as a number I hadn't saved, so I answered with 'who's this' — you gave me a fright.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I got a new phone and switched to a budget carrier, so the number changed.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Still, I should check. If you really are Go Jinu, what was the nickname I used to tease you with when we were little?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That was 'Little Train Driver', because all I played with as a kid were toy trains.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: That's right, that's right. I should have known the moment I heard your voice. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yeah, I'm doing well. Is work busy for you these days? Are the kids doing all right?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Busy, but I'm holding up. The kids are in exam period, so I'm run off my feet too.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That's rough. Anyway, Mum and Dad's seventieth isn't far off, so I called to talk about it.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Oh, that's right, it's come round already. Have you got anything in mind?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I was thinking we could send them on a trip. And we could split the cost between us.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: That's a good idea. It's not urgent though, so let's talk it through properly over the weekend.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: All right, let's get into the details when we talk at the weekend.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Sure. I'll save the new number. Let's talk again soon.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, hello? Ah yes, is this Bak Jisu?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, it's me. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Very well. Is the kitchen busy these days? You sound a bit tired

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, don't get me started, there've been so many customers I've been run ragged. It's a bit quieter today, though, so I gave you a call

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Good for you, you need some breathing room like this. Take your time, go ahead

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, haha. Anyway, have you watched anything good lately? I saw a film on Netflix yesterday

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, what did you watch? I've been looking for something myself

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That animated one, Slam Dunk. It's based on the old comic, and there's a new film version out

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I've seen that! The basketball one, right? The artwork came out really beautifully

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Exactly. I read it as a comic book when I was little, so seeing it again like this brought back a lot

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: With my kid around I mostly watch action films rather than animation these days, but I should give that a go

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, definitely watch it, you won't regret it. Anyway, I should start getting the shop ready

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, of course. Thank you for making time when you're busy. Let's talk again

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, yes, take care!

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's me, Gang Jihun. I'm calling from Busan so there's a bit of noise on the line, isn't there?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? Your voice sounds a bit different — is this really Gang Jihun? Hey, what was your nickname back in the tech school workshop, do you remember?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Ah, that — you called me 'the Measuring King', because I never got a single micrometer reading wrong

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, that's right, that's right, it really is Gang Jihun. It's been a while — how've you been?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yeah, getting by. Are you still doing delivery rounds in Anyang? It must be hard in winter

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't ask, my hands are completely chapped. So what made you call, is something up?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Well, the thing is, I'm preparing for the quality management engineer certificate and I'm awkwardly short on the course fee

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah? How much do you need

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: About 300,000. I'm really sorry, but I'll pay you back as soon as my part-time wages come in next month

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hmm... let's do a video call and talk face to face — hearing only your voice feels a bit unfamiliar

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, of course, I'll call right now

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, seeing your face, it really is Gang Jihun — looks like you've lost some weight. All right, I'll send it to the account you always use

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Thank you. But it's not urgent, so there's no rush sending it

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, I'll send it this evening after work. Make sure you pass that exam

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, thank you so much. I'll buy you a meal next time

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, hello. Oh, Sohyang — what's up at this hour?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, hi. I'm just on a break so I thought I'd call. Did you finish cleaning the third floor today?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, pretty much done. You sound a bit off, though — is something up?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: No, nothing major. My son is going into the army next month, and it's been weighing on me.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I see. It's not urgent, so take your time — I've got a bit of room right now.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: What was your military service like? Was it hard?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Well, it's over twenty years ago now, but the early part, during training, was the hardest. Looking back, though, it turned out to be nothing much.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Really? My boy is a bit frail, so I worry a lot. Whether he'll hold up at the training camp.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: They say it's much gentler than it used to be. The food's good and everyone looks after each other. You probably don't need to worry too much.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's true. But thinking about being without him already leaves me feeling empty.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: There's no helping that. But between writing letters and going for visits, the time goes quickly — that's how it was with my nephew.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, that's right, your nephew served too, didn't he? Tell me about that, I'd like to hear.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, he went up to Gangwon. At first he said it was hard, but later he adapted well. That's how it goes for everyone.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hearing that puts my mind at ease a bit. Talking to you has lightened things for me.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Good. Try not to worry too much. I need to wrap up and head home now, so let's talk again later.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, thank you. See you tomorrow.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Hello? Er... what's this number, it's not one I recognise — who is this?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me, Jo Byeongjun. My phone screen cracked, so I borrowed a customer's phone at the shop to call.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Is this really Byeongjun? Your voice sounds a bit different... What's the name of our dog?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's Dubu, Dad, Dubu. Come on, it's me, I'm telling you.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, so it is. Your voice was a bit rough so I didn't catch it. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I have. How about you, Dad? Is there a lot of work on site these days?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Getting by, you know. So what is it, is something up? If it's not urgent, take your time telling me.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Actually... I had a bit of a fender bender earlier taking the shop car out. Nobody was badly hurt, just the bumper's gone.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What? You must have had a fright. Are you all right, though? Did you go to the hospital?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I'm perfectly fine. It's just that the repair cost came to a bit — the quote was a little over 500,000.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Right, as long as you're all right, that's what matters. I can help with that much, so read me the account and I'll send it from my own bank book.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Thanks, Dad. I'll pay you back as soon as my pay comes in next month.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: It's fine, there's no hurry, take your time paying it back. Just be more careful from now on.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I will. I'll bring something nice next time I'm down in Suncheon.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, take care of yourself and we'll talk later.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, Ms Lee Jenam? It's me. Is this a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's fine. Nothing much going on at the centre these days?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: No, no, the children and I are doing well. You must be busy? You've been looking a bit tired.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, does it show? I've had a lot of hearings lately. I do rest in the evenings watching dramas, though.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, that's what I called to ask about — what drama are you watching these days? You mentioned there was a good one last time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that — I've been watching a courtroom drama on Netflix, and it's surprisingly gripping.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: A courtroom drama must be even more fun for you. Is it very different from the real thing?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, some parts are exaggerated, but the story is solid so it's enjoyable. What are you watching these days?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I've got hooked on hunting down old live music videos on YouTube. Once the children are asleep I relax with those.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that sounds nice. I'll look some up when I get the time — it's not urgent, so recommend them whenever.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, yes, I'll send you a few links by message later. Let's leave the call there for today and talk again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, thank you. Have a lovely day with the children.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hey, Jinhui, it's me. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. I'm doing all right.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: How's your body holding up, what with the weather? You said you'd been struggling with diabetes before.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that — I've been keeping up with the medication so it's manageable these days. How's your back? Steelwork must put a lot of strain on it.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Heh, it still creaks, but it's bearable. The weather's lovely here in Jeju lately so it's easy to work.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That sounds nice. I've been running around banks fixing equipment.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Nothing urgent, I just called because you came to mind. We can take our time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, right, I'm on a break just now so it's fine. So how's work going for you?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: So-so. I'm finishing off a building here. Say, is your company hiring at all? A junior I know is looking.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: We haven't been recruiting much lately, but I'll ask around. I'll look into it and let you know.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yeah, no rush, look into it whenever suits.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Will do. Anyway, are you still drawing? I think you said you did it as a hobby.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yeah, I sketch in the evenings now and then. I've been enjoying painting the sea lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's great. Next time I'm down in Jeju, show me those paintings.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yeah, do come and visit. It's been good talking today — look after yourself.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You look after your health too. I'll be in touch again.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, Jo Minhui? It's me. Is this a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's fine — it's shift changeover so I've got a moment.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's good. It's turned chilly lately — isn't it cold, standing guard?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It does get cold at night, but it's bearable. How are things at home for you, Hwang Jeonghun?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, everyone's well. I didn't call about anything urgent, you just came to mind.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I see. Go ahead, take your time.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, that's right — come to think of it, so many people keep pets these days. When I go for a walk round the apartment complex it's dogs everywhere.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's true, there are a lot of people out walking dogs in front of the building I work at every morning too.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: My kids keep pestering me to get a dog, but I've got allergies so we can't.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I see. I used to keep a cat, but with work so busy now I don't think I could.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: A cat? That's quite surprising — I wouldn't have pictured you with a cat.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Why not? I'm surprisingly soft with cats. I liked feeding it and looking after it.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Haha, I see. Some people keep turtles or lizards these days, which I find quite curious.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That would scare me a bit. Still, I suppose everyone finds what suits them.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's true. Anyway, let's leave it there for today, and I'll call again whenever.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, yes, lovely. Let's talk again. Take care.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hey, Myeongho, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's fine. I've parked the forklift and I'm taking a short break.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, good timing then. How's work, is the industrial complex busy?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as ever. How about you, is the baby doing well?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yeah, growing fine, and talking more now, so it's chaos. Anyway, Myeongho, are you still on your own these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, still single. My idea of a good time is meat and a drink after work and watching the UFC.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Haha, that's not bad either. But at your age, shouldn't you be thinking about dating soon?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I know, but whenever I go on a blind date I don't know why it feels so awkward.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I was like that too back in the day. I met my wife just naturally, over drinks.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, so you met yours the natural way. I'm jealous — that kind of connection just doesn't come along for me.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Take it slowly, there's no rush. Marriage happens when the right person comes along.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True. I'm not in any hurry — things aren't bad as they are.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's the right attitude. Let's get a drink sometime when you're free.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, sounds good. Let's meet up next week.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, Yeongcheol, it's me. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. What have you been up to lately?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just raising the kid and looking into this and that. Are you still at the same factory job?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, same as ever. The volume's high lately so it's a bit hectic, haha

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's rough. Are the kids doing well? Isn't your eldest in middle school now?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, second year already. Time really flies. What year is yours in?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Mine's going into third year, and that's actually why I called. It's not urgent, I just had something to ask.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, go ahead, what is it?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I wanted to ask where you sent your daughter for high school back then.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that? We just sent her to the local academic high school. Look into it properly and get some counselling on it.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: All right, thanks. Let's talk again sometime next week if you're free — I'll ask more then.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, call any time. Look after the kid, and stay well.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Hey, it's me, Nam Junsik from HR. Is this a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, hi. What's this number, though? It's not saved.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Ah, that — my work phone's screen died so it's in for repair. I'm calling from my personal one.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Then, do you happen to... remember what I sang when I grabbed the mic at karaoke after our last work dinner?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: That one — you said you'd sing a ballad and then suddenly switched to trot, and everyone cracked up. That was the day someone brought Sungsimdang bread.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, that's right, that's right. How have you been? Are the kids doing all right at school?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Getting by, you know. How about you, is the research work manageable now you've moved down to Daejeon?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as always. So what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Well, I'm settling up next month's team dinner contributions and yours hasn't come in yet. It's not urgent, so send it whenever suits you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, right, I forgot. Which account should I send it to? Same as last time?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yeah, that's right, the same account we used to collect dinner money before.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right. Just so I'm sure, though — could you snap a photo of the account number and send it on KakaoTalk?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Sure, I'll take one and send it right now.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I'll check it and send the money this evening.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Thanks. Next time I'm down in Daejeon, buy me some Sungsimdang bread.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hey, Lee Sujin, it's me. It's been a while since I called.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh my, hello! How have you been? Good to hear your voice.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Very well. How's the weather in Jeju these days? It's turned chilly here in Seoul morning and evening.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's cooled off here too. It's still lovely for walking during the day, though.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, right — I just called because I wanted to hear your voice after so long. And I was curious what you've been up to.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I've been climbing one of the oreum every weekend. It's nothing much, but it's surprisingly good exercise.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, really? I've started swimming again, you know. I used to hate it, but these days being in the water puts my mind at ease.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You're a good swimmer, aren't you — didn't you compete once?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, competitions, hardly. I just do a bit of freestyle at the local pool. But doesn't climbing the oreum bother your knees?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I worried about that too, but going up slowly with poles it's fine. It helps with my blood sugar as well.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's good. Next time I visit Jeju let's climb an oreum together — we'll plan it out at our own pace.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, please! I'll pick a route with good weather for when you come.

turns.speaker: Coworker

turns.text: Yeah, same as ever. Still living with my father. What have you been up to?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: I've actually been looking into beauty certificate schools, but the enrolment fee is a bit of a burden. Is this a good time to talk?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, it's fine, go ahead. What certificate, out of the blue?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: I'm thinking of training as a skincare specialist. The tuition is a lump sum, so... I wondered if you could lend me some.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hmm... how much do you need? Just to check, though, let me see your face — shall we switch to video?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, go ahead, one moment.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's you. It's been a while. Hey, what was your nickname on our club MT back then?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Me? It was 'Bupyeong Beauty Queen' — you're the one who came up with it, haha.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, that's right, that's right. All right, it's not urgent, so take your time and tell me exactly how much you need.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: About 500,000 won should do it. Thank you so much.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Got it. You're still using the same account I sent you pocket money to before, right? I'll send it there.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, that's right, the same account. Thank you so much.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure. Look into the school properly, and let me know when you start. Let's get a meal sometime.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hello, it's me.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, Gu Dayeon. What's up at this hour?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I was just bored. How's your shoulder these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that — so-so. It's got a bit better with the hospital visits. Isn't work very hard for you these days, Dayeon?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: There's a lot to inspect so it does wear me out, but these days I live for watching dramas after work.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, what are you watching? I've got nothing much to do in the evenings either, so I just leave the TV on.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: You know that dating variety show, I Am Solo? I'm completely hooked on it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I've heard the name — that's the one with ordinary people on it, right?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's right, that's right, ordinary people dating, and it's surprisingly gripping. You should watch it too, I think you'd enjoy it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah? I should put it on one evening. How many episodes are there, though?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: It's been running several seasons, so there are loads. But it's still good even if you don't start from the beginning.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Then I'll just put on any episode and give it a go. Anyway, are you actually resting properly at home these days?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, more or less — I rest at weekends. Watching TV quietly on my own is the most relaxing thing.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Good, you need at least that much rest. Let's get a meal next week.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, lovely! See you then. Take care.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, good work today.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's Yun Huiwon. Can you hear me all right? How have you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? Oh, I can't hear you very well. But you... do you remember the name of that daycare centre we volunteered at together last time?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Ah, Eunbit Daycare! It was absolutely freezing the day we went to do the teaching volunteer work

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's right, that's it — now I can hear your voice clearly. It's been a while. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: I'm still doing the home-visit tutoring. I've been a bit busy preparing for the childcare teacher exam, but I'm fine.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, you're going for the childcare teacher qualification — that's impressive. Me, same as always, work and home.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Actually, though, I called because I've got a favour to ask. The exam registration fee and textbook costs came up short all of a sudden.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? How much do you need?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Um... about 200,000 won. I'll pay you back as soon as I get next month's pay.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's not urgent, so take your time with it — don't feel any pressure.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Thank you. Although I do have to register by the end of this week, so I need to move fairly soon...

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Then shall we switch to video and talk face to face? It's been a while, and I'd like to see you anyway.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, lovely, I'll call you now!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, it's so good to see your face. So the account is the same one I used when I sent you the book money, right?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, that's right, that account is fine. Thank you so much.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure. Prepare well and make sure you pass. Let's get a meal sometime.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's me, Jeon Minsu. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, what's the occasion, it's been a while. Doing all right?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, I've been flat out with the site work. How about you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Me, I'm job hunting so I'm just getting on with it. Hearing your voice reminds me — what was our study group called back then?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Ah, wasn't that 'Safety First'? You're the one who named it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's right, that's it. Good memory.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Anyway, I'm preparing for the industrial safety engineer certificate at the moment, and I wondered if I could borrow those written-exam notes you put together back then.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, I've got those. Hang on, I'll photograph them and send them over.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, please, photos are fine.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: There you go, that's the written-exam summary. Are the photos clear enough?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, they're clear. If you give me your account number I'll send you the copying and postage costs.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, I'll text you the account number. It's not urgent, so send it whenever.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Understood. I'll send it sometime today.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Take your time. Just focus on the exam prep.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, thank you. I'll buy you a meal next time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sounds good. Do well on the exam.

victim_persona.occupation: Other craft and related trades workers

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello? Er, who's this? It's a number I don't know.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's me, it's me. My phone screen broke so I bought a new one, and the number changed too, so it looks unfamiliar, right?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, the voice sounds right... but is it really you? Do you remember the name of that LP shop in Cheonggyecheon we used to go to together?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That was Jongno Records — the time you bought a record and then ran off to avoid paying for the meal, haha.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hey, that's right, it's you. It's been a while hearing your voice. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Getting by. Nothing much going on apart from my back being bad and going to the hospital for it. How's your health? Isn't the distribution work hard?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as ever for me, though I have been doing a bit of walking lately. So what's the occasion for the call, after all this time?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, that's the thing — my son's getting married. There's a deposit for the venue that's come up, so I've got a favour to ask.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Well, that's cause for congratulations. So how much do you need for the deposit?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: About 1,000,000 won would do it, and it's not urgent — I'll pay you back as soon as next month's pay comes in.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, that much you can take your time paying back. Is the account still the same one you used when I lent to you before?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, that's right, I'm still using that account, it hasn't changed.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, doing this on voice alone feels a bit odd — shall we switch to video and talk face to face?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yeah, good idea, let's switch to video. It's been a while since I've seen your face anyway, so that works out.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, hang on, I'll call now. I'll check and send it this evening.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thanks, really. I'll be in touch once the wedding date is set. Stay well.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hey, Kim Donggeon, it's me. Is this a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's fine. It's been a while. You must be busy on site these days?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Don't ask, the weather has me all over the place. Anyway, are the kids doing well? Are you looking after your health?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, more or less. You didn't call about anything urgent, did you?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: No, no, nothing urgent at all. I was watching TV this evening and a programme about the army was on, so you came to mind and I called

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that survival show? I watch that too, it's good

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Right? So where did you do your service? I wondered if you'd been somewhere specialised, being a train driver

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: No, just regular infantry. How about you?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Me, I was in the engineers. Did an awful lot of digging back then. Looking back I wonder whether that was all just building me up

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, I thought that a lot during basic training too. Watching TV, though, the army seems to have got much better for young people these days

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Exactly, all sorts of things in the PX, and they use mobile phones. Completely different from our day

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True. I am curious what the army will be like when my kids grow up

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Same here. Anyway, as long as nothing's wrong, that's what matters — it's good to hear your voice

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, and you look after yourself. Let's get a meal sometime when you're free

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Let's do that. Take care

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello, Sohyeon, how are you keeping?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, hello, it's been a while. I'm doing well.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Is work manageable these days? Isn't the counselling job hard?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: It's all right — it's busy, but I've got used to it. How about you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Me, just getting by. I've been doing a bit of writing here and there.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, that's nice. No need to rush it, just take your time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly. Oh, and I've got into chrysanthemum tea lately.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Chrysanthemum tea? The one with the lovely scent?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, that's it. It's subtle, and drinking it settles my mind a bit.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I've been drinking grapefruit tea lately. It's refreshing, good for waking yourself up.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's nice too — something tart really does snap you awake.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: It does. Let's have some together next time you visit — I'll buy some in.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, lovely. We'll take our time over it and have a proper catch-up.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, take care of yourself and I'll call again soon.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, Sohyeon. Stay well.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Hello, it's me, Lee Junyeol — from when we worked together at the restaurant in Hwaseong.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, Junyeol? Oh, I knew straight away from your voice. How are you?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: I'm doing well. But do you remember me? What was the nickname I used to call you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course I know that — you called me the coating lady. Because I smelled of paint.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: That's right, that's right, that was it. Thinking of it now makes me laugh.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It really does. Are you still doing bookkeeping? Are you eating properly?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, I'm still doing the restaurant's books. I keep putting on weight because of highballs, but what can you do.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, same for me — I just go for a drive listening to Lim Young-woong. So what did you call about today?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Well, my card bills have piled up a bit this month. It's not urgent, but I wondered if I could borrow 200,000 from you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I see... could you tell me again how much you need? Or if you're happy to, we could talk face to face.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, that's fine, I'll call you on video then.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it really is you, Junyeol — good to see your face. If it's not urgent, take your time telling me.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, it's not urgent, anytime this week is fine. Sorry to ask you this.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't be sorry, what for. You're still using the same account, right? I'll send it to the number I used last time.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, that's right, the same account. Thank you so much.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't mention it. Eat properly, and don't overdo the dieting. Let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, hello. Kim Jiyeong? It's me.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ah, yes, hello. How have you been? It's been a while since I heard your voice.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as ever, you know. How's the weather over in Haman these days?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: It's been raining a lot here lately, so I struggle every morning on the commute.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Didn't you drive?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Well, I skidded on a rainy day recently and had a bit of a fender bender. So I've been taking the bus.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Goodness, were you badly hurt?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: No, thankfully I'm fine, but the car took some damage. It's in for repairs.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Then don't rush to fix it, take your time — you can manage on the bus without a car, so there's no need to hurry.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's right, that's what I've been thinking. Taking the bus is actually easier on the mind.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I commute by subway, and apart from when it's crowded it's not bad at all.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: There's no subway here, so I'm envious. The buses do get crowded sometimes, but it's bearable.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Well, it's a relief it wasn't a serious accident. Do take care.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, thank you. I'll be in touch again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, travel safely. Take care.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, it's me. Can you talk?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, Gawon, what's up at this hour? Why do you sound so down?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Oh, it's nothing... something happened today. How's work going for you, Mum?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Same as ever for me. But has something happened to you? Your voice sounds odd.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Um... Mum, do you remember the name of our dog when I was little? I just suddenly wondered.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What's this, out of nowhere? It was Choco, Choco. Why are you asking that — this is you, isn't it?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, yes, it's me. There's a lot of dodgy phone calls in the news lately, so I was just checking. Anyway... I came off my bike today and had to go to the hospital.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What? Are you hurt? Is it bad?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: No, it's not that serious, just some grazes on my arm and knee. They did an X-ray and the bones are fine.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, thank goodness... So how much was the treatment?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's not urgent, but the out-of-pocket cost came to about 100,000 won, and with tuition fees going out this month I'm a bit tight. Could you help out a little?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Of course, I'll send it this evening. But go easier on that bike from now on.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I will, Mum, thank you. I'll be careful.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, look after yourself, and call me straight away if anything happens.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hello, it's Jo Sangmin — is this a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, it's fine, what's up?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I just wondered if everything was all right. How's your child settling in at school?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, they've settled in now. It was hard at first. How's work going for you?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: So-so. The paperwork in the marketing team has been piling up, which is a bit rough

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's right, I heard your team was busy

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, and about that — they're taking on someone part-time to review the documents, and I wondered if you could look them over when you have time

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, is it difficult? If it's just simple checking, I think I could do it

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: No, it's not difficult, just checking whether any fields are missing. And it's not urgent, so you can look at it whenever suits you

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that's a relief. I think I'll have time around next week — would then be all right?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Of course, absolutely fine. I'll tidy up the files and email them over

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Got it, I'll check them next week and get back to you

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Thank you. I'll be in touch again later

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, take care

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Oh, hello. It's Kim Jihun from HR — is this a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, yes. It's fine. What's this about?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Nothing much. Is the work on the factory side manageable these days? I heard the line was busy this week.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it was a bit hectic but it's settled down now. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Same as ever for me. Oh, but that gukbap place you mentioned at the last work dinner — what was it called? It's slipped my mind.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that place, the sundae gukbap place in front of the station. You had two bottles of soju that night.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: That's right, that's it. Haha, good memory. Anyway, I called because I need to ask you for the working-hours data for this month's new part-timers.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, for the payroll? How many are there?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: About five. Just tidy up their clock-in and clock-out times and pass it over in Excel. It's not urgent, so anytime this week is fine.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Understood. I'll check and put it together tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Thanks. And if anything looks odd in the data, ask me straight away.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Will do. Was there anything else?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: No, that's all. You've been working hard lately — make sure you eat properly.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You too. I'll email it over as soon as it's ready.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: All right, take care.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, take care.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Hey, it's me, Lee Jongha — the one who works with you at the bar.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? Why's this number so unfamiliar, is this really yours?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Ah, that — my phone screen broke so I've moved the SIM into another one for now. You bought me whisky for my birthday last time, remember that?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's right, I got you that Laphroaig. It really is you — I can tell from your voice.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: How have you been? Are you still going out taking photos?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, I go out most weekends, though work's been busy lately. How about you, are there many customers in Jeju these days?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: So-so. Tourist numbers have dropped a bit. Anyway, you know I covered two shifts for you a while back?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, right, that — I'd completely forgotten. How much was it?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: About 150,000 won, and it's not urgent, so send it whenever suits you around next week.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: No, I'll check and send it right now. It's the same account as before, right? The Nonghyup one I used to pay into.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, that's right, that account is fine. Oh, and by the way, I'm taking leave next month and coming over to the mainland.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, good. Give me a call when you're here and we'll get a meal.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, see you then, haha.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You haven't changed a bit. Anyway, I'll send it this evening.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Thank you. Next time you're in Jeju, drinks are on me.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, I'll come and visit soon. Take care.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Hello, is this... is this Kim Hyejin? I used to work part-time with you over in Mulgeum — I'm not sure whether you'd remember me

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? The voice does sound familiar... are you the one I used to share cup noodles with on those night shifts?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: That's right, that's me — I was always grumbling that there was no kimchi, and you'd bring some from home

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, now I remember, it really is lovely to hear from you. So what's the occasion for the call?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: You just suddenly came to mind. How have you been? Are you still doing the coating work?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, still working there. My arm aches a bit, but I'm plugging along. How about you, still in the civil service?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, I'm still doing office work in Mulgeum New Town. Got to earn the kids' tuition, haha

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You work so hard. Is something up, though? Calling out of the blue like this

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Well, the thing is, a short-term part-time position has come up here in Mulgeum, and you came to mind. It's a few hours at weekends inspecting goods, and the hourly rate is decent

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, but I live in Gyeonggi — wouldn't it be a bit far to come all that way?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Ah, that's right, you're in a different region, I'd forgotten. It's not urgent, I was only asking in case you knew someone nearby you could refer

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, if that's it, I'll ask around. Some of the people I work with might be looking for weekend work

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Thank you, really. Just get in touch whenever suits, once you've asked around

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, yes, I'll ask and let you know. It's lovely to hear your voice after so long

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Same here. Let's get a meal sometime when we're both free. I'll wait to hear from you

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, take care!

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Hey, it's me, it's me. My voice is a bit hoarse, isn't it? I've caught a cold.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? Ah, your voice sounded odd so I wondered who it was. But this is Kim Byeongnam from Jinhae, isn't it? The one who was talking about saunas last time.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: That's right, that's me. We had that bet last time, didn't we, about buying coffee. You remember that?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's right, you still haven't paid up. But your cold really does sound bad — are you all right?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: I'm fine, it's the change of season, everyone's the same. My mother's a bit unwell too, so that's on my mind.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I hope she gets better. My parents' health has been up and down lately too, so I worry.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Exactly, we've both got to look after our parents. Anyway, the reason I called — my nephew has started university and wants to earn some pocket money, so I wondered if there were any part-time openings on the study-materials side.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Our side is teacher recruitment so it's a bit different, but they do sometimes hire for office support or delivery.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Oh, there's that sort of thing? It's not urgent — he's looking to do it in the holidays after this semester, so take your time looking into it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll ask the branch manager this weekend and get back to you.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Thanks, really. It's fine if it works out and fine if it doesn't, so no pressure.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Understood, I'll ask around and get back to you within this week.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: All right, take care, and give my regards to your parents.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, mind that cold, and I'll be collecting that coffee next time.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, long time no see — how are you keeping?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. Getting by, you know. Are things busy on site over your way?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Don't ask, the weather's made the work come and go. How's the job hunting going for you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: No real news yet, but I'm hanging in there for the kids. Nothing to rush about — I'm looking around at my own pace.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, right, rushing won't make it happen. Oh, did you hear? You know Taeseok, the one who used to knock about with us — apparently he's getting remarried.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Really? He's only just divorced. Already?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's what I said. You never can tell with these things. Do you remember when we got married? Everyone thought we'd end up lifelong bachelors.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, right, I was the MC at your wedding. My hands were shaking so badly I could hardly hold the mic.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Haha, I still remember that. Those were good days, though — none of us knew anything and we just got on with it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Looking back, raising kids feels harder. Dating might have been the easiest time of all.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's true. Still, having a wife and kids is what gives life its flavour.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It is, you're right. Anyway, if Taeseok has a wedding, let's see each other there.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Sure, I'll call once the date's set. Good luck with the job hunt, and take care.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, you be careful on site too. Let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Hey, it's me. Yun Dongjin. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? Your voice sounds a bit unfamiliar... you always used to buy me something from the school shop back then — do you remember what it was?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Ah, that was the triangle kimbap — you always bought me the tuna mayo one

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's it, that's it. It really has been a while. How are things, are you doing all right?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Just getting by. Are you doing all right in Incheon? How's the job hunting?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Me, I'm plugging away studying for a certificate. What have you been up to?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: I've been thinking of learning something myself, but nothing's felt right, so I've been mulling it over. Then you came to mind, so I called

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Why, what's up?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: You said you were studying for a logistics certificate. I was thinking of going for it too, but I don't know where to start

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that? If it's not urgent we can take our time — I've got materials tidied up somewhere

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Really? Then I can ask without feeling bad about it. Could you share those materials with me?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, I've got a summary I put together, I'll email it later. Don't overthink it, just go through it slowly

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Thanks, that'll be a huge help. Now I feel like I'm actually preparing for something

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Good, keep at it. Call again if you've got questions

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yeah, let's get a meal sometime soon. Take care

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Hello, it's me. This is Gang Dongcheol, isn't it?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, that's right, and you are...?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: It's Lee Seongmin — I was on the care team with you at the hospital. Do you remember taking a patient's family member out for a walk and having a coffee with me?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's right, you got me a coffee from the vending machine. It's coming back to me now.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: That's the one, haha. How have you been? How's the weather in Suncheon?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's turned a bit chilly here. Not yet over your way?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: It's getting colder here too, and my knee's been aching so I've been going to the hospital.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't overdo it — care work is so physical.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: That's actually why I called. I've got a hospital appointment next Tuesday, so I wondered if you could swap shifts with me that day.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I'd have to look at my schedule for that. If it's not urgent, could I check and get back to you tomorrow?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, take your time looking into it. I booked the appointment with plenty of leeway anyway.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Understood, I'll check and get back to you right away.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Thank you. My knee's playing up, so I should get some rest now.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, good luck at the hospital, and I'll be in touch. Take care.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ah, Director, it's me. Is this a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, Bak Hongseok, it's been a while. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, getting by well enough. The weather's turned a bit chilly in Sejong. How is it over in Gyeonggi?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same here. Chilly morning and evening. How's your health — didn't you say your back was bad before?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ah, that — it's much better since I've been going to the hospital. It's you who should be looking after your health, though. I hear you've been very busy.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Busy, yes, but that's how it goes. It's nothing urgent, so let's take our time — it's been a while.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Haha, let's do that. Actually, the thing is, I've been having a headache over the training for the new sales staff. I called to ask about that on-site training approach you used to run.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that? That's an old story. Back then we'd take the new lot straight out into the field, no question. If you did that with young people these days they'd all run off.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's true, they really do hate that sort of thing these days. And yet when you actually put them to it they hold up surprisingly well — you never can tell.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: What I learned working part-time on construction sites while I was at university actually became the foundation for where I am now. That sort of experience turns out to be surprisingly useful.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: So you had those days too. I did a lot of moving furniture out of studio flats, and the knack I picked up then still comes in handy on sales calls.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, right — meeting people and getting stuck in physically all becomes an asset in the end. Try telling the new lot that.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, I should give it a go. Talking to you has helped me sort my thoughts. Next time you're in Sejong, buy me a meal.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, I'll make time and drop by. Look after yourself, and let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, and you take care of your health. Take care!

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's me, Lee Soyeong. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. Hearing your voice brings it back — you're the one who practically lived in the library at university, right?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: That's right, I used to stay up all night preparing for editing society seminars. I remember you buying me coffee, too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, I did, I did. How are things now, is work manageable?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: So-so. There's a lot of copy at the moment so it's hectic, but it's work I love, so I can handle it. How's work for you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just getting through one day at a time. The kids keep me going. So what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Well, the thing is, I want to take an editing certificate course but the fee is a bit of a burden. I wondered if I could borrow a little from you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? How much do you need?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: About 300,000 won. I'll pay you back as soon as I get next month's pay.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That much, well — it's not urgent, so take your time thinking it through. I'll check my account this weekend and let you know.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, thank you. Just tell me whenever suits.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, let's talk again next week. Even preparing for a certificate costs money, doesn't it. Keep at it.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, and you look after your health. I'll be in touch next week. Thank you!

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, Yeongho, it's me. How are you keeping?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. I'm doing all right, though there's a fair bit of work on at the moment.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, I heard there's a lot of work over in Ansan. Have the kids grown? Is your eldest at school now?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, fourth year of primary now. How about yours? Your second is still little, right?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, still at nursery. Actually, I haven't been feeling great lately so I went for a health check-up.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, nothing serious? You need to look after yourself.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly. Anyway, that aside — the plumbing in my parents' bathroom seems to be leaking a bit.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Where's it leaking from, the sink or the toilet?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I'm not sure, but the floor's a bit damp. It's not urgent, but I wondered if you could take a look when you've got time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, if it's not urgent, how about next Saturday? I've got some time then.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, perfect. Come whenever, no pressure.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, got it, I'll bring my tools. The address is still the same one I know, ●● District, ●● Neighbourhood?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yeah, still the same. Thanks, really. I owe you a meal at least.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: No, don't be daft, we're mates. See you Saturday, then.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Hello, is this Han Seonghui? It's Bak Jihun from the materials team.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh my, yes, that's right — the number was unfamiliar so I wondered who it was.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Ah, I changed phones, haha. You remember me, don't you — the one who burned the pork belly at the company outing last month.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's right, it went completely black, everyone was in stitches. I know you now — how have you been?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, I'm doing well. How about you? Still busy with the drafting work?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: So-so. Anyway, what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Well, I've taken over as treasurer for settling up the rest of the last work dinner, and there's a bit outstanding on your side, so I got in touch.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's right, I forgot about that. How much was it?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: 35,000 won, and it's not urgent, so you can send it whenever suits you later.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: No, I'll send it right now. Is the account the same one as last time?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, that's right, I'm still using the same account we collected the outing fees in.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that one, understood. Could you read out the account number again?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, one moment, I'll read it out.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, got it, I've written it down. I'll send it right away.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, thank you, and there's no rush. I'll see you at work next week, then.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, yes, see you then. Take care!

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hello, Sujin, it's me. How are you keeping?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, hello! I'm doing well. It's been a while. How's the factory work these days?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Same as ever. But the weather's turned suddenly cold, hasn't it — is it not like that in Jeju?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's got windy here all of a sudden too, so it's turned chilly. It does seem to arrive a bit later than on the mainland, though.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Right, Jeju is warm to begin with. Here it's already cold morning and evening.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It is. The temperature swings are so big lately it's perfect weather for catching a cold. How's your health?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Me, getting by. Though my throat's been a bit scratchy, probably the change of season. Are you keeping your blood sugar under control, Sujin?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I try, but when I'm stressed it slips. I do keep up the walking, at least.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Good for you. I've brought in a few new houseplants, and now it's getting cold, even watering them is something to think about.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, you do love your plants. You'll have to bring them indoors for winter.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I should. It's not urgent though, so I'll watch the weather a bit longer and move them slowly.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That sounds best. I've been living for weekend walks round the neighbourhood looking at the autumn leaves.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Lovely. The autumn leaves must be beautiful in Jeju. I'd love to come and visit, do a city tour while I'm at it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: If you come I'll show you around. Do come when the weather's good.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I will. Look after yourself, and let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, and you watch out for colds. I'll be in touch again.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Hello! It's me, Jang Geonuk. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? Jang Geonuk! It's been a while — what's the occasion, you calling and all.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: You just came to mind, haha. I'm doing well, learning the refractory trade down in Gwangyang. How about you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Me, just going to the gym and waiting for snowboard season. You sound a bit hesitant, though — is something up?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Does it show? Actually, I'm preparing for the craftsman certificate exam and I'm a bit short on the course fee.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's what it was. How much do you need?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: About 200,000 won. But it feels a bit off saying it over the phone — could we do a video call and talk face to face?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, that's better. Let's switch to video.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Do you remember me? Back in the football club, you gave me a nickname.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, that? 'Sheer Presence', wasn't it — you really did score a lot back then.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: That's right, remembering it made me laugh. Oh, and it's not urgent, so there's no rush sending it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, could you read out the account number?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, that's right, that same account is fine.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Got it, I'll send it sometime today. Prepare well for the exam.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Thank you! I'll buy you a meal once I've got the certificate.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, good luck, and stay in touch.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Hello, Ji Byeonggon? It's me — Ji Byeonggon, the one who worked with you in Incheon. It's good to hear your voice.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Well, look who it is, it's been a while. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, getting by. Do you still grow hydrangeas in the yard? I remembered the photos you sent me before.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Heh, you still remember that. Yes, I've still got hydrangeas planted in the yard and I enjoy looking at them.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: I thought as much. How's work these days — the track work must be hard?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's all right, manageable. So what did you call about today?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Ah, the thing is, we need to settle up the part-timers' wages at our plant but the company account is tied up for a few days. I called to ask whether you could help me out.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah? How much do you need.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: About 500,000 won would do it, and it's not urgent, so send it whenever suits you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hmm... all right, understood. Could you read out the account number?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, thank you. I'll text you the account number right away.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right — it's been a while, shall we do a video call and see each other?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Of course, I've been wanting to see your face too. I'll hang up and call back on video.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, I'll be waiting.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Thank you, Ji Byeonggon. I'll be in touch when I pay you back. Keep well.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, let's talk again. Take care.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Hey, Yun Taeyeong, it's me. From the factory.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, hello! What's the occasion, at this hour.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: How are you keeping? I haven't seen you at all lately. Is your mother well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, everyone's fine. Are you still doing the balcony vegetable patch?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: The lettuce is coming along beautifully these days. Actually, I called because I've got a favour to ask.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hang on, though, let me just check it's really you. What song did you sing at karaoke after the last work dinner?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Ah, that — I sang a Tae Jin-a song. The one the kimchi factory boss made me do an encore of.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's it, that's it. Sorry for checking. So what's the favour?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: We're doing a group order for work clothes, and my card app has gone funny so the payment won't go through. It's not urgent, but could you lend me the money for a few days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, you've checked out, so that's fine. Still, if you don't mind, could we do a quick video call so I can see your face once more?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Sure, no problem. I'll call on video.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, that's you all right. Understood, I'll send it over.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Right, it's not urgent, anytime this week is fine.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Then I just send it to the same bank account I sent to before, yes?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: That's right, that same account. Thank you, I'll pay you back within the week.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll send it in my own time. See you next time.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Thank you. Give my regards to your mother.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, it's me, it's me. Byeongjun. My voice sounds a bit odd, doesn't it? My phone screen broke so I had to change my number in a hurry.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? The number was so unfamiliar I nearly didn't pick up. Is it really you? Do you remember the name of the restaurant we went to together at my daughter's wedding?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That was Byeongjun Galbi, wasn't it — I was introduced to your daughter's in-laws there. Don't you remember?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's right, that's right, the galbi there was genuinely good. It's been a while hearing your voice. Are you doing all right?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same as ever. The Hwaseong plant has been busy lately so I'm all over the place. How's the work going at the Suncheon site?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as always for me. Watching the kids grow makes me realise how fast time goes. So what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, that's the thing — my daughter's wedding date has been set. But the venue deposit has been brought forward, so I need the money a bit sooner than expected.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that's something to celebrate. So how much do you need?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: If you could lend me about 1,000,000 won, I'll pay you back as soon as next month's pay comes in. It's not urgent, so send it whenever suits you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, but with your number having changed and all, shall we do a video call? Talking face to face would set my mind at ease.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Sure, good idea. Let's do video, that way you'll feel reassured too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, it really is you — the voice too. So is your old account still the same? Should I send it there?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, that's right, I'm still using that account. If today doesn't work, tomorrow is fine.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Got it, I'll send it this evening. I hope the wedding preparations go well, and do send me an invitation.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thanks, really. I won't forget to pay you back. Next time I'm down in Suncheon, I'll buy you a meal.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, see you then. Take care.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Hello, good afternoon. Is this Kim Yeonga?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it is. Who's this? The number's unfamiliar.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: It's Bak Jeongsu — I worked with you at the Pyeongchang site, on the heating and cooling side. I'm not sure whether you'd remember.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, back then, the one... who handed out cup noodles at the site in winter, right? I remember now, hearing your voice.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: That's right, haha, it's been a long time. How have you been? Are you still on the cranes?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, still here in Pyeongchang. I heard you'd moved down to Jeju — is the work manageable?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, I came down to take on a project in Jeju. Actually, I've got a materials payment to make and the company's settlement is running a few days late. I called because I've got a favour to ask.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I see. How much do you need?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Not a lot, about 300,000 won, and it's not urgent, so send it whenever you have the room.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Then shall I send it to the account we used to collect the dinner money in back then?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, that's right, I still use that account.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll send it to that account then.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Thank you, I'll pay you back as soon as it's settled. And let's see each other sometime when you're free.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, let's. I'll check things over and send it in my own time. Do take care.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Hello, is this Han Munjung? My number's changed, so I'm calling from this one.

turns.speaker: Self
