turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as ever. So what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Well, the thing is, I've been thinking of getting a wet wipes subscription for the house where I look after the child. Have you ever done that sort of thing?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I have, I've tried a few. Where are you looking?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I've just been searching online, but the payment comes out automatically every month. Isn't that a bit worrying?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: With the bigger ones the card company sends you alerts and cancelling is easy, so it's fine. Compare the price and delivery cost at a few places and decide at your own pace.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, I see. I should look a bit more, then. How much is delivery usually?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Some places are free above a certain amount, otherwise it's around two or three thousand won.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I see. Can I look at a few more and ask you again?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course, there's no rush. Pick one and send me the link and I'll have a look too.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thanks, I'm glad I asked. I'll be in touch again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, take your time looking and get in touch. Let's see each other next week.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's me, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while! I'm doing well. How's work these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same as every day. Handling the fishing village co-op business and so on. How about you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same here. I've been busy lately and all over the place. Today's a bit quieter, though.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's good. It's not urgent, I just called because you came to mind.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: What is it?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: There's an exhibition on here in Jeju at the moment and it's really good. I'll send you some photos.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, what is it? What's the theme?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It captures the lives of the Jeju haenyeo in photographs and video. They've put it together far better than I expected.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Wow, that sounds interesting. I saw something similar over in Gyeonggi — an exhibition on the history of machinery. Old machines all gathered together.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, that's right up your field. Was it good?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, genuinely fascinating. There were models of old excavators and things. Go if you get the chance.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I should. I've been wanting to go and see things like that whenever I get some breathing room.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Do. Let's go and see something together next time you're in Seoul.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Let's, I'll get in touch when the timing works. It's been nice talking today.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, let's talk again. Take care!

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, yes, son. You said work was busy — are you all right?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Getting by. But how's your knee these days, Dad? You said you were going to the hospital.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, that — after a few physiotherapy sessions it's much better. Don't worry. Your voice sounds off, though. Has something happened?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, actually I hurt my wrist at work a few days ago, and the hospital said I've stretched a ligament. It doesn't need surgery, but the treatment cost came to a bit.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What? Your wrist? How did... is it bad? Hang on, is that really you, son? Your voice sounds a bit unfamiliar.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's me, Dad. Remember at the holidays when we went to the head family's house and I went fishing with my cousin? You laughed because I let a fish get away.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, that's right, you let a really big one go and you were gutted. Now I can tell from your voice. So how much do you need?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 800,000 won. It's not urgent, as long as it's sorted within this week.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, understood. So I use the same account you gave me before, yes? The bankbook I used to send the holiday money to.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, that same account. Dad, if you're unsure shall I show you the screen on a video call?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, let's see it on video. That's more certain.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, one moment, I'll call now.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, take your time looking at it, don't fuss. Mind that wrist and eat properly.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, and you mind that knee, Dad. Thank you for helping. I'll come down and see you soon.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, oh, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just now. How about you? Have you finished work?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, just finished and on my way home. While I was cleaning today I saw a cat in front of the building, and it was really gentle

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? There are a lot of stray cats around buildings these days

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, so it's not urgent, but I've been wondering whether to put some food out for it

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Think it over at your own pace, there's no rush. You've always liked animals

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, I kept a dog when I was little — maybe that's what brought it to mind

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: My kids keep going on about getting a dog, but I'm a bit worried

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: What are you worried about? Taking it for walks and so on sounds nice

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's that my health isn't good, so I'm not confident I could walk it

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, I see. How's your health these days? Are you going to the hospital?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just regular check-ups. Nothing major

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's a relief. Don't overdo things

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: And you don't overdo the cat feeding either — only when you've got the room

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, all right. Let's talk again, take care

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, get home safe

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hey, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just now. How about you?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I've eaten, but my digestion hasn't been good lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Are you unwell somewhere? You have been looking a bit tired lately.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: No, nothing urgent, I think it's just age making everything creak.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, go to the hospital when you get the time.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I know. My back's been off too, and my stomach feels bloated.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: My back's stiff as well, probably from sitting so much these days.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: You're young, so you're better off. I really do need to look after myself.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: At least you relieve some stress watching the UFC.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: If I didn't have that I'd have gone mad, haha.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, don't put off the health check-up — go when you have the time.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: All right, I'll go when I can. Thanks for calling, take care.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, look after yourself and I'll be in touch again.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's been a while, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it has. Just getting by. How about you?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same here. Is work going all right?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, ticking along fine. It's logistics, so the volume's been up lately and it's hectic.

turns.text: The overtime isn't too bad though, is it?

turns.text: Don't get me started, I've taken on a project so it's constant overtime. Anyway, nothing urgent, I just called to catch up.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, take your time. How's your health? You said your back was hurting before.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, that's better now. I've been doing some exercise. Though it flares up again when I sit coding.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It does seem to be the same for all developers. I'm office-based too, so sitting for hours leaves my neck stiff.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: We both need to look after ourselves, haha. Let's go exercise together when we get the time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sounds good, I've been needing that. Let's line up our schedules around next week.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Okay, let's get a meal soon and talk it over. Get in touch whenever suits.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, I'll be in touch when the timing works. It was good to hear from you today.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yeah, take care and see you soon!

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, it's me. Yeah, the number's a bit unfamiliar — I got a new phone so the number changed too.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Huh? This really is an unfamiliar number. Hang on, tell me what your nickname was as a child.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Haha, what's this all of a sudden. It's 'Peanut' — you called me that in primary school because I was short.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: That's right, it is my son. The voice too. Are you eating properly?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I practically live at the workshop these days so it's a bit poor, but I do eat.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: You're still going to that workshop in Songdo, yes? It's chilly lately, so wrap up warm.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, yes, I do. Anyway, Mum, I called because I've got something to discuss.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, what is it? Go ahead.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: How much do you need? Talking on the phone alone is a bit frustrating, though — let's switch to video and talk face to face.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, good idea, hang on, I'll call again.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, I can see you now. You look well. So roughly how much is it?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 800,000 should do it. It's not urgent though, so take your time thinking it over before you decide.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, could you read out the account number? Or you could text it to me again.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I'll text you the account. Thanks, Mum, and don't feel pressured, send it whenever it suits.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Understood, I'll go to the bank tomorrow and send it. Eat properly and don't wear yourself out.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, thanks, Mum. I'll call again, bye.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, it's me. Is this a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's fine. Have you finished your runs for today?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, I've just handed the vehicle back and come in. How's work for you these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as ever. Okcheon's quiet, nothing much going on

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's good. Anyway, do you still play that puzzle game?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that? I still play a bit before bed. Why, have you started one too?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I've got into a new racing game lately. Maybe it's because driving is my job, but I find it fun

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, that figures. Driving all day and then driving in a game too?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I know, but strangely it relieves the stress. It has real road courses in it too, which is fun

turns.speaker: Self

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: It's perfect for playing with children. I'll send you a link later — it's not urgent, so look at it whenever

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Thanks. I'll keep telling you about that puzzle game I used to play too, try it when you've got time

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, lovely. Anyway, how's your health these days? I think I heard your back was giving you trouble before

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, much better now. Thanks for asking

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's a relief. I'll be in touch again, then

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, take care out there, and let's talk again

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Hello, it's me. My voice must sound a bit unfamiliar?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? Who is this? The number's unfamiliar.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's me, the junior from Ansan, the one who did the study group with you last year. I changed phones so my number's different.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's right — but what certificate did you say you were preparing for back then? I can't remember.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: The electrical craftsman certificate. We messaged all night about that back then too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's it, and now I hear your voice it's definitely you. It's been a while — how have you been?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yeah, getting by. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Me, living the unemployed life in Gangneung. Are you still preparing for the certificate?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, I'm going to have another go at the electrical craftsman one. That's why I called, actually — you know those written-exam notes you put together back then.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, those? I've got them, and some scans too. They'd need a bit of tidying up, though.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Could you possibly send them to me? I don't want to impose, so I feel a bit awkward asking.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's fine, it's not urgent, I'll dig them out and send them in my own time. Bear with me if it takes a few days.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, hearing you say that puts me at ease. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, I'll send them on KakaoTalk as soon as I find them. Prepare well for the exam.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, thank you. I'll buy you a meal next time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sounds good. Take care and stay in touch.

turns.text: I'm looking at my own pace, there's no rush. More to the point, I'm planning to come down to Daejeon next month

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? How are you coming?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: By train — the KTX only takes an hour

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's right. But isn't it hard to book KTX tickets these days? Especially at weekends

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: It is, so I'll go on a weekday. I haven't fixed a date yet but I'll tell you in advance once I do — there's no rush deciding

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll come and meet you at the station when you arrive

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: No, Mum, don't come out, I can just get the bus to the house

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: The buses are a bit infrequent, but they are convenient

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, it's fine. I'll be in touch again once the date's set

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, love, take care and let's talk again

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, hey, what are you up to

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same as ever. Work's been a bit busy lately

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh dear, are you keeping well? You've always had that bad back

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, it still hurts now and then. But watching the baseball with a drink is my one pleasure and I can't give it up

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, I knew it. For me the best thing is just resting after work these days

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, at our age resting is the most important thing. Anyway, is something up, that you called?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: No, nothing much — the whole family is getting together this weekend and I wanted to tell you

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, for the first time in a while? That'll be lovely, everyone together

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's been a while, the kids are coming too. It's a bit chaotic but it is nice

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I'm genuinely envious. My family are all so busy we only gather at the holidays

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly, you've got to see each other while you can. Later on you might not get the chance

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's true. I should get the family together for a meal this weekend too if I've got time

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, that's a good idea. Let's talk again

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yeah, take care of yourself

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You too. Bye now

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, it's me. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. I'm doing all right, apart from my back being a bit stiff.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: What's up with your back, did you twist it at work?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Maybe it's from years on the forklift, my whole body just aches. Are you keeping up your walks?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, I go out every morning. Anyway, did you see the news? About that elderly driver accident yesterday

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I saw it, I saw it. In front of the supermarket, right? They said he mixed up the accelerator and the brake at that age

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly, it was genuinely frightening. I'm nearly sixty myself, so it doesn't feel like someone else's problem

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just out of curiosity — there's talk about older people surrendering their licences. What do you make of that?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Well, wouldn't that be hard for people living out in the country? Without a car you can't even get to the hospital

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's true. Still, apparently they're bringing in a system where you get tested and renew — I think that's reasonable

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, that's better than an outright surrender. Anyway, you be careful when you're driving too

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I will. Good talking today, let's speak again

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, take care and I'll be in touch

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's been a while, how have you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it has, I'm doing well. How about you, is the job hunting going all right?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Same as ever. I've been passing the time studying for certificates

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, which certificate?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Computer proficiency, and I've got an online course going too

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: An online course? Is it any good? I've been thinking of learning something myself

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It works for me — I can use my time freely, so it suits me

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: The company's told me to get a certificate, so I'm learning CAD

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: CAD? Isn't that difficult?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It confused me at first, but you get the hang of it. Are you doing your certificate at a school, or on your own?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Not a school, just online lectures and a workbook on my own

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That must be hard in its own way. It's not always easy to concentrate on your own

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: True, but if I make a plan it works out reasonably well

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You're doing well. Don't overdo it, take it at your own pace

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, I will. And good luck with your CAD certificate

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, let's be in touch again. Take care

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's me, what are you up to?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, hello. I've finished work and I'm having a rest. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, I grabbed something after the cleaning. Were you out plastering again today?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it was a tough site today so I'm aching a bit. It's not urgent, so let's take our time — did you have something to tell me?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: No, nothing important, but I was watching the news today and something big has kicked off in Europe

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Where? I caught a bit of it earlier, which country was it

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: France, I think, there've been huge protests. People are very angry about pension reform or something

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, the backlash against raising the age? I saw that on the news. They seem to protest an awful lot over there

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly. We have plenty of protests here too but it's even more over there. And apparently people have been hurt

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: People getting hurt isn't good. However angry you are, I wonder whether it's worth people getting injured

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly, that's what I thought too. Anyway, the world is a noisy place

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It is. Let's just get on with our own lives, haha

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, right. Anyway, you must be tired, go and rest — I'll hang up now

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, you get a good rest too. Let's talk again

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, it's me, have you got a minute?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, yes. What's the occasion at this hour. Your voice sounds odd — has something happened?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, the thing is, I had a fender bender on the way back from my class today. But I'm not hurt, so don't worry.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What? An accident? Oh dear, you must have had a fright. Are you really all right?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, honestly, it's just a scratched bumper. But Mum, just to check — do you remember my nickname at kindergarten?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Of course I do, we called you Mandu because of your chubby cheeks. Why are you asking that all of a sudden?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I just asked because it was so nice hearing your voice, haha. Anyway, to the point — the insurance covers it but there's an excess, and that's why I called.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, is that so? How much is it? Is it urgent?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 200,000 won, and it's not urgent. It only needs sorting within this week, so you can think it over.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, I'll talk to your father this evening and send it. 200,000 isn't a great burden, so don't worry.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Thanks, Mum. Use the same account as before.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Understood. Did things go all right with the other driver? No arguments or anything?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: No, we were both polite and agreed to handle it through the insurers. Nothing to worry about.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: That's a relief. You must have had a shock — get some rest today.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I will. I'll call again. And you watch out for colds, Mum.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, love, take care.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Hello? Where's this call from, it's a number I haven't saved.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Oh, Mum, it's me. I changed phones and got a new number.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, yes, I can tell from your voice. Just to check, though — what was our dog's name?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's Boksil, honestly, Mum. She crossed the rainbow bridge last year — have you forgotten already?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Haha, that's right, that's right, I was just checking. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes. How about you? I hear the wholesale business is busy.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Same as every day. Is the work in Gimpo manageable?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, not bad. But Mum, that's not why I called — my pay is running a bit late this month.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: So how much do you need? Is it urgent?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 300,000 won. It's not urgent, anytime this week is fine.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Then let's just be sure and do a video call so I can see your face — there's so much fraud about these days.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, good idea, I'll call on video right now. I'll text you the account number while we're talking.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Seeing your face, it really is my son, that's reassuring. So I send it to that account you just texted?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's the one. Thanks, Mum.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: I'll send it this evening in my own time, so don't fuss, get on with your work.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I will. I'll call again, and take care of yourself, Mum.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I have. How about you? Isn't work hard?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: It's manageable. There's not much overtime lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's good. If there's nothing urgent let's take our time — I've nothing particular on today either.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, that's right — I've got into watching esports matches lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Do you mean gaming tournaments? The ones on television?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, and there was even a regional tournament held in Yeosu this time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Really? They have that sort of thing in Yeosu? How interesting.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, the qualifiers were online and the finals were in the plaza in front of the city hall.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That must have been fun. Young people do like that sort of thing. But aren't you sitting watching for too long?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Haha, true, I worry about that too so I stretch halfway through.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's good of you. I've been so absorbed studying for the care worker certificate that I've lost track of time.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, really? Is it going well? Don't overdo it, take it slowly.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, thank you. I'll show off when I get the certificate. Eat properly.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, and you look after yourself. I'll call again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, son, what's the occasion, calling at this hour

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I just wanted to hear your voice, Dad. Have you had dinner?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just now. Your mother and I went to the Paju market and bought some noodles. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, just now too. How's work these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Getting by. Nothing much going on lately, nothing urgent. How about you, isn't work hard?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Same as ever for me. Anyway, Dad, I've been thinking of getting a dog

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, out of nowhere? What's brought that on

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I'm on my own so it gets a bit lonely. But I've got a lot of work on, so I worry whether I could look after it properly

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's not something to decide in a hurry. Think it over slowly — dogs take a lot of care

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I imagine so. You kept a Jindo at home when I was little, Dad — what was that like?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, old Nureongi. It was easier back then because we had a yard — keeping one in a flat would be different

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: True, I'm in a flat so I'd have to walk it often. I'll look into it before deciding

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, don't rush, look at several places. Have a look at a shelter for abandoned dogs too

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, that's a good idea. I'll tell you again once I've decided

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right. I'll pass on your regards to your mother. Sleep well, and let's talk again

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, Dad, get some rest

turns.text: Already? I'm still in short sleeves here

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It must get cold earlier here in Daejeon. It's not urgent, but I feel like I should start getting ready for winter

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It's still only November and you're already preparing for winter?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I know, but it feels oddly like the cold has come early this year

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: At our age we've got to watch out for colds, look after yourself

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly, when you're driving you can't even take time off with a cold, you just have to push through

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Don't overdo it, take a rest when you get the chance

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I will, and you watch out for colds too. Let's get a meal sometime

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, sounds good, let's be in touch

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, take care

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's me — my number's changed so it looks unfamiliar, right? Me, the one who lived in Gwangju, the friend who drove buses.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? It wasn't a saved number so I wondered who it was. I can tell from your voice — it's you.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's right, that's right. Anyway, do you remember the nickname you gave me at that company dinner back then?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course — I called you 'Not a driver, Captain Safe Driving'.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's it, haha. How have you been? How's work these days.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Busy as ever. Are you still on the same bus route?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, same as ever. But I called because my eldest daughter is getting married.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Congratulations! She's grown up already?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I know, where does the time go. I want to talk about the invitation, and face to face would be better than the phone — can we switch to a video call?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, let's do that. Hang on, I'll switch.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thanks. I'll send the invitation separately by mobile — it's not urgent, so look at it whenever.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, understood. Where should I send the congratulatory money?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just the same account you used to transfer money to me before, that one's fine.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that account, I know it, I know it. I'll send it there.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thanks. Let's have a soju sometime when you're free.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, see you at the wedding. Pass on my congratulations to your daughter.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, yes, I'm doing well. How's work these days?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Same as ever for me. It's been a bit hot in Busan lately — how is it over there?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's warming up here too. I didn't call about anything urgent, just to say hello

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ah, lovely, I happened to be on a break. We can take our time

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Let's have a quick chat then. I saw in the news that robots are walking like people now — did you see that?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ah, I saw that! It was Boston Dynamics, wasn't it?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's right, that's it. They climb stairs and even run — quite something.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: When I see that sort of thing I worry that robots will be coming into our broadcast equipment side before long

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, though don't you think human hands are still needed? Especially for the precise parts

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That is true. I'd like to believe so, haha

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Tell me if you come across any more interesting news. It was good talking today

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, yes, it was good talking. Let's be in touch again

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, hello, it's me! What are you up to?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, hi. Just lying down looking at my phone. Why'd you call?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I was just bored. How are you keeping? I've just got back from work

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as every day for me. I hear you've had a lot of overtime — are you all right?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Don't ask, this month has been genuinely busy. But I've started a new game after work to relieve the stress

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, which one? I've had nothing much on so I was thinking of installing a new game myself

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Valorant! I started because a friend got me into it, and it's surprisingly good fun

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Valorant? Isn't that a bit hard? Don't you need good aim?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I was completely hopeless at first, but you improve with practice. Just play it relaxed and enjoy it

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, maybe I should install it. But I'm genuinely bad at games — wouldn't I be a liability?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Don't be silly, you learn by playing together. I'm still only Silver myself, I just enjoy it casually

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, that's good then. Shall I install it this evening and we play together this weekend?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, yes, let's find a time at the weekend. It's not urgent, so get ready at your own pace

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll install it later and let you know

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, let's talk again. Take care

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, and don't work too late. I'll be in touch!

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Hey, Dad, it's me. Have you got a minute while you're working?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, what's this all of a sudden — your voice sounds odd, have you got a cold?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: No, my nose is just blocked. Oh, Dad, do you remember what my nickname was as a child?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Of course I do, you were Snotty when you were little. Why are you asking all of a sudden

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Haha, that's right, I just wanted to confirm it really is me. How's the dog these days?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, she's fine, wears me out with the walks. So has something happened, that you called?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, the thing is, I twisted my wrist at work yesterday and went to the hospital. It's nothing major but the treatment cost more than I expected.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What? Is it bad? Let me see you — call me on video.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yeah, all right, hang on, I'll call on video.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, that's a relief, it's only a bit swollen. So how much was it?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 200,000 won. I'm a bit tight this month, so could you help out if that's all right?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Of course, how much shall I send? I'll send it to the bankbook I used before.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's the one. Thanks, Dad. Don't put yourself out, send it whenever suits.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Put myself out, nonsense — my daughter's wrist comes first. Just be a bit more careful.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I will. I'll buy you a meal next time I'm in Gwangju. Take care.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, be careful, and call me as soon as that wrist heals.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, what's the occasion, calling in the daytime. Nothing wrong?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I just wanted to hear your voice. Are you very busy at work these days?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Don't ask, I did a night call-out yesterday and my body's still heavy. How about you, are you keeping up with the hospital?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I'm going. The head doctor there is a woman, and I've been seeing her throughout.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, good, that's a relief. But from your voice it sounds like you've got something to say. What is it?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Er... actually the treatment cost has come to a lot this month. I think it's because they told me to increase the physiotherapy sessions.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Really? How much was it? It's not urgent, so take your time telling me.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I'm about 300,000 won short. I wondered if you could help just for this month.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: 300,000 isn't an unreasonable amount. Not right this minute, though — I'll put it in on payday.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's fine then. Thanks, Mum.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Look after yourself properly, it's serious if you get ill. Is your father all right?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, he's fine. And you don't overdo it, rest as you work.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, I will. Let's talk again, I'm hanging up now.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just now. Have you had your food?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I have. It must be quite cold in Gumi these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's been chilly lately. My hands get cold at work. Is it all right in Sejong?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Much the same here. Anyway, Dad, do you watch the news? Politics has been noisy.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I saw. Another fight in the National Assembly. It's like that every day now.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: This time it seems to be over the budget bill. The parties keep sparring.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly. They always say they're thinking of the people, and all they do is fight. At my age, watching that is exasperating.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Right. Oh, Dad, are you free this weekend? It's not urgent, I just wanted to ask.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: The weekend? Nothing particular on. Why, is something up?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: My wife and I have something to do on Saturday. I wondered if you could watch the children for half a day. It's fine if you can't come.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's no trouble at all. It's been a while since I've seen their faces, so that works out. What time should I come?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Around eleven in the morning should do. I'll text you the details again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Understood. See you Saturday, then. Take care on the way.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, Dad, thank you. See you this weekend.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's fine. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I have. I was out on site and I've just finished. How was work today, Mum?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as ever for me. Though my back's been hurting lately. I suppose it's my age.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Don't overdo it. And do go to the hospital.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's fine, it's fine, a pain patch sorts it out. So what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Well, the thing is, I wondered if it'd be all right to send your allowance a few days late this month. My card bill came out rather high.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh dear, why would you feel bad about that. It's not urgent, send it whenever.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Still, I thought I should tell you in advance. I'll definitely sort it at the start of next month.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, don't worry. Prices are going up and it's hard, so look after your own household first.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Thank you, Mum. Still, I'd like to help at least a little.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: The thought alone is enough. I've been listening to Lim Young-woong and keeping my mind at ease.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Haha, that's lovely. I'll bring something nice next time I come.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, take care getting around, and eat properly.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, and you look after yourself, Mum. I'll call again.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, it's me! How have you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, I'm doing well. The sudden cold snap was hard, but it's better now.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly, it's been properly chilly in Siheung in the mornings. Anyway, nothing urgent, I just called because I was bored.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Good, I'd just got back from my walk and was resting.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, that's right — you enjoy photography these days, don't you? I saw something amazing on the news yesterday.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: What is it? I've been trying out all sorts of camera apps lately, so I'm curious.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: You know those AI speakers? Apparently they can hear your voice and draw pictures too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Really? You just speak and a picture comes out?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, it draws exactly what you say. My son showed me and it was remarkable.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Wow, I'd love to try that. It must feel a bit like photography, expressing what you've imagined.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's right, that's right, that's why you came to mind. You like artistic things.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Thank you, let me know the app name later. I'll give it a go.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I will, I'll text it to you. Anyway, as long as nothing's wrong, that's what matters. Let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, thanks for calling. Let's have a coffee next week.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, hello, it's me. How are you keeping?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. I'm doing all right, work's been a bit busy lately.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Really? How are things over in Gimpo, is work manageable?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: So-so. Are you still doing the escort work?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, still at it. Nothing urgent, I just called because I wanted to hear your voice.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that's sweet. Nothing much going on, then?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I've been having a bit of a headache over my child's cram school. How are you handling the kids' education?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Mine just does the schoolwork — the cram school fees are so expensive I can't bring myself to.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, the fees are genuinely frightening these days. But then I worry the child will fall behind if I don't send them.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly. Personally I think it's better to let the child do what they want to do. If you push too hard they struggle.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's fair too. Seeing my child stressed does make me feel uneasy.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Well, it shows how much thought you put in. You're very caring.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's every parent, isn't it. Anyway, talking today has helped me sort things out.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Good, let's talk again. Don't worry too much about the child.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, thanks. Take care and I'll be in touch.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Hey, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Yes, it's fine. What's the occasion, you calling and all.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I just wanted to hear your voice. Is work busy these days?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Same as ever. The assessment cases have piled up so it's hectic. What have you been up to?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Me... just getting on with studying for a certificate. Anyway, have you had your health check-up?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Ah, that... not yet. I haven't had the time.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: You always say that. If you keep putting it off because you're busy it gets worse later.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: I know, I know. I'll make time this weekend and go.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: And call Mum more often. She's been upset that she hasn't heard your voice lately.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Right, I've been so scattered. I should call her this week.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, do. Oh, and shall I come and see you next month once my certificate exam is over?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Sounds good. We'll go and eat something nice then.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: All right. And do actually get that health check-up.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: All right, all right. Thanks for worrying about me. Let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, take care of yourself! I'll hang up now.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's me, how are you keeping?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. How's Jeju these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: The wind's picked up a bit here. Are you all right in Busan?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, just getting by. Is the office still busy these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Fishing village co-op work is always the same. But I've been all over the place preparing for the administrative agent exam.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? That's impressive. Is the studying going well?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: So-so. But I called for a different reason. My nephew is enlisting next month.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? He's grown up already?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I know. But I never did military service myself, so I've no idea what to get him.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I did mine back in the day, so I can put together what he'll need.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Really? It's not urgent though, so just let me know whenever it comes to you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, I'll put a list together and text it within a few days.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thanks, really. He's so nervous he keeps asking me about it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Understandable, I was terrified back then too. Tell him not to worry.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: All right, I will. Let's get a meal sometime when you're free.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sounds good, I'll get in touch next time I visit Jeju. Take care!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Oh, hello, it's me. It's been a while — how are you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it has. I'm doing well, though I've been all over the place with the ship. How's the clinic going?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Getting by. Anyway, back when we were living in Wonju together, what was the name of that gukbap place we always went to — do you remember?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that place, Myeongdong Halmae Gukbap. You loved sundae so you always ordered the sundae gukbap

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: That's right, that's it, haha, it's been ages since I thought of that. Anyway, we're a bit short-staffed at the clinic at the moment, so I called to ask whether you know anyone who could work part-time

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? What sort of position?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Someone to help with reception and simple paperwork — mornings only. It's not urgent though, so you can think about it at your own pace, we don't have to fill it this week

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Really? Then I'll ask around the people I know from working on the boats. Some of them might have the time

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: That would be a real help. You must be busy on the ship yourself, so don't put yourself out — ask whenever it suits

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll ask around and get back to you. And you look after yourself at work

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, thank you. Let's see each other sometime when we're both free

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Let's do that. Take care

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's me, is this a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's fine, nothing wrong?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just getting by. I've been a bit bored lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Bored? The kids are grown so you must have plenty of time these days.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's right, and about that — I've been thinking of getting a dog.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, out of nowhere? Keeping a dog takes more work than you'd think, so look into it properly before deciding.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, I haven't decided, I'm just looking into it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Good thinking. There's a lot to prepare for keeping a dog.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, so I'm wondering what breed would be good. Don't you keep one?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: We don't, but a colleague at work has a small breed and says it's gentle and lovely.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, really? I'd been looking at small breeds too, so that's useful.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't rush the decision — go and have a look at a shelter too, and take your time.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I should. I'll look around a bit more before deciding.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Tell me once you've decided, I'm curious.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Will do, let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, take care.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just now. Have you had your lunch?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I grabbed something. I've been a bit busy lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't overdo it. Is the online shop doing well?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Getting by. Nothing urgent, I just called because I wanted to hear your voice, so let's take our time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Heh, that's nice. Anything interesting lately?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: The clothing trends have shifted a bit. I was thinking of buying you some clothes.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I've got clothes to wear, what would I buy more for.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Still, there's a lot of comfortable stuff out now. Stretchy fabrics that are easy on the joints. Your knees aren't good, after all.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: They make that sort of thing now? It must be different from what young people wear.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, there are ones made mainly for function. And there are a lot of skincare products with good ingredients now — I've tried one myself.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Isn't skincare just for women, heh.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: These days men all use at least a toner and lotion. Your skin gets very dry in winter.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, my hands have been chapping with the winter. Get me one, then.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: All right, I'll bring one next time I come. I'll let you go now — look after your health.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, and you look after the little one. Call again.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, son, just now. The shop's quiet so I'm sitting down.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: That's good. How are your legs these days? Standing so long must be hard.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: They're all right. At my age I just assume that's how it is.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Well, don't overdo it. Oh, Mum, you said you wanted to get some rest lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's right, I've been worn out in body and mind. I'd like to get away somewhere.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: It's not urgent, so think it over at your own pace. I saw Buyeo on television the other day — there's a fortress wall and a museum, it looked lovely.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Buyeo? Isn't that far? It'd take a while from Masan.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: It's about two hours by car. There's no need to rush — you could go on a nice weekend at your leisure.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: What's at this Buyeo fortress, then?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: It's a wall built in the Baekje period, apparently. Long history and lovely scenery. And the museum nearby has the artefacts from the area.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that sounds interesting. It'd be dull going on my own, though.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Then let's find a time and go together. Pick whatever date suits you.

turns.speaker: Self

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I had gimbap in front of the office. How are you keeping? How's the job hunting

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just carrying on with it. There's nothing to rush, so I'm taking my time

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, take your time, no need to hurry. Oh, that's right, I went to an interesting café today

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, what sort of café? I'm curious

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It's a new place in Uijeongbu and the desserts were genuinely unusual. They had a black sesame croffle

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: A black sesame croffle? What's it like, nutty?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, really nutty, and the cream isn't sweet, which is nice. If you're ever going to a gallery or something, look up whether there's a café nearby

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, nice, I like looking up cafés when I go to a gallery. Send me some photos

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, I'll send them later. There's nothing to rush, so look at them whenever suits

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right. Anyway, I found a bakery while out walking and their salt bread is genuinely good

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, salt bread is good, I like that too. Let's go together sometime when we're both free

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, let's, I'll pick a day and be in touch

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: All right, I'll send the photos later. Take care and let's talk again

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, thanks, take care

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me. What are you doing?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, love. Just making dinner. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Not yet, I'll eat in a bit. How was work today, Mum?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It was a bit busy today. Customers coming and going constantly, it was hectic. What did you do today?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I was just editing my CV, and then got frustrated so I went for a walk.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, there's nothing to rush, so take your time. Don't get impatient.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I know, I was just feeling stifled. Anyway, Mum, are you going to Gwanggyosan this weekend?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I should, I've arranged to go with friends. The weather's lovely lately, perfect for it.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Shall I come too? I've been stuck at home and I feel heavy.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, lovely, let's go together. The friends will be pleased, it's been a while.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: So what time do you set off in the morning?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Around nine? Nothing's fixed, though, so just come whenever suits.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: All right, I'll aim for nine then. I should get my hiking boots out.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, and text me again before bed. Have a proper dinner.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, all right, Mum, I'll be in touch later. Bye!

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's me. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. I've been so busy I haven't been in touch, sorry

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It's fine, it's not urgent. I just called because I wanted to hear your voice

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, let's take our time. What have you been up to?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Me, going to work and doing leathercraft at weekends. Is the kimchi factory still busy for you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't ask, the volume's high so it's chaos. Tending the vegetable patch at weekends is what keeps me going

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, it's impressive you've taken up leathercraft. Is making things fun?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Haha, you really are diligent. Anyway, I've started hiking, you know

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? What brought hiking on all of a sudden

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I wanted to get in shape a bit and relieve some stress. I've picked a mountain nearby and go every week

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that's good. I'd been thinking I should get some exercise myself

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Then shall we go together next time? If it's hard we can rest as we go, so no pressure

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, lovely. I'd have to buy some hiking boots

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: You can sort that out slowly. Comfortable shoes will do for now

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right. Let's fix a date and be in touch

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, I'll be in touch soon. Take care

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's been a while, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. I'm doing all right. How about you these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same as every day for me. I only manage to call once the little one's asleep

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, has the baby grown a bit? Isn't it hard getting them down at night?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Don't ask, though it's got a bit better lately. Nothing wrong at your end?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as ever for us. Oh, but is your father all right now after his back surgery?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, thanks for asking, he's much better now. He can't walk as long as he used to, though

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, that's a relief. My mother's been going to the hospital with knee pain lately, so it sounds similar

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, I see. As people get older they all have something wrong, don't they

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly. I just hope none of them overdo it and they get better slowly

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, let's check in on each other more often too

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, lovely. Let's see each other sometime when we're both free

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, let's meet up even if I bring the little one. It was good to hear from you today, take care

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, you get some rest too, take care

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's been a while. How are you keeping?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. Just getting by. How's it over there, in Busan?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same as every day here. How's your health, is your back any better?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, it still aches a bit. But it's not urgent, so I'm going to the hospital and managing it slowly.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, yes, don't overdo it, take your time. Oh, did you see that, the news about the earthquake in Türkiye.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I saw. I was genuinely shocked seeing the buildings just come down like that.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly. But apparently it's a region with frequent earthquakes? Because of the plate boundary.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, that's right, the news said so. Even so, I can't believe tens of thousands of people died at once.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly. They say we've had a few earthquakes here lately too, so it doesn't feel like someone else's problem.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, it made me think we should keep some emergency supplies at home.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, that's a good idea. I should keep some water and a torch at home too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, let's both be careful. And don't hurt yourself at work.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: All right, I will. Let's see each other sometime when we're free.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, let's, and you look after your health. Take care.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me, how have you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, my girl, you sound well. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I have. What have you had, Mum?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I made myself a tangerine tea earlier, it's been chilly lately

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, tangerine tea sounds lovely, I'd like one myself

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Then shall I get you some for next time you come down? It's not urgent, come whenever

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Haha, lovely. Anyway, we've got some good coffee beans in at work

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, coffee beans? What do they taste like?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Slightly acidic, with a subtle chocolate note

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I wouldn't know about that sort of thing, I find instant easier

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Haha, that's such a you answer. Still, I think you'd like it if you tried it

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Really? Then bring some next time you visit

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I will, and I'll look forward to the tangerine tea

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, yes, let's look after each other. Take care and call again

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just now. How about you? Were you at home working on paperwork again today?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I was tinkering with my cover letter and my eyes hurt so I'm taking a break. Is the kindergarten all right these days, Mum?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's all right, but with prices as they are the parents are struggling too. There's a fuss about the meal fees going up as well.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: True, I was shocked at the supermarket. A tray of eggs has got so expensive.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly. Everything's going up so even doing the shopping is frightening.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: All right, good. Anyway, the news said energy prices keep rising too. That seems to be why inflation won't come down.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly. I never used to think about petrol prices and now I get a shock every time I fill up.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: True, true. And they said the US economy might worsen — wouldn't that affect us too?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It would. Trade is all tied together. But worrying won't change it, so all we can do is spend carefully.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: True. Still, talking to you like this helps. Watching the news alone was frustrating.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, love, don't get too impatient — with the job hunting or anything else, just take it one step at a time.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, thanks, Mum. I'll call again, it's been good talking today.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, take care and eat properly. Let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's me, have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just now. It's been a while, how are you keeping?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same as ever, doing waterproofing work. The weather's warmed up so there's more work on.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Better to have work than not. Are you keeping well? Don't overdo it, take your time.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I should, there's nothing urgent so I'm going at my own pace. How's work for you these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Getting by. Watching the news lately does get me down, though.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, that's right, have you seen the news about the jeonse fraud? It genuinely doesn't feel like someone else's problem.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I saw. It's seriously bad. Apparently a lot of young people got caught out.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly, I've been looking into buying a place and news like that frightens me off.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, all the more reason to check the property register and so on carefully. I've picked some of it up making training materials at work.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: An educated man, clearly. Help me out when I'm looking at places.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course. Don't rush it, look around at your own pace until a good property comes up.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thanks, really. Come and visit Miryang sometime when you're free.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I'll come soon. Take care and let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: All right, take care.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Hey, it's me, can you talk?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, what's the occasion at this hour, nothing wrong?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Getting by. Preparing for interviews has worn me out a bit, but I'm holding up.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, are you eating properly? Don't overdo it.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I'm eating. Oh, I've got an interview in Seoul next week.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Which company?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: It's manufacturing, but I'll tell you about that later — I should have some time free that day, so I thought I'd come and see you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Lovely, it's been a while. Have you thought about what we'd do?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: You like galleries — apparently there's a good one near Bukhansan, shall we go? It'd settle my mind too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's a good one, they've got a decent exhibition on at the moment. It's not urgent though, so let's fix the date at our own pace later.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: All right, let's keep it relaxed then — I might come straight after the interview.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, yes, let's see how you're feeling. You don't have to force yourself to come.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Thanks. I'll be in touch once the interview date is set.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll wait to hear. Prepare well and take care of yourself.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's been a while. How are you keeping?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. Same as ever for me. How's your health?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, my back hasn't been good lately so I've been going to the hospital. Probably from being bent over all the time at work.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't overdo it, take it slowly. Look after yourself first.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I should. Anyway, what do you do these days when you've got time in the evenings?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I live for watching LoL matches after work. I've watched nearly all of this spring season.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, really? I used to watch a bit but I haven't at all lately. Which team is doing well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: T1 have been coming back to life lately. They were shaky at the start but their form has shot up recently.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: T1, isn't that the team with the famous player? Is he still good?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, he's still carrying. His hands haven't gone even with age. Watching him spurs me on too.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Haha, we're getting on ourselves, so seeing that does give you a lift.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly. There's a final next week — shall we watch it together? With chicken and a beer.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Sounds good. I'll text you whether I can make it depending on how I'm feeling.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, don't overdo it. Let's meet once you're better.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: All right, I'll be in touch soon. Take care.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, it's me. What are you doing?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, son, I've had dinner and I'm watching TV. What's the occasion, you calling and all

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I just wanted to hear your voice. How's your back these days?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, that — I went to the hospital and it's better. But they said I have to keep going for physiotherapy

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Really? How often do you go?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Twice a week, they said. Doing that continually does add up in cost, mind

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: How much is it each time? Let me chip in

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, no need, I can pay that much myself

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Still, it's not urgent, so think about it. When I get this month's pay I'll put a bit in

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Heh, my boy's all grown up. But really, don't put yourself out

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's no trouble, work's going well for me. When's your next appointment?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Next Tuesday I'll go again. I'll tell you when the results come

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, all right. Eat properly, and tell me straight away if it hurts

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, son. And you eat properly too

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I'll call again, Mum

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, son, I've just made myself some ramyeon in the security office. Where are you driving these days, out of town again?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I went down to Busan today and I'm on my way back now. I'm in the car so the sound might echo a bit.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, drive carefully. But you said you twisted your back last week — how is that? Is the spot you put the pain patch on still bad?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, that's right, I twisted it unloading. I got by with just the patch, but lately when I sit, my leg goes tingly too, so I'm thinking of going to the hospital.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: You mustn't put that off, go soon. Is that what you called about, the hospital costs?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, actually that's why I called. They want an MRI and it comes to a fair bit, so I wondered if you could help.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: How much is it? If it's not urgent, can I send it a bit later after this month's pay comes in?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, it's not urgent, the scan is next week so as long as it's before then.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Understood, I'll send it from the bankbook I use. Is it the same account you always use?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's the one. Thanks, Dad, don't put yourself out, send it whenever suits.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Put myself out, nonsense — my son being ill worries me more. Call me when the results come.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I will, and you watch out for colds, Dad. I'll call again next week.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's me. It's been a while, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. Getting by. How's work these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same as every day for me. Though my knee's been aching so I went to the hospital.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Your knee? Why all of a sudden, did you hurt it?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I didn't hurt it, I think it's just age. It's not urgent, I just went to get it checked.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's a relief. My knees do feel stiff going up and down stairs lately too.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, apparently everyone at our age is the same. But the hospital said there are foods that are good for the joints.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, what are they? Tell me too.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: They said things high in collagen for the cartilage — dogani-tang, mussels, that sort of thing.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Dogani-tang — it's tasty but it's a bit expensive.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Haha, true. I can't have it often but I'll try to now and then.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, that'd be good. I should drink more water too, I've hardly had any lately.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, water matters, apparently. Oh, while we're on it, let's play badminton sometime when you're free.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sounds good, let's play once your knee is better. Look after yourself.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, and you look after your health. I'll be in touch, take care.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yeah, get home safe and see you soon.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello, who's this? The number's unfamiliar.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Ah, it's me, it's me, from the Cheonan office. I got a new phone so the number changed.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Then let me ask you one thing — what did you used to call me at the work dinners?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: That — we teased you as Chef, because you're a cook. I'd be hurt if you didn't remember that.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's right, that's right, definitely you. How have you been? It's been a while.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Getting by. It's been a bit hard lately, but how about you over in Jeju, is the restaurant doing well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as ever for me, kitchen work is much of a muchness. But what do you mean it's been hard, has something happened?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Nothing much, I've just had some hospital costs come up fairly suddenly.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? How much do you need? But this sort of thing feels odd on voice alone, so let's do a video call and talk face to face.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, let's, that's easier for me too. Hang on, I'll turn the camera on.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, seeing your face, it really is you — you look worn out. How much do you need?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: About 500,000 won, and I'll pay it back as soon as next month's pay comes in. You're still using that Nonghyup account, right?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, that's right, the same account. But you said it wasn't urgent right now — does it not have to be today?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: As long as it's sent by tomorrow morning. Check it over and send it at your own pace.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll check in the morning and send it straight away. And do go to the hospital properly for whatever's wrong.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Thanks, really. I'll buy you a meal next time I'm in Jeju. Take care.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, it's me. Is this a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's fine, what's this about?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Nothing much, really, I just wondered how you were. I've had a lot on my mind about my child lately

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Is your child doing well?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Actually, that's what I called to ask about. My child is going into middle school and I'm torn about whether to send them to a cram school

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I see. It's not urgent, so you can think it over at your own pace — every child is different

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: True, but everyone around me is sending theirs, so I start to feel rushed

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I understand that feeling. But it's better to look at the child's disposition first — if you force it they lose interest instead

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's true, mine is a bit sensitive so I do worry

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Then maybe start with a short trial and increase it depending on how they respond

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, that's a good approach. I'm glad I asked

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Let's have a coffee sometime when you're free, and you can tell me more about your child

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, lovely. Thank you for listening today, I'll be in touch again

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, take care

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, hello. Your voice sounds flat. Are you unwell?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Does it show? I haven't been well lately... How's work for you, Dad, is your back all right?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Same as ever for me. But that hospital you mentioned last time — what did the doctor there say again?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, that was the digestive tests and being told to come back once more, that's right. That's why I went to the hospital again.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: So what were the results, is it bad?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Well... they said I need some treatment. It costs more than I expected, which is why I'm telling you.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: You should have said sooner. How much is it? But if it's not urgent, take your time telling me — eat first.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I only need to register by next week, so there's still time. I'll need about 800,000 won.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Let me see your face, switch to video. I want to see how you look while we talk.

turns.speaker: Family

turns.text: I just called because I was bored. Are you busy these days, Dad?
