turns.text: There's a fair bit of work on but it's fine. How's the job hunting going for you?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Same as ever. It's not urgent, so I'm looking around at my own pace

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, don't get impatient, take your time. So what's the call about, have you got something to say?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Ah, nothing, I was just watching YouTube and saw a video about skincare routines and found it interesting. Do you watch that sort of thing, Dad?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I wouldn't know, haha. Though doing retail marketing at work means I do end up watching cosmetics shelf trends

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Really? What's selling well at the moment?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Low-irritation skincare and mini-size products are popular lately — I think younger people want to try things without committing

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Ah, I've seen that too! And men seem more interested in skincare these days as well, I've been thinking of buying some

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Good idea, but don't buy everything at once — try one at a time and find what suits you

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Will do. Tell me if you come across anything else interesting

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, and eat properly. Let's talk again

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, and you look after your health, Dad. Bye!

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Hey, it's me. Can you talk?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Oh, yes, what's the occasion, calling at this hour

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I'm on a break and you came to mind. How are you keeping? How's your health

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Same as ever for me. I've been walking a bit lately so I feel all right

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That's good. Are Mum and Dad well? How's Dad's knee

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Yes, maybe because the weather's warmed up, it's much better. Mum's well too

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That's a relief. I can't get down often, so it's reassuring having you there

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Don't be daft, I've not got much on so I'm just around. It's you — isn't the training hard?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's manageable lately. I'm going to try to come down on my next leave

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Oh, really? When do you think that'd be?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Not certain yet, but probably around the middle of next month. It's not urgent, so I'll tell you again once it's fixed

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: All right, let me know as soon as you have the dates. Mum and Dad will be pleased

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, and you look after yourself, and give them my regards

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: All right, and you be careful in training, don't get hurt. Let's talk again

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. How have you been?

turns.text: Oh, love, what's the occasion, calling at this hour

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: You just came to mind. It's chilly lately — isn't it cold in the security office?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: No, I've got the heater on so it's fine. More to the point, aren't you busy at work these days

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Same as every day. Though it has been hectic lately, with the year end

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Don't overdo it, you've got the little one to look after. And eat properly

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Of course, I'm eating well. How's Mum these days? Is her knee any better?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Same as ever. It still aches on rainy days. She's going to the hospital

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That's a relief. I'll definitely come down for the holidays this time, I've kept some time free

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, really? That'd be lovely. But don't force it if you're busy, come another time

turns.speaker: Family

turns.speaker: Family

turns.speaker: Parent

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I will. See you at the holidays, and give Mum my regards

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, drive safely and call again

turns.text: Oh, hello. Oh, it's been a while

turns.speaker: Self

turns.text: I know. I've been all over the place looking after my mother, haha

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: How is your mother? Is she well?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, she's getting by. How's work going for you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as every day for me. Still stacking agricultural produce

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Isn't that hard? It's physical work, your back must ache

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It does, but I've got used to it so it's bearable. Is the security work manageable for you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that's nice. I used to want to drive a forklift but I still haven't got the certificate

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Wouldn't a forklift certificate be much better? Less physical too

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, but I can't find time to go to a school. I'm looking into it slowly

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, nothing to rush, take your time. Have a look when you get the chance

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I should. Anyway, you look after yourself too, and let's talk again

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, and don't overdo it. Let's get a meal sometime when you're free

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sounds good, see you next time

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. My phone screen died so it's in for repair and I've borrowed a temporary SIM.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, the number was unfamiliar so I wondered who it was. How did the screen go, did you drop it?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I dropped it on the stairs. Anyway, Dad, do you remember me? What my nickname was as a child.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: How would I not know that, you were Teddy when you were little. Because you waddled.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That's right, haha, so you can believe it's me now. How have you been? Is work all right?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Getting by. It's turned a bit chilly in Daejeon. Is the work in Uijeongbu manageable?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I'm getting used to the test lab work. Anyway, Dad, the phone repair came to more than I expected, so I called to ask.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: How much is it? If it's urgent tell me now, or we can talk later and I'll check properly before sending.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 200,000 won, I think. It's not urgent, so send it whenever suits you.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Still, let's talk face to face — shall we switch to video? There are a lot of dodgy calls about these days.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, of course, I'll call on video now.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, I can see you, it really is you. So I send it to the same account as before?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, I'm still using that account. Thank you, Dad.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, understood, I'll send it this evening. Take care, and come down home sometime.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I'll make time and come down soon. Take care, Dad.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, hello. What were you up to?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, it's my day off so I've been lounging about at home. How about you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I've no work today either so I'm resting. Are you keeping well? Isn't the security work hard?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It's better these days. I've got used to the night rounds now. Is your back all right? Window frame work is heavy

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's fine, playing badminton loosens me up so I can manage. Nothing urgent, I just wanted to hear your voice

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Good, I didn't call with anything particular to say either. Anyway, have you watched anything good lately?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I watched an animated film a while back, what was it... the Conan movie. That was surprisingly good

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, Conan! I used to watch that years ago, they still make it. I live for listening to Lim Young-woong and watching animated films on Netflix

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You really are a Lim Young-woong fan. I didn't know you liked cartoons too

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I've watched them since I was little, I like Winnie the Pooh too. Watching that puts my mind at ease

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I've seen that one too, Winnie the Pooh. Surprisingly full of wise lines. It looks like it's for children but it's good for adults too

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, that's genuinely moving. Let's go to the sauna together sometime and talk more about films

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sounds good, let's line up our times. And we'll finish the Conan conversation then

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: All right, take care and mind that back. I'll call again

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, and you be careful on your night rounds. Let's talk again

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, son. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, Dad, just now. Have you finished work?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Just got home. How's your health? Have you been to the hospital?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I went, but... the tests came to more than I expected.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What was wrong that you had tests? Is it bad?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I haven't been sleeping and my stomach's been off, so I had an endoscopy and a few other things. It's nothing serious, but the tests and the medication...

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: So how much was it?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 300,000 won. I haven't saved much while job hunting so it's a bit of a burden...

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Hey, you should have said sooner. I'll send it within this week.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: No, Dad, I felt bad bringing it up. You must be tight yourself.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Don't be silly, my son being ill worries me more. My account's the same, so don't worry, and tell me again if more hospital costs come up.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Thanks, Dad. I've been feeling a bit anxious too so I've been thinking about counselling as well, but I'll think that over slowly.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Right, don't get impatient. Your health comes first. Eat properly and don't overdo it.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, and don't hurt yourself at work, Dad. I'll call again.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, go and get some rest.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just now. Are you eating properly at work?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: It's the canteen every day for me. How's the site these days, Dad, not too hot now?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's cooled off a bit. The overhead work is manageable now autumn's here. Nothing wrong with you?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Nothing much, but I sold an old printer on Danggeun Market yesterday. It adds up more than you'd think.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Danggeun Market? Everyone's on that these days. How much did you get?

turns.speaker: Family Member

turns.speaker: Self

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Of course, I'll install the app on your phone next time I'm home. There's nothing difficult about it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, we'll try it slowly when the time comes.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, oh, and I bought something too — a secondhand desk. It's in genuinely good condition.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Well done. Using things like that properly saves money, which is good. Seeing you run a household is reassuring.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I'm quite thrifty, I'll have you know. Are you going to the billiard hall this evening?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I'll drop in for a bit later. And you come home at the weekend.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I will, I'll come next weekend. Take care, Dad.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, get home safe and let's talk again.

turns.text: Yes, it's fine, I've finished work and I'm resting. What's the occasion, you calling and all

turns.text: I just thought I'd hear your voice after a while. How's work these days, busy?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as ever, marketing is always hectic. How's the factory side for you?

turns.speaker: Coworker

turns.speaker: Self

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: It just feels a bit empty coming home after work. But it's not urgent, I'm looking into it slowly, I haven't decided

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I imagine so, it does get lonely on your own. What breed are you thinking?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Golden retrievers and the bigger ones look impressive, but I wonder whether it's too much to keep a big dog in a studio flat

turns.text: The big ones need a lot of walking and take a lot of work, so wouldn't it be better to start small if it's your first?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's fair. Actually, I did briefly consider a cat too

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'd genuinely love a cat but I've got atopic dermatitis so I can't. The fur isn't good for it, apparently

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, really? I'm glad I don't have that. Dog or cat, I'll look into it a bit more before deciding

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, don't rush, think it over properly. And send me lots of photos if you get one

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Of course, I'll tell you as soon as I decide. See you at work, then

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, take care!

turns.speaker: Self

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, perfect! Then I'll recommend you some next time we meet.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, lovely, I genuinely know nothing so I'd be grateful.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, we'll talk about it properly then. I'll let you go now.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, take care, see you at work.

turns.text: Hey, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.text: The children look after themselves. I've had a bit too much time on my hands lately and I'm bored.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Haha, that's right, that's it. Then shall I call you back on video so I can see your face?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, good, hang on, I'll hang up and call back on video.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Seeing your face, it really is you, that's reassuring. So how much do you need?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About a million. It's not urgent, so send it whenever suits you.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Understood, could you read out the account number? I'll send it straight away.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I'll text you the account. Thanks, I'll buy you a meal next time you're in Busan.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: All right, take care of yourself. Let's talk again.

turns.text: Hello, son.

turns.text: Mum, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just now. Aren't you busy at work these days?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Busy, but bearable. Are you keeping well, Mum? Isn't the cleaning work hard?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Getting by. Everything aches a bit with age, mind.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Don't overdo it. Oh, Mum, what are you doing this weekend? It's not urgent, I'm just asking.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Nothing in particular, why?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I saw on the news that there's a traditional market festival in Siheung. Lots of food and performances, apparently.

turns.speaker: Self

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I was thinking of coming down and going with you if my schedule that week works, but it's not certain yet so I'll let you know later.

turns.speaker: Self

turns.speaker: Family Member

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, eat properly. I'm hanging up.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, and you look after your health, Mum. Take care.

turns.speaker: Family Member

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: See you Tuesday, then! Well done today, Mum.

turns.text: All right, take care getting around. Let's be in touch later.

turns.text: What? What have you seen all of a sudden?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That AI voice cloning technology that's around now — apparently it's exactly like a real person's voice.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I think I saw that on the news. It's a bit frightening that it could be misused, though.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, apparently voice phishing uses that technology now. But on the flip side, AI to detect it is coming out too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that's clever. Which company made it?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: A domestic research institute developed it, apparently — it distinguishes real from fake by tiny differences in the voice waveform.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'd like our company to bring something like that in. Doing office support has got me interested in this sort of technology.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly. Doing bookkeeping myself, they say AI is being added to accounting programmes now too — the world really is changing fast.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It is. I've been thinking about shifting my career into that area later.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, that's good, look into it at your own pace. Anyway, it's been fun talking today, look after yourself and let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I'll be in touch again. Take care.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, it's me, but this isn't my number, I'm calling from a friend's phone.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Huh? What's this number, it's unfamiliar. Is this really my daughter?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, don't you know me? I'm the one who ate two bowls of the jeotgal rice you made every time as a child.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, that's right, it is my daughter's voice. But why do you sound so flat, has something happened?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Nothing much for now, but how was work today, Mum? Was the health centre cleaning hard?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Getting by. I listened to Lim Young-woong while I worked today and the time went quickly.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That's good. The children are fine and I'm fine, but actually something happened today.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What is it, tell me slowly. And if it's urgent, tell me quickly.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I scraped the car slightly in a car park. Nothing serious, just a dent in the bumper.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh dear, you must have had a fright. Are you all right?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I'm perfectly fine. But the repair came to a bit, and it's not urgent, so I wondered if you could chip in later when you've got it spare.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, if it's not needed today I'll send it after next week's pay.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Thanks, Mum, don't put yourself out, send it whenever suits.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, take care and drive carefully. I'll save the new number when you call from it again.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, Mum, I'll call again once the phone's fixed. And don't hurt yourself at work.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, all right, go home and rest.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello, son, have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, Mum, just now. What were you doing?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just tidying the yard a bit. It's turned quite chilly in Miryang morning and evening.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, really? It's still warm during the day in Changwon but chilly in the mornings.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, the temperature swing is big, so watch out for colds. And dress warmly.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I will, Mum. Anyway, did you call about something?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: No, nothing urgent, I was going to mention it when you had time. Take your time listening.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yeah, what is it, go ahead, it's fine.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I think the boiler needs checking before winter — I wondered if you could come and look at it around next weekend if you're free.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Ah, that, I think I can come next Saturday. I'll come then.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, come whenever suits. And have a proper meal before you come.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, all right, Mum, see you then. Watch out for colds.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me, what are you doing?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, son, I've had dinner and I'm watching TV. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I just made some ramyeon. Wasn't work hard today, Mum?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: There were a lot of tour groups today so it was busy, but it was fun. But you can't just eat ramyeon, have a proper meal

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: All right, all right. Anyway, Mum, do you still go to that bakery in Wanju?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, their red bean bun is genuinely good so I still go sometimes. Why bread all of a sudden

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: No reason, it just came to mind. That cream bun you brought me from there was really good

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, the cream bun! I love that too. Shall I get you some next time I go?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, really? It's not urgent though, so send it whenever you've got time

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I've got to go there next week so I'll buy some then and post it

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Thanks, Mum, a mix of cream buns and red bean buns would be lovely

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Understood, I'll do that. Anyway, are you eating properly these days?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, yes, I'm eating well, don't worry. And you don't overdo it at work

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, and you take care, son, call me when the bread arrives

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I will, Mum, go and get some rest

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me! Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, just now. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I grabbed something. Isn't work hard these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as ever. Kitchen work means standing so my legs get stiff, but it's fine.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, Mum, have you seen the news lately? Electricity prices have shot up in Europe. We've got it easy by comparison.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Really? I haven't been watching the news much so I didn't know. Why has it gone up so much there?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Something to do with gas imports. Anyway, apparently people there can't even put the heating on in winter. We're lucky.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly. We should appreciate how easy we have it here. Anyway, what did you call about, nothing's wrong?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: No, nothing wrong, and it's not urgent so think it over. We're making kimjang next month — could you come and help for a few days, Mum?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, of course I'll come. How many days?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Two or three days would do. We'll sort out the dates later.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right. Call me again once the date's set.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I will. Take care and eat properly!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, you too. Bye now!

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, son, just now. Are you eating properly?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I eat at work so don't worry. How's your health these days, are your diabetes numbers all right?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I've been careful about what I eat lately so it's fine. And I'm back at swimming.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: You're doing well. It's not urgent, I was just curious — how's the dog these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, she's doing well, I take her out for a walk every day now.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Really? Do you use a collar or a harness?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I switched to a harness. I worried a collar would hurt her neck.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Good thinking. Her neck joints will weaken with age, so that's better.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True. Though when I'm out walking, plenty of dogs are still on collars.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Right, people's awareness hasn't all changed yet. It must be sad seeing that sometimes, Mum.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: If they're companion animals they're family, so it'd be nice to make things easier for them.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Exactly. Ah, Mum, I should start making dinner, let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, son, eat properly. Call again.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Auntie, it's me. How have you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, my niece, it's been a while. How's the job hunting going?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Same as ever. It's not urgent, so I'm preparing at my own pace.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, that's the way. I've been a bit busy lately but I did rest at the weekend.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Good. Anyway, the weather today was properly summery.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It was, hot already. When you think of summer sports, what comes to mind?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Surfing, for me. Though I've never done it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Swimming comes to my mind first. I'd love to go and splash about.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Me too. Anyway, Auntie, would you ever want to try skydiving or something?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I've got a fear of heights so absolutely not. Could you do it?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I'd like to. You just jump and it's over, isn't it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It isn't over just from jumping, you have to open the parachute in time. Still, it's good to try things while you're young.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: True. I'll give it a go as part of a trip once I've got a job.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, and I'll come and watch at least. Eat properly.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, and you look after your health, Auntie. I'll call again!

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just now. Is today your day off?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, it's my day off so I can call at leisure. How's your knee these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as ever, it's fine when I'm walking but stiff if I sit for long. Isn't work hard for you these days?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Same as ever for me. Oh, that's right, do you watch TV these days, Dad? You keep up with the Hanwha games?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course, Hanwha have been playing well. Coming back from a walk along the Musimcheon and watching the broadcast in the evening is what I live for.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Haha, you really are a fan. I've been watching a variety show where baseball players come on and do interviews.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: What programme is that? I've been bored with nothing to watch lately.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I've forgotten the name, but players come on and talk about life after retirement. A bit poignant and quite fun.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I like that sort of thing too. I should look it up. I've been short of things to watch.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Let's go to a game together next time I've got a day off, Dad. Tickets seem easier to get these days.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That'd be good, it's been a while since I went in person. Let's line up a date and be in touch.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, will do, Dad. Take care and I'll call again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, drive safely. Let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me, have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I have. Have you had lunch? I hear work's been busy

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Getting by. Anyway, Mum, is your stomach any better? You said your digestion was off last time

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that — it's still bloated sometimes but I just take it as it is

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Maybe that's why — I've been taking a probiotic lately. It's meant to be good for the gut

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Which one

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: It's a product that's supposed to be good for people with IBS, it reduces stomach pain and bloating. I've tried it and it's not bad

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Then should I take that too? Is it expensive, though?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Not that expensive, and I'm not saying buy it right now — I'll bring some next time I come

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, bring it whenever. Thank you

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, and drink plenty of water, and don't eat cold things

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, and you eat properly

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, you too, Mum, I'll bring it when I come next week. Bye

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, take care

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, it's me. How are you keeping?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. It must be very cold in Chuncheon these days?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Don't ask, when I go out for dawn work my fingertips freeze solid. Still, I'm all right. Is work going well over in Seoul?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ticking along. But prices have gone mad lately, I got a shock at the supermarket.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: True, I sigh every time I do a shop these days. And the petrol prices.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's not urgent, but the news said this will continue for a while. Take your time, ask me anything you're curious about.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, actually there was something I wondered about. So interest rates will keep going up too?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: For a while, apparently. But there are a lot of variables so they say it's hard to say definitively. I'm just following along with the news myself.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I see. I don't know much about this so it helps a lot when you explain it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't be daft, I'm only picking things up from the news. Still, ordinary people like us can only spend carefully.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Exactly. Anyway, it's good to hear your voice. Call me next time you're in Chuncheon.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll come when I've got the time. Take care and let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, just now. Have you finished work?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, just finished. The hospital was hectic today.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Well done, anyway. Is the little one all right?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, she's getting on well at school. Nothing much going on with you, Dad?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as ever for me. Just a walk round the neighbourhood.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Still, it's good you keep a routine. The cleaning work has picked up for me lately, they've added wards.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I see. That must be hard on you, then.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: It is hard, but the daily rate isn't bad so it's fine. I just wanted to tell you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, take your time telling me. And be careful not to wear yourself out.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I will. And you don't overdo it, just stick to the light jobs.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, all right. Let's talk again, once you've got the little one down.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, Dad, eat properly. I'll be in touch.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, take care.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Dad, what are you doing, have you been fishing?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just got back, didn't catch much today, haha. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I have. It's turned chilly in Gumi — how is it in Incheon?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's a bit cold morning and evening here too. Are you keeping well? Are you still going to the workshop?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I've been enjoying working with leather lately. But apart from that I've been thinking of doing a part-time job with my spare time

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? What have you got in mind

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Just looking for something mornings only, at a local café or supermarket. It's not urgent, I'm looking around at my own pace

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, take your time, don't overdo it. When I worked at the industrial complex I noticed morning part-time work is easier on the body

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: True. The hourly rate matters, but honestly talking to people matters more to me

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's right, that's surprisingly important. After I retired, being around people turned out to be the best thing — that's why I go to the singing class

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: True, you said the singing class was fun. I'll let you know once I decide

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, look into it at your own pace, and call once you've decided. Tell me if there's anything I can help with

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I will. And dress warmly when you go fishing, Dad

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, don't worry. Let's talk again

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Hey, it's me. You're not busy, are you?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Oh, what's the occasion at this hour, calling and all. Nothing wrong?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: No, I'm doing well. How's the welfare centre preparation going for you?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Getting by, I'm all over the place with the paperwork. Weren't you saying you were transferring units?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, I have to move next month, and that's why I called. Do you remember me? What you used to tease me about when we were looking for a flat together

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Ah, that — you miscalculated the deposit and I gave you the nickname 'number-blind'

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That's it, only you know that. Good, so it really is you — I was just checking

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Hey, what's this checking all of a sudden. So are you short on moving costs?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I'm a bit short on the quarters deposit, so I wondered if you could lend me a million for a few days. It's not urgent, so give it whenever you can

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: That much is fine. But the account is the same KB Bank one as before, right?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, still using that account. Shall I read out the number again in case it's confusing?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Yes, go on, read it out

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: One moment — is this right? Check the last digits of the KB Bank account

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Yes, that's right, I'll send it tomorrow morning. Good luck with the move

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Thanks, send it whenever suits. Take care, and good luck with the paperwork

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: All right, good luck with the move and let's talk again

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's been a while

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it has. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same as ever. How's your health? You said you weren't feeling great last time

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's better now. I've put on a bit of weight, mind, haha

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's a relief. I just called because I was bored, I wanted to hear your voice

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sure, I've nothing to do either so it's good

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Do you watch the news? There's been another fuss at the National Assembly

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I saw, they're fighting over the budget bill, apparently

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's right. But I can't work out exactly what they're fighting about

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I don't know the details either, but I think the parties keep sparring over the budget allocation ratios

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, I see. So will it actually pass this time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Well, the news said they'd reach agreement within this week, but who knows

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Politics is confusing however much you watch. Still, I'm curious so I keep watching

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly. Anyway, let's get a meal sometime when you're free

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Sounds good, let's be in touch. Look after yourself

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, let's talk again

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's me, Sujeong. You must have been startled getting a call from this number?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Huh? Oh, it was an unknown number so I nearly didn't answer. Have you changed phones?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: No, that's not it — I dropped my phone taking the kids to their class and the screen died. So I've borrowed the neighbour's phone.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Oh dear. But is this really Sujeong? Do you remember the name of that snack shop in front of Gimcheon market when we were children?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That's Halmae Tteokbokki, the one that gave you free sundae broth. Why are you asking that, you startled me.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Haha, I was just checking. Then let me see your face on video for a moment — how would you show me with a dead screen?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, I'll call on video from the neighbour's phone, one moment.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Ah, it really is you, seeing your face puts my mind at rest. Are the children growing well?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, they're both getting on at school. My eldest started middle school so we're all over the place with the adjustment.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: I see. I've been all over the place with work lately. Anyway, what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Well, my eldest's class fees are a bit behind this month, and with having to buy a new phone as well it's a bit tight. Could you lend me 300,000 won?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Ah, that much of course. It's not urgent, so take your time — as long as it's sent today?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, thank you, as long as it's before she goes to class this evening.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: All right, I'll send it to the usual Nonghyup account, the number's the same?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, still using that account. Thanks, I'll call as soon as I've got the new phone.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: All right, eat properly with the children. Let's talk again this evening.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, hello, it's me! How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, what's the occasion, you calling and all, I'm doing well. Isn't work busy these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Don't ask, work's been chaos lately. How about you, is the weather nice in Taean?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: The wind's been a bit strong here but working with a view of the sea is nice. Are you eating properly?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Getting by. Oh, that's right, it's not urgent but I called because there's something I wanted to ask — have you got a moment?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's fine, take your time, what is it?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: The thing is, my hair's got so long I want to cut it — where was that salon you go to?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, the one I go to? It's a small shop over in Jung-gu and the owner is very skilled

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, really? I only need a cut — are they good for that too?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course, she specialises in cuts, I only ever go for cuts. But do book, it gets busy

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, you have to book. Could you give me the number?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, one moment, I'll find it and text it to you

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thank you, I'll go this weekend if I've got time

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, and tell me how it went afterwards

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Will do, and you eat properly, and let's see each other soon

turns.speaker: Self

turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. Yes, I'm doing well, how about you? Is your mother all right?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, she's fine these days. Anyway, isn't the truck work hard for you these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't ask, I don't know why the roads are so congested lately. It seems far worse than before

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, really? Same in Busan, especially at rush hour, absolutely gridlocked

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, right, even when I set off early in the morning I'm on edge about being late

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's genuinely rough. I'm on the afternoon shift today so I've got time to hear more

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Then let's talk properly. Honestly, even the sat-nav is useless these days, everything's blocked

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Haha, exactly, I've been thinking of cycling to work myself

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that'd be good. Busan has decent cycle paths, doesn't it?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, the coastal ones are genuinely good so I want to try

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Nice, maybe I'll cycle around too once things quieten down here

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, give it a go, it'd be less stressful too

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, let's talk again. Give my regards to your mother

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, thank you, and you drive safely! Bye now

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hello, it's me, is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's fine. What's this about?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Nothing much, how have you been? It's been a while since I saw you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It has, I've been all over the place wrapping up a project. How about you?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Much the same. Anyway, that external meeting next week — that's why I called.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that meeting, why?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: My car is in for repairs at the moment, so I wondered if you could give me a lift that day.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's no trouble. What time should we set off?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: It's not urgent, so you can settle that at your own pace, there are still a few days.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Then I'll text you the day before to confirm. We'll fix the time then.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, lovely, and I'll buy the coffee that day.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, that suits me. I'll take it as arranged, then.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, thank you, see you later.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, take care.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, it's me, is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, love, yes it's fine. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I have. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Just now. Anyway, how's your back

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, I meant your back, Mum — how is it these days

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Same as ever, I'm still going for physiotherapy

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That's a relief, don't overdo it

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, that dental treatment I mentioned before — I've arranged it for this week

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, right, how much will it be?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 800,000 won, apparently

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Goodness, that's a lot. Does the medical insurance cover it?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: A bit, but it still comes to a fair amount

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Shall I chip in if it's hard? It's not urgent, so think it over

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: No, it's all right, I'll manage. I just wanted to tell you

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Still, say so any time if it's hard, I've got a bit spare in my account

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Thanks, Mum, I'll say if I really need it. I'll call again

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's been a while, it's me. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? I know exactly who it is from your voice. What have you been up to, it really has been a while.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, do you remember the name of that pojangmacha we always went to? The one where the owner always gave us extra.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Wasn't that Silbijip? The one with the rich sundae gukbap broth. Of course I remember, why all of a sudden.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: You're the only one, haha. Nothing much, it just came to mind. Anyway, something good has happened.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Something good? What is it, don't leave me hanging.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I've actually been seeing someone, and we've decided to get married. We're both of an age so we're keeping it modest.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hey, really? Congratulations! Why are you only telling me now, that hurts.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Sorry, sorry, I've been all over the place. Anyway, I've been getting a ring — shall I show you a photo?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, go on, show me. I'm curious what it's like.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: This is it, it's nice, isn't it? Actually, I came up a bit short paying for it — sorry, but could you spot me about 300,000 won?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that much is fine. Is it urgent?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: No, not urgent, anytime within this week is fine. No pressure.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, give me the account. Where should I send it?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, I'll send you the account number. Thanks, really, and I'll definitely invite you to the wedding.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course I'll be there. Congratulations, good luck with the preparations, and let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Have you been keeping well?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, yes, what's the occasion all of a sudden.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: You just came to mind. How's your health these days?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Getting by. I've started badminton again.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Oh, that's good. And your knee is all right?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: It's fine, I play carefully. Anyway, isn't driving the train hard on you.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I'm used to it. Anyway, how are things at my brother's house, nothing uncomfortable?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Uncomfortable, no, everyone treats me well, it's fine. I even sing a bit of trot these days.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Haha, that's good. I was thinking of coming down on my next day off — when would suit you?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Come any time, I've plenty of time.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Then I won't fix it in a hurry, I'll check my roster and get back to you.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, yes, take your time, don't push yourself for nothing.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: All right, take care and keep well until I see you.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, and you drive safely. Thanks for calling.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, oh, it's been a while, how are you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while, I'm just going along the same as ever

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: How's work, is the apartment side busy?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's fairly quiet at the moment. The kitchen must still be busy for you?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Don't ask, we've had so many customers I've been all over the place. Anyway, I've got hooked on buying kitchen supplies online lately

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? I order a lot of cleaning supplies online too

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, it's definitely convenient, but bundling things together to save on delivery means I end up buying things I don't need

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, my card bill has gone up a bit because of that too

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I've switched a lot of my ingredient buying online as well, comparing suppliers makes it far cheaper

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Maybe I should compare the cleaning contractors we use at the management office

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, you definitely save as much as you put the legwork in, though the really cheap places are a bit disappointing on quality

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That'd be right, finding somewhere reasonable is the hard part

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly. Anyway, it's been good talking, let's get a meal sometime

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I'll be in touch when the timing works. Take care

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's me. It's been a while, hasn't it?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while, how've you been? The shop must be busy?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Don't ask, with this weather the customers are down and handling the wok is killing me

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I've been all over the place with air conditioner repair calls. I go round ten-odd houses a day and there's nothing left of me

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, well, it's not urgent, so take it slowly and look after yourself

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I should. Anyway, the heatwave news is genuinely serious, apparently heat-illness deaths are up too

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, I saw the news as well. It must be really hard for outdoor workers — we're practically in a sauna standing in front of the flames in the kitchen too

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: There are times I get genuinely dizzy working in front of an outdoor unit. There ought to be some kind of measure for this

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: At least the government says it's supporting heatwave measures, though I don't know how much it'll actually help

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly. Anyway, let's both drink plenty of water and look after ourselves, don't overdo it

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, you too. Once this summer's over we should see each other, get a drink after so long

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sounds good, let's be in touch once it cools down. It was good talking today

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, take care, and I'll be in touch again

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me! Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's fine, I've eaten and I'm resting. What's up?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I just wanted to hear your voice. How's your back these days? Don't overdo it at work.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's fine, work's been fairly sparse lately so I've been taking it easy. How about you, are you and your husband well?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, we're fine. It's nothing urgent, I was just bored so I called, we can take our time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, all right, so is there anything fun going on?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, do you watch YouTube these days? I've got completely hooked on a camping vlog channel.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Camping vlogs? I don't know about that sort of thing, I just put the news channel on in the evening.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: There's a Netflix drama as well — we could watch it together if you've got time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I don't even know how to watch Netflix, but if you show me later I'll give it a go.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I'll install it on your tablet next time I'm round. Then we can watch something fun together.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, lovely. But don't stay up too late, and don't watch too much, it's bad for your eyes.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: All right, Mum, I'll call again. Take care!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, sleep well and be good to your husband.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, hello, it's me. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. How's the shop these days?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Just getting by. My back's not been great, it's been a struggle lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh dear, your back? Don't overdo it, go and see a doctor.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I should. It's not urgent though, so I'll go when I've got time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, don't put it off, haha. Oh, that's right, that thing you asked about before, the kitchenware site.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ah, right, right, that. Is it any good? Is the delivery fast?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, mine came in two days. Though it's best to compare prices before you buy.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: True, I've been comparing this and that and still haven't bought anything, haha.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Do you pay by card, or bank transfer?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Just the card I always use. Bank transfer makes me a bit uneasy.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, the card's easier for me too. Send me a photo when you buy it.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: All right. It was good hearing all that, let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, yes, and mind your back. Take care.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Er... the number's unfamiliar, isn't it?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Huh? What's this number, I don't know it. Who is this?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's me, your daughter, my phone screen is cracked so I've borrowed my sister's phone for a moment

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, right... the voice sounds right, but let me ask one thing just in case. What did I call you when you were little?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Kongsuni. You always called me that, haha

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: That's it, that's it, Kongsuni. Now I'm sure from your voice. But shall we do this on video while we're at it?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, good, hold on... (video connects) It's nice seeing your face, Dad

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: It is, it's been a while. Are you still going for walks by Tangeumho? Baking bread too?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I still walk every morning and bake bread now and then. I feel a bit more settled

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: That's a genuine relief. So what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: The phone screen repair costs a fair bit, so sorry, but could you send a few tens of thousands to that Shinhyup account I used before?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, I know that account, the one you always use. If it's not urgent I'll send it this evening, no rush

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, whenever is fine. Thanks, Dad

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, take care. Let's see each other next time you're down in Cheongju

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I will, and look after your health, Dad. Bye now

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's me. You keeping well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. How's work, busy?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just getting by. I rest at weekends and so on. You must be all over the place with the baby?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't ask, I'm run off my feet with the baby even at weekends. Anyway, what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, nothing urgent, I just wanted to talk. I went climbing last week

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, climbing? Outdoors, not indoors?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, outdoor rock. There's a decent spot near Asan

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Weren't you scared? I can't stand heights

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: My legs were shaking at first but it got fun as I went. Feel in your fingertips matters a lot, and I suppose working with my hands helps with that

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, you're good with your hands. Take me sometime, when you've got time

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Of course, we'll pick a day at our own pace and go together. You can hire the gear so there's no pressure

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Sounds good, I'll find a weekend once the baby's down

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, tell me whenever suits. I only called to tell you about it

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Thanks, I enjoyed hearing it. Let's talk again soon

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, take care, see you

turns.text: Oh, hello, it's me. How are you keeping?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I'm doing fine. What's the occasion, you calling and all

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Nothing, it's just turned so cold all of a sudden. You've not caught a cold?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'm all right so far, but it really has been cold since yesterday. How about you?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: My throat's a bit rough, maybe from having the heater up high while driving. Still, it's bearable

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You drive at night a lot, you need to be especially careful then

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: True, true. Anyway, the thing is, I've got something personal on next Tuesday

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, yes, is something the matter?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Something family-related, and I wondered if you could swap shifts with me that day. It's not urgent though, so think it over and tell me whenever

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, is that so? I've nothing particular on Tuesday so it should be fine, but let me check and get back to you

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, all right, and if you can't I'll ask someone else, so just tell me whenever

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, understood. I'll check and text you this evening

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Thank you, really. It's cold, so wrap up warm

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, and watch out for that cold while you're driving. I'll be in touch later

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. You keeping well?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, love. What's the occasion, calling at this hour.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Nothing, how's your back these days? You said you were going to the doctor last time.

turns.text: Yes, it's much better. More to the point, are you still writing cover letters?

turns.text: Yes, that's what I called about. I want to take a marketing certification course this time and the fee is a bit steep.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: How much is it? Hang on, though, your voice sounds odd — is that really you? Have you got a cold?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, right, my throat's been a bit hoarse the last few days. What's got into you, Dad, don't you know me?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Haha, no, just checking. Then do you remember what I bought you for your birthday last year?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: You bought me a laptop case, in the colour I wanted. Honestly, Dad.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Right, that's it. Then let's see your face, shall we switch to video?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Good, hold on.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, that's you, it's nice seeing your face. So how much is the fee?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 400,000 won. Could you send it to that account you sent the tuition to last time?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, I know that account. It's not urgent today, is it? I'll check at my own pace and send it within the week.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, the course starts next month so there's time. Thanks, Dad.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, work hard. Eat properly, and let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, hello? It's me, how have you been?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's been a while. How's work, isn't the driving hard?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I just get on with it. How about you? The building cleaning must be hard, and the weather's warming up too.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Don't ask, the fine dust has been bad again lately. I can't even open the windows while I clean, it's killing me.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, true, when I'm driving my throat gets rough on the bad dust days too. Come to think of it, I saw an interesting piece of news about that.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, what is it? I'm curious.

turns.text: Samsung Electronics has made a new filter that catches fine dust and harmful gases at the same time, and apparently you don't need to change it for about twenty years.

turns.speaker: Coworker

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly, apparently it uses ceramic material and a photocatalyst so it lasts a long time. Maintenance costs would drop a lot too.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Wow, that's good. Science and technology really do move fast these days, it's remarkable.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, I found it remarkable watching the news and wanted to tell you.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Thank you, I've heard some good news thanks to you. Let's get a meal sometime when you're free.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, lovely, I'll be in touch soon. Look after your health!

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: All right, and drive safely. Let's talk again!

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's me. How've you been? I've not heard from you at all lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while! I'm the same as ever, the school kitchen has been a bit busy.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just getting by. How about you, is the training hard?

turns.text: It's fairly quiet at the moment. Nothing urgent, so I called thinking we'd just have a relaxed chat today.

turns.text: Oh, I never miss it! Watching it after I've put the baby down is my treat.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That actor on it — they really do look after themselves as they age. We talk about it at the base a lot too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, right, I'm amazed every time I see them. What on earth do they eat.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly, whereas we do overtime and training and just age on the spot.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, true. Running around the kitchen, I feel it more by the day.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Anyway, I called because I wanted to talk about that. Tell me if there's anything else good to watch.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, and I'll message you if I find something fun. Let's get a meal sometime.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Sounds good, let's find a time soon. Take care and let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, and take care in training, let's talk again!

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, it's me. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. What have you been up to?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Work's been busy so I've been living in a blur. Is the site work still hard for you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It is, I've been out at a site in Siheung, though it's easier now the weather's milder. And I rest at weekends.

turns.speaker: Friend

turns.text: No, it's not urgent, the place is just getting old and I want to redo the wallpaper and the bathroom, but I don't know how to start.

turns.speaker: Friend

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, lovely, tell me later. And jeonse prices have gone up a bit so that's a worry, but there's nothing to be done about it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, I hear a lot about that lately too. But everyone's living the same way.

turns.speaker: Friend

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, lovely, let's meet up soon. Take care.
