turns.text: Not yet, but watching the TV lately there are so many cosmetics adverts. Even at my age it makes you want to look after yourself.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, right, even at our age people do a lot of that now. The men in my neighbourhood were boasting recently about the good skin lotion they use.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Goodness, so men pay attention now too. I want to buy a basic product but I don't know what's good.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It's not urgent, look at your own pace, there are a lot of reviews on YouTube these days.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll look and tell you if I find something decent.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, and there are a lot of winter padded coats out too, Busan follows the trends as well.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, I was thinking of buying one. But something plain, not in a garish colour.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Then let's go round the market together next time we meet, I need to look at clothes too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Lovely, I'll come and visit before winter.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: All right, take care, let's be in touch.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, thank you. Keep well!

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hello, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's fine. Hello, what's the occasion at this hour

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Nothing much. Is the driving manageable these days? It must have got much colder in Sejong too?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's a bit chilly lately but it's manageable. It must be cold in Gumi too?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: My hands are cold in the mornings here too, haha. Anyway, the thing is, there's that in-house safety training, and the completion deadline is coming up

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that? I haven't taken it either... is there something you need me to check?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I can't find the link to the training materials. If you've got the email, could you screenshot it and send it?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, yes, it should be in my inbox. But I'm driving at the moment — could I check and send it this evening?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Of course, it's not urgent, send it at your own pace. The deadline is next week so there's plenty of time

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, understood, I'll find it and send it as soon as I finish work

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Thank you. Drive safely today, let's talk later

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, take care

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me, is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's fine, I've finished work and I'm resting. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I have, I went out on a forest survey today and got back late. Is work busy for you, Mum?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't ask, it's year-end closing season so I'm all over the place. Anyway, what's the occasion, calling and all?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I just wanted to hear your voice. Oh, but people at work keep talking about dating.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Has someone caught your eye?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: It's not that, but everyone's talking about marriage so it got me thinking. Aren't you curious when I'll marry, Mum?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course I'm curious, why wouldn't I be. But it's not urgent, you can think it over at your own pace. It's your life, there's no need to rush.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: True, that's what I think too. Though there aren't many people to meet in Chuncheon, which is a bit frustrating.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: If it's meant to be you'll meet them. It was the same when I was young, there's nothing to be impatient about.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Haha, all right. Talking to you about this is just easy.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I like this sort of talk too. Are you coming home next weekend?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I'll come if I can. We'll talk more then.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, keep well, let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, hello, what are you doing?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, I've finished work and I'm out walking the dog. How about you?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I've just finished too. Anyway, isn't it really chilly out?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it genuinely wasn't like this until yesterday and today it's turned cold all of a sudden

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same here in Jeju. The wind is completely different morning and evening

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly, going out in short sleeves in the morning and regretting it in the evening is my daily life at the moment

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Haha, that's why I carry an outer layer morning and evening now

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's not urgent, but apparently it gets colder this weekend, get your clothes out in advance

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, really? I haven't even got the winter duvet out yet

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I only just got mine out yesterday. And there have been mornings with mist over Daecheongho already

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: The sea wind is strong here so it feels worse, I think

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, isn't the autumn foliage pretty in Jeju? Take some photos and send them

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, the foliage round Hallasan is genuinely pretty lately, I'll send photos later

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Lovely, I've taken some photos of Daecheongho too, I'll send them

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: All right, let's talk again, watch out for colds

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, and dress warmly. See you tomorrow

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's me. How've you been? Isn't it very cold in Changwon these days?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's been a while. But your voice sounds tired, have you been on overtime?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, I just finished a bit late tidying the shop. Isn't the loading work hard for you? Is your back all right?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: I'm managing. Anyway, do you remember what nickname you called me as a child, I'm suddenly curious.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That was Teddy Bear, wasn't it, because you were chubby as a kid, haha

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: That's it, that's right, that was it. Anyway, what did you call about, nothing much going on?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, nothing much, it's about Mum and Dad's birthdays next month.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Ah, that's right, it's come round already. What are you planning?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I want the family to gather at a restaurant, something modest, and I wondered if you and I could split the cost.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Yes, of course we should. How much should we each put in?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 100,000 won each should do. Get in touch whenever suits.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: All right. I send it to the account we used before, don't I?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, that same account. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Don't be silly, it's their birthday. Let's be in touch again, take care.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, and mind your back, let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, hello.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's me. You're off duty today, aren't you?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, that's right, it's been a while. You keeping well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just getting by. How about you, aren't the shifts hard?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Same as ever. Though I've got a bit of room lately so I've been out and about at weekends.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Where have you been?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I went to a gallery near Bundang last week. There was a photography exhibition on.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, I like that sort of thing. What kind of photography exhibition was it?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Photos of old railway station scenes. I'm a train driver, so it caught my eye all the more.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, true, that'd be right up your street. I've booked a small play over in Eunpyeong-gu.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, what's it about?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's an unusual piece about environmental pollution. The title was unusual too and I was curious, so I booked.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That sounds good. I should look out for something like that too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, let's go together when you're free. I'll be in touch again.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: All right, lovely. See you next time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, of course, I've just finished work and I'm resting. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, same as ever for me. Have you got a lot on these days?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I have, the volume is high so I'm all over the place. Though I've got some room today so I could take the call.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's good. It's not urgent, I just called wanting to hear your voice.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Good. Oh, you said you wanted to get a dog, didn't you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's right, but living on my own, when it comes to it I do worry.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: We worried about that too and ended up with a cat. She's surprisingly little work, which is easy.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Cats are definitely more independent. But I like being greeted the way a dog does.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Then look at small breeds, plenty of people keep them in studio flats these days. And you get walks together, which is nice.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True. Send me photos of your cat sometime, so I can prepare myself.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, I'll send them on chat later. She's put on weight lately and got quite round, haha.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: She must be sweet. And you eat properly and don't overdo it.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, and you look after yourself, and send me photos when you get the dog.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, understood. I'll be in touch again.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, I have. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I'm about to. I had some work on so I'm eating late.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't eat too late, it's bad for your stomach. Anyway, nothing much going on today?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: No, nothing much, I just called wanting to hear your voice.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, yes, I've nothing much on either. Anyway, I've been thinking about when I was courting your mother.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, really? How did it go? I've never heard the details.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I used to take the bus from Busan all that way to see her. Thinking about it now it was hard, but it didn't feel hard then.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Looking at people at work these days, nobody puts in that sort of effort. Everyone wants easy.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, young people meeting without putting pressure on each other seems good too. It's a different era.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: You're very open-minded, Dad. Anyway, did Mum like you at first?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Not at first, no, I kept chasing after her. Asking her to come and watch the baseball.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: So the baseball goes way back. I'll tell stories like that when I'm dating too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, if there's someone good, take your time getting to know them. There's no need to rush.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, understood. It's been nice hearing the old stories since I called. I'll call again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, eat properly and let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello? It's me, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's been a while! I'm well. How about you, is your mother keeping well?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, she's getting by. The weather's cooled down so she seems a bit better.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's good. Work has been busy for me but it's quietened down now.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Really? Then we should rest. The factory has quietened down too so I've got some room.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's good. Then I was thinking we could go somewhere in the autumn.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, lovely! I saw the autumn foliage spots on TV lately and wanted to go.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Where looked good? I haven't got anywhere particular in mind.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Naejangsan was on. The foliage was genuinely beautiful, and the walking paths are good.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that'd be lovely. I think Gyeongju would be good too, the night views there are pretty.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, right, Gyeongju is good too. Let's match up our times and go.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, let's fix the dates later once we've both looked at our schedules. It's not urgent.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, we can decide at our own pace. I've got my mother's hospital appointments to look at too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, let's do that. It's good to hear your voice today, let's talk again soon.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, look after yourself. I'll be in touch again!

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, hello, it's me! You keeping well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. I'm well, how about you, is the baby growing?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, they've started walking lately so I'm genuinely all over the place. What have you been up to?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just working with some data at home... nothing special. Shall we talk later if you're busy?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: No, the baby's napping so it's fine, it's not urgent, let's take our time

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, that's good then. Anyway, what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Nothing much, I was watching the news today and Evergrande in China was back on it. Apparently the debt problem is growing again

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that, I saw it too. The company that nearly defaulted before

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, right, but this time they say it could genuinely collapse, and the impact on the property market would be big

turns.speaker: Self

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, but does it not really affect us? I only asked out of curiosity

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It wouldn't be completely unrelated, but I'd guess the direct hit is less. We'll just have to watch

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, it's not as if we can do anything about it. Anyway, thanks for the chat

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Not at all, I enjoyed it. Take care of the baby and let's be in touch again

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, let's talk again, bye!

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Hello? Oh, what's this number, it's not saved.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, it's me, my phone screen went so I went to a shop and swapped the SIM temporarily. Do you remember me? When you had me on the back of your bike as kids and we both ended up in the paddy ditch.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Ah, that's right, that, you scraped your knees and I got told off by Mum. Hey, now I can tell from your voice.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: How've you been? Is work very busy?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Yes, getting by. The freight volume has gone up a bit so I'm all over the place, but it's manageable. How about you? Are the kids growing well?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, the younger one is talking more and is very loud, haha. Is everything all right with your wife?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Yes, everyone's well. Anyway, is something up, is that why you called? Your voice sounds a bit rushed.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: No, it's not urgent, but two months of nursery fees and the card bill have landed together this month and it's a bit tight. I wondered if I could borrow a million won for a few days.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: All right, understood, if it's not urgent I'll stop by the bank this evening and send it. It's the same account you sent to my wife before, isn't it?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, that same account. If you're busy, anytime this week is fine.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Still, just in case, let's do a video call, it'd be better to talk face to face.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, lovely, I'll call on video now.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Yes, seeing your face I'm sure, I was worried when you said the number had changed. All right, I'll send it this evening.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Thank you. I'll come and visit with the kids sometime.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: All right, take care. And give my regards to your wife.

turns.text: Mum, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, just now. How about you? Have you fed the little one properly?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I have. They've been eating well lately, thankfully.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: That's good. Anyway, how are you these days, how's the weight going?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah... no real difference yet, but I'm trying to walk a bit.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, take your time, don't overdo it. You mustn't wreck your health.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, understood. Have you been anywhere lately, Mum? You said you were going on a history tour.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, yes, I went over to Suncheon last week. It was good, walking while hearing the old stories.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That must have been lovely. You really do like that sort of thing.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, I do. Anyway, are you looking into work at all?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I've sent applications to a few places but no word yet. It's not urgent, so I'm looking at my own pace.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, don't think of it as urgent. It's harder doing it while raising a child.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Still, seeing the little one smile does give me strength.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Of course, that's all strength. Eat properly, and I'll call again.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, and look after yourself, Mum. Let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. What are you doing?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, son, I've had dinner and I'm watching TV. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Of course I have. Are you still going out walking?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Of course, up Cheonggyesan every day. Anyway, what's with your voice, is something the matter?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, well... I hurt my hand at work. Not badly, but I think I need to get it looked at.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What? Hurt your hand? Does it hurt a lot? Have you been to the hospital?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I went to A&E. But it's the ligament so I need more outpatient treatment. It'll cost a bit but it's not urgent.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What do you mean it's not urgent, your health comes first. How much do you think the treatment will be?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I don't know exactly, about 300,000 won, I think. I'm checking whether it's covered by work insurance.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: I'll just chip in while you're checking whether it's covered. I send it to the account you always use, don't I?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, that account. Thank you, there's no rush.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, I'll send it tomorrow morning. And tell me straight away if you're hurt, all right?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, understood. And mind you don't fall while you're out walking, Dad.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, don't worry. Don't overdo it until your hand heals, let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, that's my son's voice. Yes, it's fine, I was making dinner. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, just getting by. Anyway, do you still walk up the hill behind the house at dawn?

turns.text: Sometimes. Oh, that's right, do you remember falling and hurting your knee up there when you used to come with me?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, at the steps? You carried me on your back all the way to the pharmacy. I must have been in primary school.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: That's it, that's right, that was it. You remember it well. How's your health these days, is the certification study going well?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Getting by. Anyway, Mum, the registration for that exam closes next week and I need the registration fee.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, is that so? How much do you need?

turns.speaker: Parent

turns.speaker: Family

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, all right. Eat properly, and call again if the exam prep gets hard.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, understood, thank you. And watch out for colds, Mum.

turns.text: All right, I'm hanging up, son.

turns.text: That's rough. I've had more office work lately so I'm all over the place too.

turns.text: Still, you've got to look after yourself. I've been going to the sauna to unwind.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Good for you. It's not urgent either, so rest as you go.

turns.speaker: Friend

turns.speaker: Friend

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, there's no need to rush. Send me photos once you've decided.

turns.text: All right, let's talk again. Keep well!

turns.text: Yes, look after yourself, see you next time!

turns.text: Hey, it's me, how are you keeping?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It is a bit. Anyway, how's your health these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Getting by. My son's grown a bit so I've got some time now.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, you've got some room. That's good.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: So the thing is, I'm thinking of coming up to Seoul next month. To do a bit of culture for a change.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, lovely. Is there something you want to see?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Nothing decided, but you live over in Mapo. Recommend an exhibition or a show nearby if there's one that's decent.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: If it's not urgent I'll look into it and tell you, the things at the small theatres round here have been decent lately.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, lovely, I'm looking forward to it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, understood. Once I've picked something we could go together on the day you're up.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Lovely, lovely, let's be in touch then.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, look after yourself, see you soon.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's me! Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Oh, what's the occasion at this hour, isn't this your rest time once the kids are down?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I've got a moment. How are things, have you heard back from that interview?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: No word yet. Just getting by. Aren't the kids wearing you out?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's fine, they're sweet so I hardly notice. Anyway, I've actually got a favour to ask.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: What is it? Saying favour all of a sudden makes me nervous, what's up?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's Mum's birthday next week, and my pay is a bit tight this month, so I wondered if you could chip in for the present.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Ah, that's right, her birthday. But is that really you? What was the dog we had called, I'm suddenly curious.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: What are you on about, that was Kong, the brown Jindo mix. What's got into you, this isn't an exam.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Haha, no, apparently there are a lot of odd calls these days so I just asked. Shall we switch to video for a moment so we can talk face to face?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Good, let's do that, hold on, I'll turn the camera on.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Yes, that's my brother all right. Anyway, it's not urgent, so I can send it at my own pace?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, as long as it's here before her birthday. I send it to the account I used before, don't I?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Yes, I still use that account so I'll send it there. I should pay you back once I've got a job, sorry about that.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: What are you on about, we're family. I hope the job search goes well, let's get a meal soon.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: All right, give Mum my regards. Take care and let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, what's the occasion, calling and all

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Oh, I just thought I'd hear your voice after a while, you keeping well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just getting by. How's work for you these days? Busy?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Don't ask, I'm genuinely all over the place preparing a local campaign

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, is that the one you mentioned before, to do with the regional festival?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, that's it, but I urgently need a part-timer to work the desk and there's nobody about

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, really? Is it urgent? I'll have a think about who I know

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: No, no, it's not urgent, you can look at your own pace, I only need someone by next week

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I see, that's a relief. Anyway, what are the terms, the hourly rate and so on

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: The rate isn't bad, and it's simple reception work so it's not difficult, though the dress needs to be fairly smart

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, semi-office wear, that sort of thing? Our company pays a lot of attention to that too

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, exactly that feel, though you're in sales so you'd be used to it

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course, we're round clients every day so we pay a lot of attention to clothes. Oh, anyway, how's the weight going for you

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Ah, don't ask, I've been on overtime and can't exercise so I think I've only put more on

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, still, look after your health. Anyway, I'll be in touch about the part-time job if I know anyone

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: All right, thank you, let's get a meal when you're free

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's fine. What's the occasion, calling at this hour.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Nothing, I wondered how you were. Nothing much going on at work?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as ever. My eyes are about to fall out testing reagents lately. Are you still on nights?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, I'm on nights this week. So I'm a bit tired, but I'm all right.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Take it easy so you don't wreck your health. So what's this about?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Well, I need a switchboard component and I saw a group buy posted online. But the payment screen confuses me a bit.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, which site is it? I've done that a few times so I might know.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: It's an industrial supplies site, and you need a minimum number of people for the discount. I'd like you to take a look.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, it's nothing difficult. I'm looking at reagent results right now — can I look after work?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, yes, it's not urgent. The deadline is this weekend so you can look at your own pace.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, text me the link. I'll check after work and call.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Thank you. You're the only one I can ask about this sort of thing.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: What are you on about, it's nothing. I'm only telling you in advance because it might take a while this evening.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, understood. I'll wait to hear from you later. Eat properly.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, and take care on nights. I'll call later.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hello, have you had dinner?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I have, I just had a bowl of noodles and came out. How's the factory work these days?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Don't ask, my wrist was a bit stiff today. Still, it always is, haha

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't overdo it, take it easy. Anyway, what's the call about?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ah, nothing much, I bought some leathercraft materials online lately and it was interesting so I wanted to tell you. It's not urgent, I'm just bored

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, they sell leather materials online too? Where did you buy?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: On Naver Shopping. A set of cowhide offcuts, a bit over ten thousand won

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's a decent price. I bought some fishing tackle online recently, though the delivery took a while

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Still, it's easier than going in person. What did you buy?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: A few floats and sinkers. I didn't need them urgently so I chose at my own pace, waited a few days

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Same here, there's a pleasure in browsing and buying at your own pace. I'll set aside some good leather offcuts for you next time

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That'd be kind. And I'll sort you out with something next time I go fishing

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Lovely, haha. See you at work tomorrow, get some rest

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, see you tomorrow. Mind that wrist

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, it's me. You keeping well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. Just getting by.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: How's work these days, busy?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, same as ever. It must be hard for you being out on sales.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: It is. Anyway, being out and about lately, the weather really is strange.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, true, I thought that too. It was hot enough for short sleeves a few days ago and today it's proper winter.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Exactly, I spent ages this morning wondering what to wear.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: At this rate I wonder whether spring and autumn will disappear here too and we'll be left with just summer and winter.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: True, they say the climate is odd worldwide. We're no exception, it seems.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, it's not urgent, and what can we do about the weather. We can only dress properly.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: True, we'll just have to adapt at our own pace. Anyway, it's a shame I can't get out surfing.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, you surf, don't you, the water must be cold in this weather.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: It is, but with a wetsuit it's manageable. Let's go together when the weather improves.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Lovely, I've wanted to learn. I'll be in touch when the timing works.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: All right, watch out for colds and let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, and look after yourself. Take care.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Hello? Who is this, the number's unfamiliar.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, it's me, my phone screen is cracked so I'm calling from a friend's phone.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh dear, is that so? The voice sounds right... but let's be sure, what was the name of that restaurant we went to for my birthday last time?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That omakase place in Nam-gu, I booked it because you like raw fish.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: That's it, that's right, haha, it really is you. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I have. Was work hard today, Mum?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Same as ever, just as always. Anyway, how did the phone break, do be careful.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I dropped it taking it out of my bag. So the thing is, the repair costs a bit. Could you send it to the account I used before when you've got time?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, the one we always use? All right, how much do you need.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 200,000 won should do. You don't have to send it today, take your time.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, I'd like to see your face too, let's talk again later.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, lovely, it's a friend's phone so hold on, I'll call back later.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, seeing your face, it really is my daughter. I'll send it this evening.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, thank you, Mum, I'll be in touch as soon as I get a new phone.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, all right, take care. I'm hanging up.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's me. I changed my number so I'm calling from this one — it's unfamiliar, isn't it?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? The voice is familiar but I hadn't seen the number so I wondered who it was. Do you remember the name of that club we were in together?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: That was the accounting club, the one where you taught me Excel.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's it, now I remember your voice. How've you been? How's Ulsan these days, the weather?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Just getting by. I'm busy walking the dog. Is work going well in Daejeon?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I just go back and forth to the lab. Anyway, what did you call about? Your voice sounds a bit rushed.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Ah, nothing much, I'm preparing for the computerised accounting certification and I have to pay the registration fee rather urgently. Sorry, but could you lend it to me?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, is that it? All right, how much do you need?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: About 150,000 won. I'll pay you back as soon as I'm paid next week.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, but could you show me the registration screen? I'd just like to check.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, of course, I'll switch to video. One moment.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I can see the screen, and the registration deadline matches. Could you give me the account number?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, I'll text you the account. Thank you so much.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't be silly, it's nothing. Good luck with the exam and let's see each other sometime.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, I'll come and visit Daejeon. Thank you, take care.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just now. How about you? Isn't it hot in Busan these days?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: It's unbearably hot here too. Anyway, Mum, the news said something about the National Assembly amending working hours — did you see that?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I caught a bit of it. The one about adjusting the number of hours a week?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, that's it. There's a lot of talk about it at work too. But honestly I don't even know what's written in my contract, haha.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Really? What's odd about it, is there a problem?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Not odd exactly, but I got a new contract from the company this time and some of the clauses confuse me. You know a bit about law — could you look at it when you've got time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course. If it's not urgent, photograph it and send it over, I'll look at it at my own pace.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Then anytime within this week is fine. Thanks, Mum.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll read it carefully when you send it. Anyway, watching the political news lately, things keep changing, so companies seem to be watching their step too.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: True, that's why everyone's a bit on edge. Anyway, thanks to you my mind is a bit easier.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's nothing, that's what you should ask your mother about. Eat properly.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, and look after your health, Mum. I'll call again!

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, it's me! How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, what's this, what's the occasion, calling and all, I'm well, how about you?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just bored. Is the shop doing well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just getting by. Bread prices are up and flour is up so I'm all over the place. What have you been up to?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just drawing a bit and going for walks. Living like that.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: No, I've got a moment right now, it's a quiet time for customers. Anyway, did you see that news about free subway travel for the elderly?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, that! I saw it, I saw it. The one about whether to scrap it from 65?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, that's it. There's talk of raising the age threshold and talk of charging a fare, all sorts.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: But we'll be that age in a few years too. It doesn't feel like someone else's problem.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly. Though apparently the subway deficit is so big, which I can understand. It'll feel unfair from the older people's side, though.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, I can see both sides so it's hard to say which is right. Some older people can't even get to the hospital without it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly, and there's talk of dividing it by income, which is also ambiguous. Anyway, I hope we don't lose out when we're old.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Haha, exactly. Though it'll be a long time before there's a conclusion, there's nothing to rush, we can just watch.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, it's a slow-moving story. Anyway, it's been fun talking, let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, take care, and let's see each other next time!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, take care, thank you for calling!

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, it's me, is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, son, I've just finished my shift and I'm on my break. Is something the matter?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Nothing much, are you eating properly? I hear it's very cold in Gimcheon.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Getting by. How's work over in Gapyeong, busy?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Busy, but it's ticking along. Anyway, Mum, I actually called because I've got a favour to ask. I'm moving and I'm a bit short on the deposit.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh my, this is the first I've heard of you moving. Where are you going?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Somewhere a bit bigger than where I am now. It was decided suddenly so I couldn't tell you in advance, sorry.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: No, that's fine, but let me check something. Do you remember your nickname as a child? I feel easier when I ask this sort of thing.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Haha, that? Bread Boy, wasn't it, because I wouldn't leave the bakery. Why ask that all of a sudden.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: That's it, that's right, it's definitely my son. Apparently there are a lot of odd calls these days so I just asked.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Good, you're right to be careful. Then shall we talk face to face? I'll call on video.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, that'd be better, call on video.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Oh, it's nice seeing your face. Anyway, it's not urgent, as long as you send it within the week. You can think it over at your own pace.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: How much do you need? The account is the same one I sent your allowance to, isn't it?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, I still use that account. About three million should do.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, I'll send it tomorrow while I'm at the bank. Good luck with the move, and call if you need anything.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Thanks, Mum, take care, I'll come down to Gimcheon sometime.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's me, I'm in Daegu, how have you been?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's been a while! I'm well, how's the garage these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just the same, fixing cars for a living is fixing cars. Is Jeju treating you well?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: It's good here, though work has been busy so I'm all over the place

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Why, is bookkeeping always this busy?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: It's month-end settlement season. But I've been thinking of doing a part-time job at weekends

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Can you do a part-time job while employed? Doesn't the moonlighting rule catch you?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: It's not a public body so it should be fine, though it still feels a bit awkward

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I've been wondering about a second job too. Maybe designated driving in the evenings

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Wouldn't that wear you out? I'd like a weekend job somewhere like a library

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, working seven days a week is a bit much, isn't it?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Of course, I couldn't do seven days either. I'm only thinking of one weekend day

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That much would be all right. It's not urgent for me either so I'll look into it at my own pace

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, doing it without wrecking your health is what matters most

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, and don't overdo it, let's talk again

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: All right, let's get a meal next time, take care!

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Oh, you picked up.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, yes, son, what's the occasion at this hour. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Not yet, I've just finished work and I'm home. Is the site work still busy for you?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: It is, we've got steelwork going up so I'm a bit all over the place. Anyway, your voice sounds flat, is something the matter?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, well, I twisted my ankle at the site last week. I thought it was nothing but apparently the ligament is stretched.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What? Hey, why are you only telling me now, have you been to the hospital? Hang on, do you remember what you were eating when you cried after hurting your ankle as a child?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, that was banana milk, I fell and was crying and you bought me one and I stopped dead.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Haha, that's right, that's how it was. So, have you seen a doctor?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, they say I need physiotherapy, and I have to go for several weeks so it'll cost a bit. It's a bit tight on this month's pay.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, it's not urgent, take your time, how much do you need.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 300,000 won should do. Sorry to spring this on you.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Sorry, nothing, my son's hurt, of course I'll help. I'll send it to your account this weekend, you still use the same one?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, the same account. Thanks, Dad, I'll come and visit once I've had the treatment and healed.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, don't overdo it, look after yourself first, nothing matters if you're hurt. Take care of yourself.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Understood, and you be careful at the site, Dad. Take care!

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello? Oh, it's me, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's been a while. How's the shop these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same as every day. Though we've had more customers lately so I'm run off my feet.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that's good. Isn't it hard on you? There's a lot of work on the window side too so I'm all over the place.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It is hard but it's fun. Oh, that's right, it's not urgent, but I want to travel on my next holiday.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Where are you thinking?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I'm thinking Jeju — didn't you say you'd been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I went, a few years ago. It's easy if you get a hire car.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right? But I'm not a good driver... would public transport be all right?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's possible but it could be a bit inconvenient. The bus timings don't line up well.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, then I'll just call taxis. I'm planning to go with plenty of time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, better to look into it at your own pace before you go. Have you decided on somewhere to stay?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Not yet, I'm going to look at my own pace. I'd like somewhere with a sea view.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Around Seogwipo is decent, I'll send you photos for reference.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, lovely, lovely. Thank you, let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, have a safe trip. Let's be in touch again!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello, oh, son, what's the occasion at this hour

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Dad, I wondered whether you'd had dinner. Nothing much going on?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just now. Have you and the little one had dinner?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I've just bathed them and put them down. It's been a bit hectic lately, plenty of work on too

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, working while raising a child is hard. Don't overdo it, take it slowly

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, yes, though I've got a bit used to it now. Anyway, how's the site work these days, Dad?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, and it's got much colder, you've not caught a cold?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: The Icheon site is at the final stage so it's a bit busy. Though my blood pressure has been up so they've increased my medication

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, really? Are you keeping your food fairly plain?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I try, but everything you eat on site is salty so it's not easy

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Our place in Magok is finally sorted, though. Now the child's room is done it's liveable

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Good. Apparently Magok is nice these days, and good for raising children

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, there's a park nearby and a hospital close by, which is a relief

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, that's a relief. It'd be nice to move nearby and help with the little one when I retire

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: That'd be lovely. Look after your health, and I'll come down with the little one soon

turns.speaker: Self

turns.text: The temperature swing is big and it's genuinely below zero in the mornings

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, maybe that's why a lot of people at work have colds

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Anyway, there's a reason I called — maybe it's the cold, but my car hasn't been starting well in the mornings

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, is it the battery? That happens a lot in the cold

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, I think so. So the thing is, could you give me a lift tomorrow morning? On the way to work

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, of course, we're going the same way anyway, what time shall we set off?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: About eight should do. Thank you, sorry to spring it on you

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's fine, we should help each other in weather like this. See you at eight tomorrow

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, thank you! Sleep warm

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, and watch out for colds, see you tomorrow

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello, love! What were you doing?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, Mum, just lounging about in my room.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Have you eaten? It's chilly lately, don't catch a cold.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I've eaten, don't worry. Isn't work busy, Mum?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Busy enough. Though I've got some room today so I called.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Good, I was bored too. I've been playing a game on my phone lately and it's good.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: What game is it? Maybe I should try it when I'm bored.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: You know the raising games, growing a character. Time just vanishes.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I played something like that years ago, it's surprisingly a lot of work.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Right, right, but it relieves the stress. The job hunt isn't going well so I might as well.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't think of it as urgent, take your time, a good position will come up.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, thanks, Mum. Anyway, the graphics in this game are pretty so it's a treat for the eyes.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's good, small pleasures like that are enough.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, try it with me when you've got time, it's fun.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, show me sometime. Rest well today and let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, well done today, Mum, take care!

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, love, just now. Are you eating properly?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, getting by. It's turned chilly, are you keeping well?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Haha, same as ever for me. My knee aches a bit but it's bearable.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Oh, that's right, I went back to that hospital I mentioned. The tests and this and that came to a fair bit.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, that, how much was it? A lot?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: More than I expected, but I covered it with what I'd saved for now. It's not urgent so you don't need to worry.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Still, tell me if you're struggling. I can help a little too.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's all right, Dad, I'm getting ready to start work again so things will improve soon.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, don't rush, take your time. Wrecking your health would be worse.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, understood. And go to the doctor if your knee hurts, Dad, don't just put up with it.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Haha, all right. And you eat properly.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, and you have a proper dinner. I'll call again.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, take care, love.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello! Love, what are you doing?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, Mum, just lounging about in my room. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I grabbed something earlier. How's your back these days. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I have, I have. Anyway, Mum, it's nothing urgent, you just came to mind so I called — let's talk more this weekend if you're free.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, let's take our time. Anyway, has your brother's visiting date come through?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Ah, that's right! A text said the second Saturday of next month.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'm free that day too, so we can go together. Anyway, has he not said the training is hard?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Last time we spoke he said he'd got used to it. The food's good and the people are all right, apparently.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's a relief. I was so uneasy when he went off to the training camp.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Exactly. What shall we take when we visit? Shall we bring the fried chicken he likes?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Lovely, that and some fruit. Let's talk it over at our own pace this week.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, understood. Let's talk again at the weekend and settle it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, eat properly. I'm hanging up!

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, you too, Mum. Let's talk again!

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, Uncle, it's me. Have you been keeping well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's been a while. You must be busy teaching the children?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, just getting by. You must be all over the place, it being apple season?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I've been busy preparing for the harvest, but I can breathe now. I'm just resting watching TV in the evenings.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, that's right, are you watching anything good? I've been watching a documentary series and it's surprisingly addictive.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I just watch some variety shows. There's nothing I have to watch in a hurry, I just catch up at my own pace when I've got time.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I think you said you had Netflix Premium last time, is that right?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, that's right, it's only me and your aunt using it so there are spare slots.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Then could I join and use one? I'll send you the monthly fee separately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, there are spare slots anyway, just join and use it.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, thank you, Uncle. If you make a profile I'll sort myself out.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, understood. I'll make one this evening and text you.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, thank you, Uncle! I'll come and have some apples next time I'm down in Jangsu.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, come any time, and keep well.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's fine. I'm on my break so it's perfect for a call.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You must be very busy with the driving. Are you keeping well?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I'm managing. I'm running about for the children's academy fees. Is the security work manageable for you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, same as ever. Nothing much going on.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's good. Oh, I called because I was curious about something — do you buy clothes online much these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, sometimes. Why, are you looking to buy something?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I want a winter jacket, it's not urgent, I'm looking into it at my own pace. I wanted to ask where's good to buy.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I use Musinsa a lot lately. The sizing reviews are good and exchanges are easy.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ah, Musinsa? I haven't used it much, are the prices reasonable?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: If you time the sales well it's quite cheap. And the delivery's fast.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Then I should have a browse this weekend.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, understood. Send me a link if you find something you like.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, I will. Thank you for the tip today.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Not at all. Let's talk again, take care.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, it's me, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while, how's the weather in Seoul these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It's still a bit chilly here. Jeju must be warm already?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, the cherry blossom is starting to come out here. How's work, are you doing a lot of overtime?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same as ever. Anyway, it's not urgent but I've got something to ask, that's why I called.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Take your time, what is it?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I found a kitten while walking on Suraksan. I'm keeping it at home now but I don't know what food to give it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, good for you. How many months old does it look?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: The vet said about two months. But you know about food, so could you tell me what's good to feed it?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I know about human food, cats are a bit different. Still, I've seen a lot of hospital diets so I can help.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: So can I just buy any kitten food?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Choose one high in protein for now, and never give it human food. Especially not anything salty, and no milk.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, I was about to give it milk, that's a relief, I didn't. Thank you, really.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Good. Send me a photo later if you've got one, I'm curious.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, I'll send a photo this evening. Thank you, let's talk again soon.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, take care.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, it's me, are you asleep?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: No, no, I've just got in from work. What's up?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I just called out of boredom. What have you been up to?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as every day, security duty and home. How's the factory work for you?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same for me. Anyway, I've taken a dog into the house lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? Really? When did you get it?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: A bit over a month ago. Living alone was lonely, and a friend said he'd give me a puppy so I took it straight away.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Good for you. There's no rush, you just get attached at your own pace and raise it.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly. It whined at night at first so I couldn't sleep, but it's got used to things now.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: What breed? Is it going to grow big?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: A Jindo mix, I think, it just looks like a country dog. But it's very affectionate.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, lucky you. I kept one at home years ago, it brings it back.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Come and visit Paju when you've got time, I'll show you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Paju isn't that far. Yes, I'll pick a day and come. Eat properly and take good care of the dog.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: All right, and you take care. I'll call again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, take care.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's me! What are you doing this evening, I wondered if you could talk.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, how long has it been. How've you been? Isn't the factory work hard these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Don't ask, the line's been so busy it's killing me. Anyway, you're still driving the lorry down in Gangneung, aren't you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, that's right, still Gangneung. It's good to hear your voice after so long.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It is, it really has been ages. Do you remember when you fell carrying the load and we teased you as the 'clumsy driver'?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, that's right, you still remember. Anyway, what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, the thing is, I'm getting married next month. So I wanted to ask you to sing at the wedding.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Really? Congratulations! But I'm genuinely a terrible singer, is that all right?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It's fine, you don't have to be good, just get the mood going. It's not urgent, so think it over and let me know.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, thank you, I'll pick a song and call you again next week.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, lovely, my fiancé has heard a lot about you. Let's see each other at the wedding too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I'll definitely be there. The preparations must be hard, don't overdo it.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thank you, let's talk again. Keep well!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, take care and let's be in touch.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's fine. Aren't you on duty? It's good to hear your voice.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's just gone lunchtime so I've got a moment. How's your back these days, has it got better?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: I'm managing. Anyway, have you settled into the new staff quarters? Oh, when we moved house you drew up the whole layout of your room yourself — do you remember where you put the desk?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Up against the window, with the bed on the opposite wall. And you nagged me about the walking space being too tight, haha.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: That's right, that's right, that's how it was. That's my son all right. Anyway, are the quarters liveable?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: They're all right, but the wallpaper and lighting are so dingy that I want to do something about it. That's what I called about.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, what is it? Do you need something?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I only want to change the lighting and put up some sheeting, but I wondered if you could chip in part of the cost. I'm thinking of doing it around the start of next month.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, let's take our time. Let's talk with your mother at the weekend and settle how much.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, let's talk again at the weekend, then.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, and take some photos and send them, I'm curious how it'll change.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Understood, I'll take photos and send them. Mind your back, and let's talk at the weekend.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, eat properly. Take care.

victim_persona.occupation: Other craft and related trades workers

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, it's me, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's been a while. I'm well. How's Seoul these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just getting by here too. Anyway, is work very busy for you? Your voice sounds a bit tired.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I've just been taking my mother to the hospital. It's not urgent, it's a routine check-up so we went at our own pace.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, that's a relief. Is your mother well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, she's all right. Are you and the children well? Is work still busy?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same as ever, the systems side has been busy. Anyway, the cost of living is no joke these days, is it?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't ask. Leather material costs keep going up, and customers don't bring work in like they used to.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Did you see the inflation figures announced this time on the news? Higher than expected.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I saw, I saw. Food especially has gone up a lot, apparently. Which is why everyone's closing their wallets.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True. Though there's talk of interest rates stabilising a bit — would that make it better?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, I heard that too. We'll have to wait and see, it's not going to change in a hurry.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's true. Anyway, look after yourself. Don't overdo it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same to you. Let's see each other next time I'm in Seoul.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Good, let's get a meal then. Take care!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, take care.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, it's me, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. Work's been busy so I've been all over the place.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, you always say you're busy. Is your little one growing well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, they've started primary school so we're all over the place settling in. How about yours?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ours is finishing kindergarten and starting school too. Oh, and the weather's cooled down nicely lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, it's perfect walking weather at the moment.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Anyway, it's not urgent, but can I ask you something when you've got time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, what is it, go ahead.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: You live over in Seongsu-dong. Could you tell me if there's a decent English academy there? I think ours needs to start soon.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, there's the one mine goes to, and the teacher is thorough and good.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, really? Could you text me the name and location later?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, understood, I'll put it together and send it later.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thank you, really. That'll be a big help.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, let's meet up with the children sometime.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Lovely. I'll be in touch, take care.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's me, the one who used to play basketball with you. It's been a while.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, I can tell from your voice. But let's be sure, what was your nickname in the basketball club?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Ah, that, it was 'Rabbit', because I was fast. Haha

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's it, that's right, it's definitely you. How've you been? Isn't the call centre work hard?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Just getting by, it's been busy lately. Are you still driving?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, going here and there around Sejong. Anyway, what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Well, I want to enrol on a course to prepare for a car maintenance certification, and I'm a bit short on this month's tuition.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, really? How much do you need?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: About 300,000 won would do. I'll pay it back as soon as I'm paid next month.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: If it's not urgent we can take our time, but if it's for a certification of course I'll help.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: If you need, I can show you the course information and the enrolment slip on video.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, good, let's have a look on video.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Here, this is the enrolment information. Can you see it?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I can see it, that's clear enough. Then I send it to the account I used to send to before, don't I?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, that's right, I still use that account. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll send it today. I hope you get the certification.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Thank you, I'll buy you a meal sometime.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's me. Do you remember me? The one who stuck to you like glue at school.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? Hang on, the voice is familiar... are you the one who got caught cleaning the practical room for me?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: That's right, that's right, that's me, haha. I was the only one who got told off by the teacher.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, now I remember. Hey, it really has been a while, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, just getting by. How are you these days? You're in Busan, aren't you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, still living here. Looking after the children and running the house. What have you been up to?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: I just... grow plants at home and film a bit. Nothing much really.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's fine too, that might be more fun than picking one thing and living by it.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: True, but I've been thinking I should at least get a certification. You prepared for a beauty certification once, didn't you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, that's right, I had a struggle with that. Why, are you thinking of it too?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, but I've no feel for which academy to go to. Where did you go?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I went to a small academy near home, but honestly, rather than an academy I think it was better to take online lectures for the written part and practise the practical separately.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Oh, really? Have you still got the textbooks or your notes from then? Could you send me photos if you have?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'd have to look, I'll dig around this weekend and let you know.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, I'll wait. Thank you so much.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't be silly, keep well. Call again once you've sorted things out.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, son, but the number's unfamiliar. What's this, have you got a new one?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, well, my phone screen is cracked so I'm borrowing a colleague's phone.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Is that so? But let me check it really is my son. What was the dog you kept as a child called?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Bori, the same Bori that's still living happily at your house.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Haha, yes, that's right. Anyway, are you eating properly, isn't work hard?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's been a bit busy but I'm getting by. How's your leg, Dad?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Same as ever. Anyway, your voice doesn't sound good, is something the matter?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, actually I came off my motorbike on the way to work today, and I went to the hospital and need money for the stay, so I called.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What? Are you badly hurt? I'm worried, let me see your face on video.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, it's fine, I'll switch to video right now.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, seeing your face is a relief, it doesn't look serious. It's not urgent, so take your time.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, the hospital stay costs a bit — that account you sent the holiday money to last time, send it there.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, I know that account, understood, I'll sort it out and send it this evening.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, thanks, Dad, and look after yourself.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, you be careful, and come down once you've healed.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Are you driving?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, son. I've pulled in at a rest area. What's up?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I just wanted to hear your voice. How's your health these days? Is your back all right?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: The back is what it is. At my age nothing doesn't hurt. Isn't work busy for you?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: It is busy, but I've started a game on my phone to unwind.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: A game? You, playing games, that's remarkable. What game is it.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Just matching puzzles, it's nothing. It's not urgent, I just play a bit when I'm bored.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, do something like that and rest. Where would I find the time, driving takes the whole day.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: True, you're so busy. I hear you used to go to the arcades a lot?
