turns.text: Fifteen thousand won each, and it's not urgent, as long as you decide within the week.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, at that price I'll take one, what colours are there?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Beige and khaki, and I'm going for beige. Do you want the same?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, beige for me too. How should I send the money?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I'll text you the account number later, there's no rush.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, and set mine aside when they arrive.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, thank you, let's get a meal sometime.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Lovely, get back to the children.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I have. Have you had your dinner?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I have. I've put on a bit of weight so I'm trying to cut back on dinner, but it's not going well.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, don't starve yourself, eat in moderation. How's work these days, busy?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Just the same. Anyway, Mum, the lease on my flat ends next month.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I see. So you have to move?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, but it's not urgent. There's still time so I'll look into it at my own pace.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, there's no need to rush. Don't sign anywhere in a hurry, compare several places before you decide.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I should. I've been thinking of going somewhere a bit bigger this time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Have you got enough money? Tell me if you're short, I can chip in a little.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: No, it's all right, I think what I've saved will cover it. I only called to let you know.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, understood. Tell me again once it's settled. Look after yourself.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, and look after your health, Mum. I'll call again.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: It's me, is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's fine, what's up?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: I just wondered how you were. How's the factory work?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: There's a lot of volume lately so there's been some overtime. Is the shop work manageable for you?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: We've had a lot of customers lately so I'm all over the place too. Though I've been wondering about taking on another part-time job at weekends

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Why, what job?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: I thought about a café, even just weekend mornings. I feel I should earn a bit more while I'm young

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: But wouldn't not resting at weekends wear you down? Constant overtime tires me out too

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: True, but it's not urgent, I'll look into it at my own pace

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, there's no rush. Nothing matters if you wreck your health

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: True. Anyway, you must feel good on payday?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course, that's the day you live for. How lovely it'd be if every day were payday

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Haha, everyone must feel the same about that

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly. Anyway, look into the job but don't overdo it

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, understood. And tell me if the overtime gets too much

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, thank you, let's talk again

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, just now. Are you eating properly, you must be busy on your sales rounds?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, just getting by. I've been going round Changwon building up the client list.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, don't wreck your health. Anyway, from your voice it sounds like you've got something to say?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, does it show? Well, that distribution platform business I mentioned before — I need some start-up money for it.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, the one you mentioned last year? But you doing this over the phone feels a bit unfamiliar. I'd like to talk face to face, shall we switch to video?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, yes, of course. I'll call on video right now.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, now I can see you. Anyway, do you remember twisting your ankle when we went to Jirisan? Which side was it?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That was the left, and you nearly fell carrying me down on your back.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: That's it, that's right, that's clear enough. So how much do you need?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About three million. As long as it's in by the start of next month.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, let's think it over at our own pace. Where should I send it? Is it the same account as before?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, I still use that account. By the start of next month is fine.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Understood. I'll check my account and send it this evening. I hope the business goes well and works out the way you want.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Thank you, Dad, I'll genuinely do my best. It's cold, so wrap up when you go out walking.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, understood. Call me again when it arrives. Go in and rest.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, it's me! How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's been a while. I'm well, I've been all over the place with the nursing home work.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, are you eating properly? The weather in Seoul has been all over the place lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's raining then clear then raining in Jeju too. Anyway, there's nothing urgent, is there? We can take our time.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: No, I just called wanting to hear your voice. Let's have a relaxed chat.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's fine, then. I'm off today so I've got room.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, that's right, you said your son had gone into the army. How's he doing?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's been six months now? I worried at first but we talk often these days.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Really? Mine is enlisting soon and I'm worried. Apparently the army has got much better?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Much better. They can have phones, and the food's better than it used to be. I don't think you need to worry too much.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's a relief. Still, a parent can't help it, haha.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, I couldn't sleep at night at first either. But it got better with time.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I see. Let's talk more face to face, and help me out when my son enlists.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, get in touch any time. Let's find a time and meet.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, understood, take care and let's talk again!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, keep well, bye now.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hello, it's me, have you got a moment?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, yes, it's fine, I've just wrapped some work up and I was catching my breath

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's a relief, it's not urgent so I can take my time

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: How have you been, what did you do at the weekend?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I binge-watched Netflix at home at the weekend, there's so much to watch these days

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: My treat is watching a film at night after the little one's asleep

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Have you seen that film? Apparently it's based on a webtoon, what was it called...

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I've heard of that too, but I haven't seen it so I don't know what it's like

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I've read the webtoon but not seen the film, and the original fans seem divided on it

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Films based on something always seem to go that way, the expectations are too high

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: True, that's why I tend to watch the film first without reading the original

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'm the opposite, I dig into the original first, I've bought a fair few comics

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, then recommend me some later, I've wanted to read some comics

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I'll put a list together and send it on the messenger later

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Lovely, see you later then, take it easy

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, see you later

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, hello, it's me. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's been a while! It's good to hear your voice. Are you busy?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same as every day. Though I've nothing on today so I called at leisure for a change.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, lovely, I've nothing particular to do today either so I'm free. Are the children growing well?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, getting by. The eldest has hit puberty so it's been a bit hard, haha

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh dear, that phase really is hard. Mine went through it so I know.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Come to think of it, I've been thinking about my mother a lot lately. As she gets older I keep worrying.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, that happens. I keep snapping at my mother lately and regretting it.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, because they're family we're comfortable and treat them worse. Even though we shouldn't.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, and after marrying I found the culture at my family's and my in-laws' was so different. It took time to understand each other.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I really relate to that. Once I married I found every household is different, far more than I expected.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, they're family so we live making the effort. Let's get a meal together with the children sometime.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Lovely! I'll pick a day soon and get in touch. It's been good talking today, take care.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, let's talk again. Keep well!

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, yes. I've just had dinner. Are you eating properly?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I grabbed something at work. It's cold lately, watch out for colds.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, yes, you be careful. Anyway, what did you call about? Your voice sounds a bit stiff.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, well, a piece of lab equipment at work has broken. I have to pay my share of the repair up front and it's landed with this month's card bill so it's a bit tight.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Really? But is that really you? Do you remember what our dog was called, I'm suddenly curious.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, that was Choco. The brown Jindo I nagged you for as a child.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Haha, that's right, that's it. Anyway, let me see your face, shall we switch to video? Apparently there are a lot of odd calls these days.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, of course. I'll switch the screen now, one moment.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, yes, seeing your face puts my mind at ease. So, what was it?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: As long as it's sorted within the week. It'd be about 300,000 won.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Understood. Then I send it to the account you always use, don't I? The one I used to send your tuition to.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, use that same account. Thanks, Dad.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, and the temperature has dropped sharply in Incheon too. Eat your dinner and dress warmly.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, understood. I'll come to Incheon at the weekend if I'm free. Get some rest, Dad.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, take care and let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's been a while, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while, I'm well, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same as every day for me, watering the field in the morning and working in the day

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, there's the pleasure of tending the garden, and the weather's improved

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly, the weather's just right lately so my treat is putting the trot on and fiddling with the pots. Anyway, isn't the office work busy for you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Manageable, nothing urgent so I'm taking it slowly

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's a relief. Oh, have you seen that? Apparently the AI translators have got genuinely good

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I saw it on the news, apparently they understand dialects almost completely now?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, right, I tested whether it'd understand the Jindo dialect and remarkably it got it

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, that's impressive, the Gangwon dialect is a tough one, I wonder whether that works too

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Give it a go, technology is developing frighteningly fast these days. Won't we be talking to foreigners without an interpreter before long?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It looks that way, remarkable and a bit frightening at the same time

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly. Anyway, it's an interesting world. I'll tell you if I find anything new next time

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, lovely, and take care, let's talk again when you've got time

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: All right, I'll call again, keep well

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's me. Oh, my number's changed so I'm calling from this one.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Huh? What's this number, I don't know it. Is that really you?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's me, I said. Do you remember my nickname as a child? Shall I say it, haha

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Hey, go on then, what was it.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Big Eyes, wasn't it. Mum called me that as a child because my eyes were big.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Haha, that's it, Big Eyes. Yes, it is you. Why did you change your phone?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: The screen cracked so I bought a new one. How are things with you, isn't it cold in Pohang?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: It's still a bit chilly here. Is work manageable? You said there was a lot of overtime.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Manageable enough. Anyway, I have to renew the lease on my flat next month and I'm a bit short on the deposit.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: How short are you? Is it urgent?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 500,000. As long as it's there by the start of next month, so think about it whenever suits.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: All right, I'll see how I'm fixed and let's talk again around next week.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, thank you. Don't stretch yourself, help with whatever you can.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Understood. Anyway, I'll save your new number. Eat properly.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, and you take care, I'll be in touch again.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, son, what's the occasion. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I have. Anyway, Dad, I fell going up Mudeungsan last week and hurt my knee — do you remember?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, that's right, you said on the phone you were limping. But is that really you? Go on, tell me what your nickname was as a child, haha, I'm joking.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Haha, what's this all of a sudden. I was 'Beansprout', because I shot up in height. Anything else you want to know?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Enough, enough, it's you. Anyway, how's the knee, all right?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It hasn't got better, so I went to the doctor and apparently I've damaged a ligament, they said I need physiotherapy.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Really? Have you got the money, how much is the treatment.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 300,000 won, I think. I've not been able to do any part-time work while preparing for the exam so I'm asking.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: It's fine, it's not urgent, take your time. I'll go to the bank tomorrow and put it in the account you always use.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, thank you, Dad. Sorry to worry you.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Sorry, nothing, my son's hurt. Keep going to the doctor and eat properly.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, understood. And give my regards to Mum, take care!

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, look after yourself.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. My number's changed so it's unfamiliar, isn't it?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, yes, but why is the number so unfamiliar. Is that really you?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I got a new phone when I was made an executive at work. Do you remember taking me to the baseball as a child and catching a home run ball for me?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Haha, yes, that's right, you shouted with joy that day. And that's your voice all right.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Still, if you're worried shall we do a video call and see each other?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, turn it on for a moment, it's easier talking face to face.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, can you see? It's me, haha. Anyway, how's your health these days, is your knee all right?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, it's better now, going to the hospital for physiotherapy has helped. Are you eating properly? You said work was busy.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, it's busy but I eat properly. Anyway, Dad, there's a kindergarten event for your grandchild next month and so on, so I'd like to send you a bit more for living costs.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, you don't need to bother with that. Is it urgent? By when do you have to send it.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: No, not urgent at all, I can send it at my own pace within the week. I'll send it to the account you always use.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, I know that account well so it's easy. Send it at your own pace, and send me photos from the kindergarten event too.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, of course, I'll send plenty of photos after the event. I'll come and visit with the little one next week.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, yes, that'd be lovely. Take care and eat properly.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, and mind your knee, Dad, I'll call again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, hello

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, it's me, what were you doing

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just resting after work, what are you doing

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I've been tidying the house and I'm taking a break

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: How's the house renovation going? It looked nearly done last time

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, yes, it's nearly finished, haha, anyway, I've got something to ask

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, what is it

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That board game you've got, the one we played at my place

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that? You mean Ticket to Ride

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, yes, that's it, some friends are coming round this weekend, could you lend it to me?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I can, but if it's not urgent can I give it to you next week? I need it myself this weekend

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, whenever is fine, it's not urgent

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Okay, I'll sort it out and give it to you early next week

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thank you. Oh, are you keeping up with the LCK?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, this season's been good, did you see the T1 match?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Not yet, let's talk about it when we meet, I'll hang up now

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, it's me. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. How's the weather in Gangneung these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It's turned a bit chilly here. How about Seoul?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Much the same. Living with my mother, the heating bill has been on my mind lately.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, that's right, talking about prices reminds me. It's not urgent, I just called out of curiosity.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Take your time, what is it?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: The news says raw material costs keep rising so everything is going up — do you feel it on your side?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it seems so. Everyone at the office says they get a shock every time they go to the supermarket.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Seafood prices in Gangneung have gone up a lot too. The fishermen say the fuel costs are hard.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That'd be right. When oil prices rise everything else follows.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly. The children's academy fees are up too and running a household gets tighter and tighter.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, at our age we get through most things. Don't worry too much.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's true. Talking has made me feel a bit better. I'll hang up now.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, let's go fishing together next time. Keep well.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Good, I'll be in touch. Take care.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, it's me, I'm calling in the middle of eating, can you talk?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, I can, it's been a while. Is the excavator work manageable these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just getting by, lining things up to the millimetre is killing me. Are the trains going well for you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I take my diabetes medication and get by. Anyway, what's with your voice, is something the matter?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Haha, you're quick. Hey, do you remember what my nickname was in high school? I'm suddenly curious.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Weren't you 'Dolsoe'? Everyone called you that because you were good with a shovel.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's it, that's right, you're the only one. Anyway, the thing is, I've decided to get married.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Congratulations, you're finally getting married. What's your bride like?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: She's lovely. But between the venue deposit and the yedan the money is a bit tight for the moment — it's not urgent, but if it wouldn't be a strain, could you help?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, how much do you need? I'll help as I'm able, take your time.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: About 500,000 won would do it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, have you got a photo of the invitation? I'm curious.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, I'll show you on video. Look at this, the venue name and date are on it, aren't they? For the account, just use the same one as when you sent me money last time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I know that account, I've checked. I'll send it this evening, good luck with the preparations.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thank you, I'll send the invitation separately once it's printed. Let's see each other more often.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I'll definitely be at the wedding, keep well.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, it's me, is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's fine. It's been a while, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just getting by. Living with my parents means there's a lot to see to

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's right, you said three generations live together. Isn't it hard?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It is hard, but they mind the child so there are easier parts too. Anyway, it's not urgent, but there's something I want to talk about at our own pace

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, what is it, take your time

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I have to be out all day this weekend for a kindergarten event. But my parents happen to have a hospital appointment that day

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, so there's nobody to mind the child

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, I wondered whether you could watch mine for a few hours on Saturday afternoon. If it's too much, never mind

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that sounds good. Though I'm a bit drawn to classical too.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Then there's the Czech Boni Pueri Boys' Choir Christmas concert. Apparently they're performing with well-known artists.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Wow, that's good. Shall we check the dates for both and pick one?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, let's talk again around this weekend and settle it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Good. Let's have another call then. Eat properly!

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, and look after yourself, Auntie. I'll be in touch!

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while, how are you keeping?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. I'm just getting by. Is work busy these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Don't ask, there have been a lot of cases lately so I'm all over the place. Anyway, are you fishing often?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: No, it's been a bit sparse lately. The weather, and work as well. Nothing much going on with you?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: No, I'm just trying to rest at home. With age my body definitely isn't what it was.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same here lately. Maybe it's the sitting work, but my shoulder's been stiff.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, you need to be careful with that. There's frozen shoulder, inflammation in the shoulder — apparently it's a real ordeal if you get it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, really? What causes it?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It can come from injuring the shoulder, and apparently diabetes or thyroid problems make it more likely. Are you eating properly?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I grab something near the office. Gukbap or a set meal.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Still, have some vegetables. I've been trying to drink plenty of water and eat mostly vegetables lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, yes, I should pay attention too. And don't overdo it, take it easy.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: All right, mind that shoulder, and let's go fishing together when you're free.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Lovely, I'll be in touch. Take care.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Auntie, it's me. Have you been keeping well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, my niece. It's been a while. Is work manageable these days?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Just getting by. Dongtan has a lot of people so it is busy... How about you? How's the garden these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: The weather's lovely so I lose track of time tending the yard. I've planted some flowers too.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, exactly, I only called wanting to hear your voice. Anyway, the news says prices have gone up a lot.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, I get a shock every time I go to the supermarket. This money used to fill a trolley and now it's barely half.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I'd like to open a café but the rent is no joke... and I hear a lot about how hard it is for people starting businesses, which worries me.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, it's good to have a dream like that at your age. It's not something you're doing right now, is it, you can prepare at your own pace.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: True. I'll save some money first and look into a spot with plenty of footfall.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Good thinking. I worried about all sorts years ago, but doing it one step at a time without rushing worked out. There's no need to hurry.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Hearing you say that is reassuring. Anyway, I just called wanting to chat about this and that.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, call any time. Let's talk again, take care.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, look after your health, Auntie. Bye now!

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, what are you doing! It's me

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, what is it, have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just now. Isn't the factory work hard? You said you were busy

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't ask, kimjang season is coming so the volume is up and my wrist is about to give out

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh dear, that's rough. It's not urgent, I just called wanting to hear your voice

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Good. Anyway, has something happened? You sound cheerful

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, I went to a new skincare salon in Cheonan yesterday

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? How was it, any good?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: After the treatment my face was noticeably brighter. My skin had been dull and it was bothering me

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, you mentioned that last time. My skin has been dry lately and it's a problem, maybe from standing all day at the factory

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: They recommended a cream there and it's genuinely moisturising. I'll share some next time we meet

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, lovely, thank you. Nothing I put on lately has made any difference

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Let's go together when you've got time. You can book with plenty of notice

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, let's go once the kimjang is over and it quietens down, I've wanted a treatment myself

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, I'll be in touch then. Take care and mind that wrist

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, and you keep well, let's talk again

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hello, it's me. It's been a while, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, it's been a while! It's good to hear your voice. What have you been up to?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Just getting by. It's turned cold lately so my body feels heavy.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, I've been going to the pool and the water's cold so it's a bit hard.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Still, look after your health while you go. Oh, anyway, did you see the news? There was something about metal raw material prices.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: No, I missed it, what was it about?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Apparently aluminium prices keep rising. The companies on our side are all in uproar about the cost pressure.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, really? So does that mean prices of goods go up in the end?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, but nothing terrible is happening right now, it's a situation to watch at our own pace. There's no need to rush.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's a relief. I've been looking at property lately and the interest rates worry me too.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, the rates and everything, it's hard for everyone. But I think you can take your time thinking that over.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I should. Hearing all this today has been helpful.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Let's be in touch again, take care.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, take care!

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's me, have you been keeping well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while, I'm well, how about you? What have you been up to

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Just job hunting at home. How about you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same for me, living at my parents' in Cheonan and doing this and that

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: There's nothing much on lately so I'm just passing the time

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Oh, that's right, I've been looking into government-funded training courses — have you heard of them?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I've heard, there are so many kinds, which are you applying for?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: I'm on the engineering side so I want a data analysis course, though the length gives me pause

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: How long is it? How many months

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: About six months, but apparently they help with job placement afterwards so it seems worth it

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that sounds like something you can look into and decide at your own pace

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Right, I'm going to compare a few more

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I should look into something like that myself, being stuck at home isn't great

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It'd be fun if you took it too, haha

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, tell me if you find out more and I'll look into it too

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, understood, I'll be in touch again

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Oh, what's the occasion, calling at this hour, you keeping well?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, getting by. I did three home lessons today and I've only just sat down.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: That's hard work. Anyway, your voice sounds a bit hoarse, is your throat bad?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, is it? Maybe from talking so much with the children today. Anyway, I've got a favour to ask.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: What is it, go on.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: This month's card bill is a bit tight, could you lend me 100,000 won for a moment? I'll pay it back as soon as I'm paid next month.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: All right, that's no trouble, but hang on, let me check it's you. What did Dad call you as a child?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That was Kongsuni, he called me that because I loved kongjaban. Why ask that all of a sudden, haha

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: No, apparently there are a lot of odd calls these days so I just asked. Anyway, shall we switch to video so I can see your face?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, good, hold on.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Yes, it really is you, seeing your face puts my mind at ease. Anyway, it's not urgent, is it? I'm getting in a bit late today so I'll send it this evening.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, as long as it's today. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Then could you give me the account number again? I want to check in case I mix it up.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, yes, that's right, that same account. Thank you, I'll definitely pay it back.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Don't be silly, don't worry about that, just eat properly. I'll send it later, hanging up.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, yes. What's the occasion at this hour, nothing much going on?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: No, nothing much. I've just been busy preparing for a certification.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, are you eating properly? It's not long since you went down to Daejeon.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I eat properly. It's got cold lately, so watch out for colds yourself.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, and you watch out for colds. Is the studying manageable?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, it's manageable. Anyway, Dad, how's your shoulder these days? You said it hurt last time.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Much better. Thank you for thinking of it.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That's good. And Dad, I'm registering for the electrical engineer exam this time and there's the exam fee and textbooks.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, how much do you need. Is it urgent?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 150,000 won should do. It's not urgent, as long as I have it within the week, you can send it at your own pace.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Understood, I send it to the account I used last time, don't I?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, that account is fine. Thank you, Dad.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, prepare well and pass. Eat properly.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, and work is hard for you so take care. I'll call again.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, take care.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, it's me, the plumber from Gangseo-gu. You know my voice straight away, don't you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, straight away, that booming voice is you all right. Anyway, do you remember the nickname you gave me when we were drinking years ago?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, that's 'Seal', I gave you that because you were a good swimmer. If you'd forgotten that I'd have been genuinely hurt.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, that's it, Seal. Hey, it's been a while, how've you been? How's work, are you keeping well?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just getting by, apart from a stiff back I'm still serviceable. How about you, are you looking into work?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I've sent applications to a few places but no word yet. Still, I've got time on my hands.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, perfect. The thing is, my daughter is getting married, that's what I called about.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Congratulations, when is it? What's the partner like?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: The third Saturday of next month, and apparently they met as colleagues at work and have been together two years. But the venue is a bit out of the way and we're short of people to help with guest parking and directions.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, for that I've got time so I'll come and help. What time should I get there?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It's not urgent, so let's talk again at our own pace as the date approaches, there's no need to fix it now.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, get in touch when it's closer, I'll fit it into my schedule.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thank you, really. I'll call again in a few days, keep well.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, good luck with the wedding preparations, let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Hello, Mum, it's me.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, yes, what's the occasion, calling at this hour.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I just wondered how you sounded. Isn't the factory busy? Kimjang season is coming.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Don't ask, the volume is up and I haven't a moment. Anyway, your voice sounds odd, have you got a cold?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, you know that cold medicine you gave me last time, taking that helped but my nose is still blocked.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh dear, let me see your face, switch to video.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: All right, Mum, hold on, I'll switch.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, now I can see you, your face is a bit puffy. How's your father?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That's what I called about, his knee was bad yesterday so he went to the hospital. The tests and medicine came to a fair bit.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh dear, was it very bad. How much do you need?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 200,000 won, and it's not urgent, so send it at your own pace.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, I'll put it into the account I sent to last time this evening.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Thanks, Mum, apart from that there's nothing. And Dad will be better soon.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, tell your father not to overdo it. And eat properly.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, and look after yourself, Mum. I'll call again.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, take care.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's me. It's been a while, hasn't it? Have you been well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's good to hear your voice! It really has been a while, have you been well?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, just getting by. I've been all over the place with the shop lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, the shop must be busy. I'd been wondering how you were. Oh, that's right, do you remember twisting your ankle when you fell at the valley on our club trip?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Haha, of course I remember, you carried me down on your back. Thinking about it still embarrasses me.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's right, that's right, that was it. Anyway, is something up, is that why you called?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Well, I want to apply for an advanced Japanese cuisine course — I think I'll need it if I'm going to run a little late-night restaurant one day.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that's a good idea. But what's that got to do with me, is there something you want to know?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, you know about the education side so I'd like you to look at the curriculum. And, sorry, but the registration deposit is a bit urgent... I wondered if you could lend me a small amount.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, you should say so for that sort of thing. But I'd need to see the curriculum on screen — could you show me on video?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Ah, yes, of course, one moment, I'll share the screen.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, this isn't bad. Anyway, the money isn't urgent so I can send it at my own pace, I'm a bit busy today.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Ah, yes, whenever suits. For the account, just send it to the same one you sent to back at university.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I know it, so you still use that account. Then I'll check and send it when I've got room this evening.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, thank you. I'll buy you a meal sometime. Take care.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, meal nothing. Prepare well for the course and be in touch!

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello! It's me! Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's fine, what's the occasion, calling at this hour

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I just wanted to hear your voice. You keeping well? I wonder whether you've given up the smoking

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, don't ask, I can't give it up. How about you, do you go walking by the Geumho River often?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Of course I do. Anyway, I'm suddenly curious — do you remember where we first met?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Why do you ask, of course I remember. You fell over catching the bouquet at a wedding, and that's when we first spoke

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's it, that's right, haha, I was so embarrassed. Hey, talking about that reminds me, my daughter's wedding is next month

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh my, really? Congratulations, she's grown up already

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: But preparing for it, all sorts of costs have landed together and it's a bit tight. It's not urgent, but if you can spare it could you lend me a little? I'm short on the yedan costs

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: How much do you need? I'd have to see how I'm placed

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Not much, about 300,000 won. If it's too much that's fine, so tell me honestly

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: No, that much is no strain, give me the account number and I'll send it

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thank you. Oh, that's right, I've had the invitation design printed, I'll show you on video later if you've got time, the colours came out beautifully

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, lovely, switch to video, I'm curious

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I'll call later, thank you, really. You're coming down to Daegu for the wedding, aren't you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course, I'll come down. Let's talk later, take care

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, it's me. I thought you might have forgotten my voice and you got it straight away.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, yes, why wouldn't I know your voice. It really has been a while.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, do you remember what we called you at university? You had a nickname.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Teddy Bear, don't you know. You used it more than anyone.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's right, Teddy Bear. Haha, it's funny hearing it after so long. You keeping well? Have the children grown?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just getting by. Mine's at kindergarten now. Is work still busy for you?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Busy, but that's not why I called. Actually, I'm getting married.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Congratulations! Since when have you been seeing them, all of a sudden.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: We've been together a while, I'm only saying now. But more to the point, you do finishing work, don't you. I wanted to ask about wallpapering and flooring for the new place.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that? If it's not urgent take your time, I'll tell you what I know.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: For flooring, is engineered or laminate better? And roughly how much should I budget per pyeong?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: For a newlywed home engineered flooring is better, it feels nicer underfoot and lasts. Roughly 150,000 won a pyeong, though it varies by material grade. Send me a photo of the floor plan next time and I'll go through it roughly.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Really? Thank you, genuinely. I had nobody to ask about this sort of thing while preparing.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: What are you on about, of course I'll help. Tell me in advance once the wedding date is set.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Understood, I'll sort out the photos and send them. It's been good hearing your voice today, let's get a meal sometime.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, congratulations, let's be in touch soon. Take care.

victim_persona.occupation: Other facility and special security guards

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Hello, Dad, it's me!

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, love, but what's this number? Have you changed your phone?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, that's right, I bought a new one last week. I dropped the old one and the screen was completely cracked.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: I see. But is that really my daughter and not someone else? Do you remember what our dog was called when you were little?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mongsil, Dad! Have you forgotten that too, haha

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Haha, that's right, Mongsil. Are the children wearing you out these days?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's fine, a lot of them have colds so it's a bit busy, but it's fun in its way. Are you keeping well, Dad?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Same as ever for me. Anyway, is something the matter? Your voice sounds a bit odd.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I twisted my ankle on the stairs yesterday and went to the hospital, and the ligament is stretched. The treatment costs a bit so I'm telling you.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh dear, does it hurt a lot. How much do you need?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 300,000 won. Sorry to call about this sort of thing.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What's there to be sorry about, it's not urgent so take your time. Still, I'm worried whether your ankle is very swollen, are you all right?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Oh, all right, I'll call back on video, Dad.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, it's quite swollen. All right, I send it to the account you used before, don't I?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, send it to that account. Thanks, Dad.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, look after yourself and we'll talk when you next come home.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello? It's me! It's good to hear your voice

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, what's the occasion, calling and all, you keeping well?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I'm well, though I've been all over the place preparing to open the café

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? The vegan café you wanted, right? Is it going well?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, that, but I've got bigger news than that. I'm getting married

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Really? Congratulations, genuinely, with your boyfriend?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's right, him. Anyway, do you remember? That song we sang at the karaoke at university, what was it

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course I remember, you were singing a ballad and got the note wrong and we were doubled up laughing, haha

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's it, that's right, haha. So the thing is, you know about the legal side. I wanted to ask whether there's anything to watch out for on the marriage registration form

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, there's nothing much to it, you just need the documents ready in advance, but I'll write it up for you if you need

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thank you. And could you look over the wording on the invitation? It's not urgent, so look at it at your own pace

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course, send it on chat. I'll check and get back to you

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: You really are the best. And we should do the karaoke round again on the wedding day, haha

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Lovely, I'll belt one out with my badminton muscles that day. Congratulations, genuinely

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thank you, I'll send the invitation by text later. Take care

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, take care, and I'll look at the invitation as soon as it arrives

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Hello.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's me. What are you doing?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Oh, what's the occasion, it's been a while.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Just a how-are-you call. How's the shop these days, busy?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Busy enough. Are you and the children well?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, we're well. Is your back all right now? You said you'd twisted it.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: It's better. Anyway, you looking after me like this all of a sudden is odd. Hey, are you really my brother? What was the name of that market we went to all the time as kids?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yeongdeungpo Market, and you still trade there. What's got into you, does my voice sound odd?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: No, I was just checking. Your voice sounded a bit different.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It must be the cold. Anyway, the thing is, I'm having a health check next week and I'm a bit short on the cost — I wondered whether I could borrow from you.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: How much do you need?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About 200,000 won should do.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: That much is fine. It's not urgent, so send me the account whenever and I'll transfer it.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Thank you, I'll text you the account number.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: All right, look after yourself.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, thank you, let's get a meal sometime.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, it's me, can you talk?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I can, what's the occasion, calling and all

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I just wondered what you were doing. You keeping well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just getting by, housework and fiddling with the plants. How about you, have you found anything?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Nothing definite yet, I'm just sending applications. There's no rush so I'm looking at my own pace

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, don't get impatient, take your time, somewhere good will come up

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thank you. Anyway, I suddenly wanted to talk about travel, so I called

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Travel? Travel all of a sudden, why

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I saw some photos of Namhae online and it looked really pretty. I want to go someday

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, Namhae is lovely, it's been ages since I went. And walking by the sea is good

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, apparently there's a cable car there — shall we go together when the timing works?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Lovely, but not right now, let's talk when a date comes up

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, exactly, there's no need to rush. Let's go at leisure once I've got a job

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Let's do that, but we're definitely going, promise

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Understood, I'll be in touch again. Keep well

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, good luck to you too, let's talk again

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, hello, it's me! Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I've just eaten. How about you? Is the hospital busy today?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Today's manageable. Anyway, it's not urgent so let's take our time, I'm on a break right now.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, really? That's good. Anyway, is your dog growing well?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, don't ask, she's put on so much weight lately I'm worried. I haven't been walking her.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, she must be sweet. How old is she again?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Five now. Anyway, don't you keep anything? You said you wanted fish once.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's right, I did say that, but I still haven't done it. The flat's a bit small.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Then how about a cat, they're less work.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I've thought about it, but I travel for work a lot so it worries me.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: True, that could be a problem. Still, having a dog genuinely lifts your spirits, being greeted when you come home.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly, send me photos, I want to see her.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: All right, I'll send them later. Oh, I should get back in now.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, get back in, I'll wait for the photos!

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, yes, take care and let's talk again!

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me, have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I've just finished in the kitchen and eaten. How about you?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I'm about to have dinner. How are your legs these days? Standing all day is hard

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'm managing. It's not urgent so don't worry, it'll get better in time

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: That's good. Oh, that's right, Mum, did you see the news today? There's been a lot about jeonse fraud

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: No, I missed it. What's it about?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Apparently young people can't get tens of millions of won in deposits back from landlords. It's been on the news constantly

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh dear... that's such a lot of money. Those young people are having a hard start

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Exactly. So apparently you have to check the property register and so on when signing a contract now

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Thankfully there's not much of that in our neighbourhood. Maybe because everyone here knows each other

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: True, the countryside might be safer in that respect. Anyway, it's nothing urgent, it just came to mind so I mentioned it

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, thank you for telling me. I'll be careful too. Enjoy your dinner and let's talk later

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, get some rest, Mum. I'll call again!

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, it's me, how are you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while, I'm well, how about you?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same as ever for me. Isn't work hard? Building work must be physical

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It is, but the weather's nice lately so it's manageable. Isn't work busy for you?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Busy, but just getting by. Oh, that's right, I went to the hairdresser's yesterday

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? What did you have done, a perm?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: No, just a light colour. The grey keeps coming through

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's my worry too, the grey comes through so fast with age

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, though apparently the dye isn't good for the scalp, which does worry me

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Right, I heard scalp massage is good so I tried it and it felt lovely

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, really? I should try that, my skin's been a bit dry lately too

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I switched to a richer lotion and it helped, you should switch too

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I should. Let's go to the hairdresser's together next time and check each other

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Lovely, lovely, let's find a time and be in touch

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Understood, see you next time, take care

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, you too, take care, bye

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, Dad, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, just now. How about you?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I've just eaten too. Anyway, has it turned chilly in Daejeon too?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, it drops sharply mornings and evenings. How's Seoul?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Much the same. It's still warm in the day but a bit cold at night.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly, maybe it's the change of season, my body feels a bit sluggish too.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Same here, I've had a runny nose in the morning. Watch out for colds, Dad, and dress warmly.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, and don't you dress lightly either. It's been especially cold at night lately.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, yes, though I quite like this weather. It's just cool enough for walking.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's true. Once the summer heat passes this is the best time for walking. I've been walking a bit in the evenings too.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, good for you. Though once it gets cold you won't get out, so exercise indoors then.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I should. And you watch out for colds and eat properly.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, and you too, Dad. I'll call again, take care.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, take care.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, it's me, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. I'm well, how are you these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just getting by. I've had an interview and I'm waiting, which is frustrating.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's hard work. Still, don't think of it as urgent, take your time until the result comes.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly. I'm going to rest as I go. Anyway, nothing much going on with you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as ever for me. Work, and resting at weekends.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, that's right, that's what I called about. There's a culture festival in Wonju this month, shall we go together?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, lovely. When is it?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: From this weekend to next weekend, about ten days apparently. There's no fixed day, you can go any day.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Then let's match dates at our own pace, no rush. I'm a bit busy this week so around next week would be better.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, I've no fixed schedule either so I'll fit round whichever day suits you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Thank you. Anyway, are there performances and so on?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: There's gugak performances and an exhibition by local artists, apparently. It'd be nice to eat and then look round at our own pace.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Lovely. Get in touch again once the date's set.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Understood. I'll be in touch soon, rest well.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, see you next week.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, it's me, your son.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Huh? But what's this number, it's not saved.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, one of my phones broke so I've put in a temporary SIM. Mum, do you remember what time I was born?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Of course I know, you came just after half past five in the morning. But why ask that.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Just in case you doubted it was me, with the number changed and all. Do you remember my nickname as a child? The one the lady next door used.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: That was Pill Bug, wasn't it? Everyone teased you about being scared of insects. It's my son all right.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: How's the shop these days, Mum? Have you got customers?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Just getting by. How's work for you, a lot of overtime?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's been busy so I'm all over the place. Anyway, can I call back on video so I can see your face?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, let's do that, I've no make-up on but never mind.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: You look well, Mum. Anyway, my card bill has come out rather high this month, and I wondered whether you could tide me over with 500,000 won.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What made it so high, are you all right?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Just several things landing together. It's not urgent, as long as it's within this week, so send it at your own pace.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Then I send it to the account I used before, don't I? I always sent it there.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, the same account. Thanks, Mum, I'll send you a bit more next month.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Don't be silly, don't worry about that, just eat properly. I'm hanging up, son.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Have you had dinner?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just now. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I have too. I ate late after teaching the children today. How's your appetite these days, Dad?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same as ever. Maybe it's the heat but I haven't much appetite.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Still, you must eat. It's not urgent, so have something at your own pace.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I did make some porridge in the morning. Don't worry too much.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: That's good. Anyway, are you drinking enough water? You have to watch out for dehydration in summer.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I just have a few coffees, I don't really drink water.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Dad, you need to drink water rather than coffee. Apparently caffeine actually draws water out of the body.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Really? I didn't know. Then I should keep a bottle beside me and drink.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, that'd be good. And a decent new café has opened nearby, you like desserts so give it a go.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, apparently their cake is famous. I'm going to try it next week.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Lovely. But don't have too many sweet things, in moderation, all right?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, all right. Still, you have to enjoy things now and then.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Of course, exactly. Stay healthy and enjoy them for a long time, Dad. I'll call again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, and you eat properly. Go in and rest.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey! It's been a while, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while, same as every day for me, off to the factory and so on

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: How's work these days? Very busy?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's been a bit busy but it's manageable. What have you been up to

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just resting at home and walking round the Magok area

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'm envious, I stand all day working the bending machine so my back's been aching

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Your back? Have you been to the doctor?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I went, but I just had some physiotherapy. They said it's nothing major

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Still, don't overdo it, take it easy, overdoing it makes it worse later

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, understood. Are you keeping well? You said your knee was bad before

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, that's much better now. It only twinges going up and down stairs

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, be careful, at our age you have to be careful with everything

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, we're at the age to look after ourselves. Let's get a meal sometime

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, lovely, let's be in touch and meet up

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, take care and let's talk again

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, it's me! Have you been keeping well?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, yes, love, what's the occasion, calling at this hour. Nothing much going on?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Are you still going for walks, Mum? The weather must be lovely at Boramae Park.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Of course! It's cool mornings and evenings lately so I go out every day. Anyway, your voice sounds a bit low?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, actually... the little one has been unwell for a few days so we've been going to the doctor. It's nothing much, but the tests and everything have come to a fair bit.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh dear, my grandchild is unwell? You must have had a fright. Anyway, is it urgent? You don't need it right this minute?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: No, it's not urgent, I'd be grateful if you could help within the week.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, yes, no rush. Come to think of it, it's been ages since I saw you — let's switch to video and let me see the little one.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Lovely, one moment, I'll call on video.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, now I can see you, your face looks worn. Anyway, what was the nickname your father used to call you, do you remember?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, that, 'Kongsuni'. He called me that because I loved kongjaban.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: That's it, that's right, Kongsuni. All right, it's definitely my daughter. Then I'll send it, could you give me the account number again?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, send it to that account. Thank you so much, Mum.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Thank you, nothing, my grandchild is unwell, of course I'll help. I hope the little one gets better soon.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, they say a few days and it'll pass. And look after your health while you're out walking, Mum.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, understood, show me the little one on video again once they're better. Take care!

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, hello, it's me. You keeping well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, of course, I'm well. How's work these days?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Just getting by. It's got much hotter in Daegu lately.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same in Incheon. I've got the air conditioning on already.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Exactly. At times like this you need something cold to drink.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, I can't live without an iced americano lately, two a day.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Apparently you should cut down on caffeine as you get older, but it's hard to give up.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly, though without coffee I'm too sleepy in the afternoon to work.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I've been making maesil tea lately. I take it to work in a bottle.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, maesil tea is good. Sweet and tart, and good for fatigue too.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: True, and my wife makes sikhye in the evenings so I have that a lot too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'm genuinely envious. I should ask my wife to make some.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Ask her, apparently it's not difficult.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I should. Anyway, let's get through today with something cold to drink.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: All right, let's talk again. Look after your health!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Okay, take care!

victim_persona.occupation: Other sales and customer service managers

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. How've you been? It's good to hear your voice.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Do you remember the study group we did at university? I was always late and you told me off.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, I remember, you always said you'd missed the bus. Was it the accounting principles study group?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: That's right, that one. Are you and your mother still well? How's Cheongju?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: My mother's the same, and I live for going round bakeries these days. Is work manageable for you?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, just getting by. Anyway, I want to get the computerised accounting certification this time and I called to ask which training courses are good.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's a good idea. I took an evening class when I was doing my certification, I'd have to look up where it was.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: I've only just started looking into it, so you can tell me at your own pace.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll look into it this weekend and get back to you. I'll put the material together and send it on chat.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Thank you. I'll wait without pressure, then.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, don't worry. Give my regards to your mother, and let's get a meal next time I'm down in Cheongju.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, thank you. Take care!

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, it's me, have you been well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, yes, I'm well. It's getting hot, the security work must be hard on you.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, it's in the shade so it's bearable. How's the shop, plenty of customers?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just getting by. It feels like everyone's closing their wallets a bit lately, but it does keep ticking along.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's how it is, but everyone lives the same way. Anyway, did you watch the TV yesterday? That trot programme.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that! I watched it, I watched it. That singer on it has a genuinely good voice.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Exactly, they're young and I don't know how they sing so soulfully. My wife has become a complete fan.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same here, haha. They sing old songs and it isn't dated at all, it's actually stylish.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Right, right. Though there are so many programmes like that now that I don't know what to watch.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True. I just watch whatever I land on flicking channels, and that's not bad either.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: True enough, that's fun too. Anyway, it's good to hear your voice today, let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, do look after your health and I'll be in touch again.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello! Oh, it's me, how are you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, hello! It's been a while, you sound well.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, I've been all over the place with the little one so I haven't been in touch. How's the weather in Busan?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's humid here lately so it's a bit hard. Is your little one settling in at nursery?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, they've settled in now. Anyway, we've been looking into moving.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? You're in Dongjak-gu now, don't you like it there?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: The area's good but the flat's a bit small. It's not urgent, I'm just looking at my own pace.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, I see, there's no need to rush. I'm in a studio flat so it's small, but living alone it's fine.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Living alone that might actually be easier.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, I get called out a lot so having a lot of stuff would be a nuisance. So you're going somewhere bigger?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, somewhere with an extra room. But I'll only move when something good comes up.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Tell me if something good comes up, I'd like a look too.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, understood. Come and visit when the timing works!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I'll come soon, and love to the little one. Bye now!

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, it's me! How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, I've been well, I've been a bit busy tending the garden. How about you?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Same for me. Though the weather's cooled down a bit so it's more liveable

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, though it's still hot in the day. How's your health these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just getting by. I'm managing it with hospital visits

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's good. Anyway, have you seen the news? About our lunar probe

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, I saw, I saw! It was remarkable. We really do have space technology now

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Exactly, it used to be only the US and the Soviets, and now apparently private companies are piling in too

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, I saw that on the news. Apparently the space industry makes money now

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Maybe that's why a lot of young people go into aerospace engineering now. The times move fast, don't they

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly, we couldn't have imagined this as children

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, haha. Anyway, the time has flown talking, let's talk again

turns.speaker: Friend

turns.speaker: Friend

turns.speaker: Self

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I understand. But there's no need to decide in a hurry. Watch for a few months and if they still want it, starting then isn't too late.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, thinking of it that way puts my mind at ease. I needn't be impatient.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Then let's do that. But do have a proper talk with your child about why they want to go.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I should. Thank you for listening, let's get a meal sometime.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, see you soon. I'll be in touch after my mother's hospital appointment, take care.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, hello, it's me! Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Coworker

turns.speaker: Self
