turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Mostly parks and walking paths around Anyang. Last time I went to the sauna and took some cherry blossom photos nearby

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: The sauna and photography is a good combination. All I do lately is exercise and rest

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Aren't there good photo spots near where you live? I'd like to visit when the timing works

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: There are, Sejong Lake Park is good for photos at the moment. Come at your own pace when the weather's nice

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, lovely, let's pick a day and go sometime. Tell me whenever you've got room

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, understood, I'll check my schedule and get in touch

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: All right, it's been fun talking today, let's be in touch again! Take care

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, take care

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's fine, I'm off today so I'm at home. What's the occasion, calling and all

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Just bored. What have you been up to? Are the children growing well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just getting by. The eldest is at secondary school already so I'm all over the place, haha

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's fast. I'm still going fishing on my own

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: There's no rush, you'll meet someone good in your own time

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Exactly. Anyway, what's the best thing about being married?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hmm... just that there's someone there when you get home from work. And someone to talk to over a meal

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's nice. I'm of an age now so I should start thinking about it seriously

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still, there's no need to be impatient. I met my wife at nearly forty

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: How did you meet her? I've never heard the story properly

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Through a friend. At first it was just meeting for a meal and then I stayed, haha

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: So blind dates are the answer after all. Introduce me to someone

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: I mean it seriously, if you know anyone decent do put us in touch

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'll ask around, I'll be in touch straight away if I find someone good

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Thank you. Let's get a meal sometime

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, it's me. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. I'm well, is the factory busy for you these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Busy, but it's manageable. Are you keeping well? You said your back hurt last time

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's much better, going to the doctor helped. Thank you for thinking of it

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, it's been a while, let's have a relaxed chat. Oh, anyway, did you see the news yesterday? About the local elections

turns.speaker: Self

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, but they've been talking about this for years and I've never seen it actually happen, haha

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Pledges like that are always the same. Daejeon's much the same

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly. Anyway, let's get a meal when you're free

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, lovely, let's be in touch soon. Take care

turns.text: Mum, it's me. My phone screen is cracked so I'm calling from a friend's phone

turns.text: Huh? What's this number, is that really you? The voice is similar but it sounds a bit off

turns.text: We had sundae-guk together last week, remember, I spilt the kkakdugi juice and you passed me a tissue, don't you remember?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, that's right, that was so funny. Yes, it is you, that's a relief

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Have you been well? Is Dad all right?

turns.text: What is it, go on

turns.text: Really? Is it urgent?

turns.speaker: Family

turns.speaker: Parent

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, good, hold on, I'll take it

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, now I can see you, it really is you. What was the account number? Could you give it to me again?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I'll text you the account number. Send it to that. Thanks, Mum

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Understood, I'll send it today. Eat properly

turns.text: Oh, hello. I was at the Busan site, the one who did nights with you.

turns.text: Huh? Who is this... ah, are you the one I worked with on the railway side?

turns.text: That's right, that's right, we used to make ramyeon at three in the morning, remember?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that, I remember you grumbling that there was no kimchi. It's been a while, have you been well?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Just getting by. My wife's well, and are your children growing well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, everyone's well. Is work the same for you?

turns.text: Same as ever. Anyway, the thing is, I have to hire a piece of equipment this time and I'm a bit short on the hire cost.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, is that so. How much do you need?

turns.speaker: Colleague

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Then... could you show me your face? Voice alone is a bit confusing.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, all right, of course. Hold on, I'll turn it on.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's right, seeing your face puts my mind at ease. Then could you give me the account number?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, all right. I'll give you the account. Thank you, I'll buy you a meal next time you're in Busan.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I'll send it around this evening.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Thank you, really. Take care, and let's be in touch.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, look after your health too, take care.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, hello, it's me, is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it's fine, what's up?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Nothing urgent, I just wondered how you were. Is work all right?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just getting by, it was busy with the settlement season but it's eased now. How about you?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Same as ever for me. Oh, you know I've been hiking every weekend?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's right, you said you went up Gwanaksan last time

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, that's right, it was genuinely good. But I've no one to go with this weekend, would you come if you're free?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, lovely, but I haven't got hiking boots, would trainers do?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: It's a low mountain so it should be fine, it's not urgent, think it over and tell me within the week

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, understood, I'll check my schedule this week and get back to you

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: All right, no pressure. Oh, shall I bring some gimbap? Or shall we each bring our own lunch?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I think we can decide that later, haha

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Haha, yes, yes, anyway get in touch if you're free, you've worked hard today

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, and you, I'll be in touch later

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello, son, I hope I'm not calling while you're busy.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I have. I've been back from the field and resting. Isn't work hard for you?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: It has been a bit busy lately but it's fine. How's your back, Mum? You said it hurt last time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Much better. The women's association even bought me some patches. Anyway, what did you call about today?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Ah, it's not urgent, I was thinking of going somewhere for the summer holiday. We can take our time, but is there anywhere you'd like to go?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Somewhere like Yeosu or Tongyeong would be lovely. Somewhere with a sea view.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Then shall I look into Yeosu? Apparently the night views there are famous.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, apparently there's a night-sea cable car too. Your father would like it.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I'll look up some good places to eat too. Let's talk about the dates another time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, look into it while looking after yourself.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, understood. I'll call again next week. And look after your health, Mum.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, thank you. Take care and call again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, son, what's the occasion at this hour.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Ah, nothing, I finished work and thought I'd call, Dad.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Have you eaten? You said work was busy.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I've eaten, I had tonkatsu, haha. Isn't the kitchen work hard for you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hard, nothing, my hands know it so it's fine. Anyway, your voice sounds low, is something the matter?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Just... I've been wondering whether I'll ever get married at this rate.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Why are you saying that all of a sudden, has something happened?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Everyone at work has a partner and I'm the only one who doesn't. And dating hasn't gone well.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's not something that happens by rushing. You can meet someone in your own time, there's nothing to hurry about.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Still, at my age I keep getting impatient.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: What's late about your age, in my day everyone met differently. Just look for someone good at your own pace.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Hearing you say that puts my mind at ease, haha.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Manage your weight a bit too, and live at ease in body and mind, and it'll come naturally.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, understood, Dad, I'll cut down on the late-night eating and get some exercise.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, don't worry too much and eat properly. Let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, and look after your health, Dad. Take care.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, yes, just now. Are you eating properly?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, my wife sees to it so I eat well. How's your back these days, Dad?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: It's been a bit achy lately but going to the doctor is helping. Don't worry too much.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Still, don't overdo it. Anyway, that facilities management interview I had — they got in touch today.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, really? How did it go, did it work out?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I start next week. The pay isn't much but they credited my mechanical equipment experience, which is a relief.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Hey, that's genuinely good. Congratulations. It's not urgent, so settle in at your own pace and don't overdo it.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Thank you, Dad. Oh, come to think of it, I remember you teaching me to ride a bike as a child, holding on behind me the whole way. I was so frightened of falling.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: You were frightened and kept saying Dad, don't let go, didn't you?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That's right, haha, remembering it suddenly made me laugh. Anyway, you can rest easier now, I'm working again.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, seeing you working puts our minds at ease. I'll tell your mother, she'll be pleased.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, do. And look after your health, Dad, don't overwork.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, all right. Good luck with the new start, do well.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, thank you. I'll call again, take care.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, let's hang up, well done.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's me, the one with the skincare salon in Iksan. You haven't forgotten my voice, have you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, how would I forget that voice. I even remember what you teased me about when you treated my swollen hand last time.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's right, that's right, I said your hand was puffed up like a bungeoppang. Have you been well? How's the sales side these days?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just getting by. Is the shop going well? Nothing else?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: The shop's always the same. Anyway, did you know my son's marriage has come up?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? When's the wedding? How long were they together?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: A bit over a year, apparently. They met with marriage in mind so it's moving fast. So the thing is, the wedding costs are a bit tight.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, so? How much do you need.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Not a lot, I wondered whether you could lend me about a million won. It's not urgent, as long as it's within this month.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That much is no trouble. Are you still using that Saemaul Geumgo account you used before?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, that's right, that same account. I'll send you a photo of the invitation when it's printed.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Lovely, but shall we switch to video for a moment if you've got time? I'd like to see your face after so long.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It's nice seeing your face after so long. I'll send the invitation at my own pace, no pressure.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll send it this weekend when I've got room. Pass on my congratulations to your son.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thank you, I'll buy you a meal sometime. Take care!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hey, are we that age already, haha. Anyway, it's not urgent, it's just a how-are-you call?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, nothing urgent, you just came to mind. I went to my parents' at the weekend and Mum asked after you

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, is your mother well? You said her back hurt before

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, much better, she's back to tending the vegetable patch. Though Dad has been a bit bored since retiring

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That'd be right, suddenly having nothing to do leaves you empty. My father was like that years ago

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, right. So I've started going fishing with Dad, and he seems to enjoy it

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that's nice, father and daughter fishing, that's a lovely picture. I should visit my parents more often but work is busy

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Don't live so busily. There's a limit to how long parents can wait

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, I should make time and go down this month. Talking about it has made me think of my parents

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, go and show your face. Anyway, I'll hang up for now, let's talk again

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, take care and let's be in touch again

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, it's me! Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just now, how about you? Isn't the shop busy?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Don't ask, at weekends the customers pile in and I'm completely all over the place. Though it's quietened down now

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's hard work. I've been all over the place with the month-end at work but I've got some room now

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's good. Oh, that's right, do you still play that puzzle game on your phone?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, still, a bit every day. Were you curious about that?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, yes, I play one my niece installed when I'm bored and it's fun

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Which game is it? I'm curious

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: The sweet-matching one, Candy something. I lose track of time, haha

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that one! I used to play that religiously. Is it still fun?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It's fun, though the hard levels stress me out, haha. What level are you on in your puzzle game?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: About level three hundred? Though I've been playing less lately, only when I've got time

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Wow, you've done a lot. Let's show each other our games next time we meet

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Lovely, let's have a coffee and get our phones out, haha

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: All right, understood, I'll get in touch around next week

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, do, it's been good talking today. Take care!

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, love, what's the occasion at this hour. Have you finished at the nursery?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, just finished. Anyway, how's your health these days, Mum? You said your back hurt.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: It's fine, getting by, I wear the patches. Anyway, what's with your voice, is something the matter?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, well, don't be alarmed, Mum. I had a minor collision on the way home from work today.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What? An accident? Is that really my daughter? What nickname did I call you as a child, I'm suddenly worried.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Honestly, Mum, I'm Kongsuni. You called me that because I loved kongjaban as a child.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, that's right, Kongsuni. Sorry, sorry, the news lately has made me jumpy. So are you badly hurt? The hospital?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: No, I'm not hurt, it's just a scratch on the bumper. I bumped the other car but the insurance is handling it.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: That's a genuine relief, nobody being hurt is the main thing. So what did you need?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: If I claim on my own cover there's an excess, and this month's pay is a bit tight... I wondered whether you could lend me 300,000 won.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: That much is nothing. When do you need it by?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Sometime this week is fine. Sorry, Mum, for worrying you.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What are you on about, don't be sorry about that. I'll send it this evening to the account I used before.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Thanks, Mum. I'll buy you something nice next time I'm down in Cheongju.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, yes, drive carefully and eat properly. Go in and rest.

victim_persona.occupation: Care worker for older adults and people with disabilities

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello! It's me, have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. I've just finished work and got in. Isn't the school kitchen busy for you?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Don't ask, I'm all over the place planning the children's meals. Anyway, doing care work you handle a lot of machines, don't you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Machines? What machines? Has something gone wrong?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: No, my mother's carer says there are AI speakers now that check on older people's health. I'd like to get one for my mother but I've no feel for how to use it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that, I've seen a few of the residents at our centre using them. It tells you when to take your medication, that sort of thing?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: That's right, that's it! But setting it up looks a bit complicated. Could you show me when you've got time?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course. Though I've got some night shifts so this week is awkward, I should have some room around next week.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, it's not urgent, take your time. I haven't even bought the device yet, I'm still looking into it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, look into it without pressure. And I'll ask in more detail at the centre how they use them.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Thank you! You really are the best. Let's find a time next week and be in touch.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, see you then. Take care!

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, love, I've just come down from the site and I was about to eat. How about you?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I'm about to have dinner too. Isn't work hard these days? The weather's warming up too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's fine, manageable. Is the studying going well?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Just getting by. It's nothing urgent, listen whenever suits, Dad.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, what is it, go on.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: You know Valorant, Dad? Apparently there's a new support programme for esports teams.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: What does that do? I don't know about games but I'm curious.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: The annual support per team is quite large, apparently. They pick several teams by open application and support them.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? So companies back that sort of thing now. It's remarkable, given it's a field you like.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, apparently the players get stable operations and their performance improves. The ecosystem grows.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's good news. If you're interested you could do work related to it later, that'd be fun.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Haha, I don't know about that yet, I just mentioned it because it's interesting.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, telling me about this is fun for me too. Eat and get some proper rest.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, and don't overdo it at work, Dad. I'll call again.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, it's me. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's been a while. How's the weather there these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It's got a bit chilly here. How about Seoul?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Much the same here. How's work these days, busy?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just getting by. Let's take our time, it's been a while.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, it's nice talking at leisure. Oh, that's right, are you watching that drama?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Which one? I've been watching a thriller on Netflix.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Me too! It's genuinely gripping. How far have you got?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Up to about episode five. I got goosebumps at the scene where the culprit appears.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, my heart nearly stopped there. And the acting is genuinely good.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right, completely absorbing. I wish the next episode would come out sooner.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'm waiting too. Let's talk about the ending when we've finished it.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Good, I'll be in touch once I've seen it all. It's been good hearing your voice today.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Same here. Take care and let's talk again!

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Dad, it's me, have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I've just had dinner. Was the counselling hard today?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Don't ask, there were genuinely difficult customers today. But it's always like that

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's hard work. Eat something substantial

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, understood. Anyway, Dad, I was thinking of going somewhere on the holiday if you're free — are you up for it?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, lovely. But it's not urgent, we can think it over at our own pace, can't we?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: True, there's no rush. My schedule isn't confirmed yet either

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I should have some room after this month's closing too

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Then we can talk again then. Anyway, is there anywhere you want to go?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hmm, I'd like to eat raw fish looking at the sea. How about Gangneung or Sokcho

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, lovely! I love raw fish. Then I'll look into things and we'll talk again

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, think it over at your own pace and let's talk again

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, understood. Well done today, Dad, get some rest

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, and you shower and rest. Let's talk again next week

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: It's me. It's been a while, hasn't it?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Huh? Your voice sounds a bit different, is that really you?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: I've got a cold so I sound bunged up. Do you remember me borrowing your bike and falling and cutting my knee? You bought me a plaster.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's right, you were in a right state. Hearing your voice I thought it really was you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: So, have you been well? Is work all right these days?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, just getting by. How are the shop preparations going?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Still preparing. Anyway, what did you call about?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Well, I've enrolled on a barista certification course and my card payment keeps failing. I wondered whether you could pay it for me.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Shall we talk face to face for a moment? Shall we switch to video?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, lovely, one moment, I'll switch.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, it really is you, that's a relief. So how much is it?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: About 300,000 won. It's not urgent so you can do it at your own pace when you're free.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, understood. Then I send it to the account I used to send your allowance to, don't I?

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, that's right, that same account. Thank you, I'll buy you a meal sometime.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't be silly, meal nothing, get the certification and make me a coffee sometime.

turns.speaker: Junior
turns.text: Yes, understood, I'll be in touch soon. Take care.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, oh, it's been a while, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while, I'm just getting by. How are you these days?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Nothing special for me either, the weather's nice lately so I walk a lot

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's nice, I live for listening to LPs at home these days

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: You're still in that Bundang flat, aren't you? You said it was genuinely good

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, that's right, I looked at a lot of places before choosing it so I'm attached to it

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I'm genuinely envious, I'm still renting in Buk-gu

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: What's the rent like there these days? Better than Seoul or the capital area, isn't it?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It's gone up a lot here too. Still, there's nothing to rush and I'm content where I am

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, that's what matters, being content with where you are is the best thing

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: What are you doing about the urban regeneration thing? You said you were interested

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I just go round old neighbourhoods taking photos and gathering material when I've got a moment, I haven't started anything in a hurry

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: It's good seeing you do it at leisure, I'd like to live with that attitude

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You seem to be living well as you are. Come and visit when you're free

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Good, I'll pick a day and come. Let's talk again

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, take care and let's be in touch

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me. Have you had dinner?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just now. Have you fed the children?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, they've all eaten and I'm resting. Isn't work hard, Mum?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's fine, I finished early today so I'm lying on the sofa. Is something urgent?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: No, nothing like that, I just wanted to hear your voice. Nothing urgent at all, let's take our time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, lovely. What have you been up to, not bored?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I've got surprisingly hooked on some escape room game on my phone. Do you do anything on your phone, Mum?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I just read webtoons, I don't really play games. I only know old things like Minesweeper.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Minesweeper, it's been ages since I heard that. That takes some thinking, you'd be good at it.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I use concentration when I weld so I'm decent at that sort of thing, haha. What's your escape game called?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I've forgotten the name, I'll text you the link later. It's not urgent, install it when you're bored sometime.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, send it at your own pace. I'll try it when I've got time.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, eat properly and don't overdo it, Mum. I'll call again.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, and enjoy the children. Take care.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, it's me. Have you been well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, it's been a while. Nothing much going on?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Same as ever for me, security duty and so on. The driving must be hard on you?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It is hard, but my body's got used to it lately. And the children are growing well.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: That's good. It's not urgent, I called to ask you something, so we can take our time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, what is it?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: We've had new CCTV installed in our building and the picture quality is superb. You can see everything even at night.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? Camera technology really has got good lately. I saw on the news that Korean company cameras are used a lot in Europe too.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: True, Hanwha Techwin or whatever it's called is famous in Europe apparently. They installed dozens at some science museum.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Goodness, that's something. I put a new dashcam in the truck and the picture quality is beyond comparison with the old one.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Right, technology develops fast so it's made things a bit easier for security staff like us.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, that's a good thing. Anyway, take care and let's get a meal when you're free.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, I'll be in touch. Keep well.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hello, it's me. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while. Just getting by, there's nothing much on lately.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Are you keeping well? It's turned cold all of a sudden.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: My health is getting by. I walk in the morning and so on. Is the kimchi factory still busy for you?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Busy, but there's some room lately. So I was watching YouTube in the evening and saw something interesting.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: What is it? Tell me, I've nothing particular to do.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Nothing much, but apparently there've been huge protests in France, it was on the news.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that? Over the pension reform, apparently. I caught a bit of it, an enormous number of people were out.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, central Paris was complete chaos. It made me wonder whether that could happen here.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Who knows, it comes out differently here, doesn't it. Though Europeans really do have a strong protest culture.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly. Anyway, there was interesting stuff about the British royal family too, I'll tell you about that next time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, tell me properly next time we meet. It'd be a waste to cover it all on the phone.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, yes. I'll hang up for today, let's get a meal sometime.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Let's do that. Take care and be in touch.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, it's me. This number's unfamiliar, isn't it, I'm calling from a friend's phone.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Huh? What's this number, it's not saved. Is that really you?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, it's me, do you remember what nickname Dad called me? I can tell you if you like.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Ah, that's right, your father called you 'Slowcoach'. Hearing your voice it really is you.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, it's me. Have you been well? How's work these days, busy?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Same as ever for me. Anyway, your voice sounds a bit odd, is something the matter?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Er... actually I came off my motorbike today. I'm not badly hurt.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What? You fell? Are you hurt? Have you been to the hospital?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I went and had an X-ray and thankfully the bones are fine. But my arm and leg are grazed so there was a treatment cost, and my phone screen went so I need to get it repaired.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh dear, still, I'm glad you're not badly hurt. It's not urgent so take your time, how much do you need?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: The hospital and phone repair together would be about 200,000 won. Sorry to spring this on you.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Sorry, nothing, you being hurt worries me more. I'll send it this evening to the account I always use, check for it.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Thanks, Mum. I'll call from my own number again once the phone's fixed this evening.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, take care. And don't put up with it if it hurts, say so straight away.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Dad, it's me, have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, just now. Are you eating properly, living on your own.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Of course, I've got hooked on salt bread lately and I buy it almost every day.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, the bread costs must add up. Are you keeping well? You've not caught a cold?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: No, I'm fine. Anyway, Dad, there's something I wanted to tell you.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, what is it, take your time. I've plenty of it.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I've started seeing someone. I just wanted you to know.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, really? What are they like, what do they do?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: The same age as me and living in the same neighbourhood. Fairly quiet, but we suit each other.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's good. There's nothing to decide in a hurry, so take your time, no need to rush.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I think so too. I just wanted to tell you first.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Thank you. Tell your mother whenever suits too. I'm rooting for you.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Understood. What have you been doing at weekends, Dad?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I'm going to a match with a friend this weekend. And let's go round some good restaurants next time you're in Daegu.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Lovely, I'll call again. Look after your health, Dad!

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, and you keep well. Bye now.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Hello, it's me, are you keeping well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's been a while, I'm well. How's work these days?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Same as every day. The weather round Seongseo here has been even hotter and it's killing me.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It's genuinely hot here too. Anyway, if it's not urgent let's take our time, I'm fairly free today.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Oh, really? Then let's have a chat. Are the children well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, they're fine. Though my son seems to be seeing someone and won't say.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Haha, at that age they never tell their parents. My daughter was the same, she only brought up marriage recently and it took me by surprise.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh my, really? Is your daughter getting married?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Yes, around next spring, apparently. Raising the children on my own I couldn't give her much attention, so seeing how well she's turned out is bittersweet.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: You've had a hard time, so how proud you must be that she's grown up so well. Have you started the wedding preparations?

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Not much yet. The money worries me a bit, but I want to do it for her somehow. Don't you worry about your son marrying?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, I've been worrying about it already. The jeonse deposit is tight enough, I wonder whether I'll have anything to give.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: Still, everyone finds their own way. We just watch from the side.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, seeing the children do well is the pleasure. Do tell me when your daughter's wedding date is set.

turns.speaker: Coworker
turns.text: All right, understood, and tell me if there's good news about your son. Thank you for the time today.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, yes, it's been good for me too, take care in the heat and let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, hello, it's me, it's been a while

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, yes, what's the occasion, calling and all, how've you been?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just getting by, the shifts have been heavy lately and I'm aching all over

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: The rescue service must be genuinely hard. Are you eating properly?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I eat, but the timing's awkward so I often grab something. How about you? Is work manageable?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I just sit writing code all day, and that's hard in its own way, my shoulder aches

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, that's right, it's not urgent, it just came to mind so I called, but are you watching anything? Anything good

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, I've been watching an audition programme and it's completely gripping, the contestants can genuinely sing

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, I've heard of that, apparently the judges' reactions are fun too

turns.speaker: Self

turns.text: The print shop work has piled up so I've been all over the place. Anyway, are you keeping well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: My shoulder's a bit stiff but I'm getting by. Anyway, nothing much going on?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Nothing much, I just saw something remarkable on the news. Apparently the yen has completely bottomed out?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that, I saw it too. Under 900 won to 100 yen, apparently?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Exactly, so the number of people going to Japan has shot up. The lads at our company are all going to Osaka in the summer.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: My sister-in-law's family went last month and said prices were genuinely cheap. Meals cheaper than here, apparently.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: But why does the yen keep falling like that? There's a reason, apparently.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: The news said it's because the Bank of Japan keeps interest rates low. The rate gap with us is big so the yen can't hold up.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, that'd be it. But if it goes on like that isn't it hard for the Japanese?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: It would be, import prices would rise. But it's good for travel for us so I just enjoy it, haha.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: True, haha. Maybe I should take the children while this lasts.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Lovely, I'd like to go but summer's busy at work. Let's talk about it around autumn.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: All right, let's talk again, look after yourself.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Yes, and you look after your health. See you next time.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, what's the occasion at this hour. I picked up while tidying the shop, what's up.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I just wanted to hear your voice. How's the shop these days, plenty of customers?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just getting by. I've been all over the place with a new bread. Is the sales work going well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just getting by. Anyway, do you remember? My nickname in our university club.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Wasn't that the Romantic? You always carried a book of poems around, I still remember that.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: That's right, the Romantic, exactly. Haha, hearing that takes me back.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: So what did you call about, this doesn't sound like just a how-are-you call.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Actually I wondered whether you could introduce me to someone decent if you know anyone. I've started wanting to settle down.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Oh, finally. What's got into you, talking about marriage. Anyway, it's not urgent, is it?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: No, no, just tell me if there's someone good, at your own pace. I've no intention of rushing.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: All right, then I'll ask around at my own pace. I'll see whether any of our regulars would suit.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Thank you, don't feel pressured, think about it whenever.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Understood, I'll be in touch soon. Anyway, you should start preparing to be a good father too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, thinking about it does excite me. I hope the shop does well too. I'll be in touch again.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: All right, take care and let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, it's me. It's been a while, hasn't it?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, it really has been a while. How've you been?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Just getting by. I've been all over the place studying for a certification. Is work going well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Busy, but bearable. It's hot lately and I'd like to rest somewhere.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Hey, perfect timing. It's nothing urgent, but I've been thinking about where to go for the summer holiday.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, lovely. Take your time, I've got a bit of time now.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I read somewhere recently that the Mediterranean side of Türkiye is popular now. There's a port city called Bodrum.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Bodrum? First I've heard of it. What's it like there?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: A port city on the Aegean, apparently, and the water colour in the photos was genuinely beautiful. Though the flights are a bit steep.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: True, Europe is like that. Is there nothing domestic? I've wanted a short trip in the country lately.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Ah, that's right, apparently Bunker de Lumières in Jeju has a discount. It's cool indoors anyway so it's perfect in summer, and tickets are 15% off at the moment.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, that's decent. Until when is it running?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I don't know exactly either, it's not urgent so look it up sometime. Apparently students get up to 40% off, though that doesn't apply to us.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Haha, true, nothing like that at our age. Still, being indoors it'd be good in the heat and humidity.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Right. Anyway, I want to go somewhere this summer. Come with me if you're free.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, I'll check my schedule and get in touch. Let's talk again.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me, have you been keeping well?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, son, what's the occasion, calling and all. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, I have. Is the hospital very busy these days, Mum?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Just getting by. The weather's nice lately so the patients are down a bit. Is work all right for you?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Just getting by. Anyway, Mum, I'm thinking of going to Gangwon on my next holiday, where's good?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh, good question. Living here on the East Sea I've plenty to recommend. First, go to Nongoldam-gil at Mukho Port, the murals are pretty and you can see the sea.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Oh, that sounds good! Anywhere else?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: The sunrise at Chotdaebawi is famous, and a bit further there's Chuam Beach. It's genuinely beautiful early in the morning.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: I'd have to become a morning person. Are there good places to eat?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course, there's a place that does gomchi-guk and I'll take you. It's good for you too.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Lovely, it'd be even better going with you. Shall we match up dates?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Let's do that, there's no rush, we'll match schedules and fix it at our own pace.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, lovely. I'll be in touch again next week, look after your health, Mum.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: All right, and you eat properly. Take care.

victim_persona.occupation: Former food service worker, currently job-seeking

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Hello, is that you, love?

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Mum, it's me. Have you eaten?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: I have. I took it easy today, cleaned the yard and walked the dog.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Good. I'm a bit worn out, there was a lot on at work, I just called wanting to hear your voice.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Oh dear, that's hard work. If there's nothing urgent let's take our time.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, nothing urgent. I've just been thinking about travelling. Do you remember when we went to Gyeongju?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Of course, we went to Bulguksa and took loads of photos. It was lovely.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: True. I've been thinking of trying Tongyeong this time. Apparently you can take a cable car too.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Tongyeong is lovely. The sea there is pretty and the raw fish is fresh. I'd like to go.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Then let's pick a weekend next month and go together. We can leave your dog with my aunt for a bit.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Lovely. Apparently from the cable car you can see the Mireuksan observatory too. I'm looking forward to it.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Then I'll look into accommodation and the cable car tickets. You just have to turn up.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Thank you, love. I'm looking forward to that day. Let's hang up now, it's late.

turns.speaker: Family Member
turns.text: Yes, get to bed, Mum. I'll call again next week.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. I'm calling from a colleague's phone so the number's different.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, yes, I can tell from your voice. Anyway, what's wrong with your phone?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, something happened today. Have you eaten, Dad?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: I have. Anyway, what's happened, why does your voice sound like that?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I had a minor collision on the way home from work. I'm not hurt but the front of the car is dented.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Are you all right? You're not hurt? Anyway, where did you hurt yourself when you fell off your bike as a child, do you remember?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: That was my knee, in year four of primary school. Nothing like that now, I'm genuinely fine.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, I can tell from your voice. Still, let me see your face, switch to video and call.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Should I? Hold on, I'll switch to video.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, I can see you now, you look all right. So how much will the repair be?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I'd need a quote, but roughly 500,000 won, I think. It's not urgent so you can send it at your own pace.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Understood, I'll go to the bank tomorrow and put it in. It's the same account as before, isn't it?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, put it into that account. Thanks, Dad.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Don't be silly, more to the point, drive carefully. And eat properly.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, understood, and look after your health, Dad. Bye now.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Dad, it's me. Have you been keeping well?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh, it's my son, it's been a while. It's good to hear your voice.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Anyway, are you still boiling ramyeon every evening? You used to.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Haha, how did you know, I still do sometimes. I'm busy so I end up grabbing something.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Still, you've got to look after yourself, at your age.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: You're right... actually that's why I called.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: I had a health check recently and the results weren't great, so I think I need treatment.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: What, what's wrong? You must have had a fright.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's nothing serious, they just said to manage it properly, but the treatment costs a bit.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh dear, still, that's a relief. How much do you need? Don't worry, just say.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: About a million won should do.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Understood, I'll send it to your account. Your health comes first, don't put it off.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Thank you, Dad, that's put my mind at ease.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, and you eat properly. Call again.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Hello, is that Lee Gwanghyeon in Daegu? I did the safety management training with you in Hwaseong.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, yes, that's right. Er... who is this?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: We all went for gukbap on the last day of the training. Do you remember sitting next to me talking about badminton?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that's right! You said you liked badminton and worked on facilities at a training centre in Hwaseong. Now I remember.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, that's right, good to speak to you. It's been a while. How have you been? It must be very hot in Daegu?

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Don't ask, Daegu has been genuinely sweltering lately. Hwaseong must be no joke either?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: True, I'm drenched every day. Anyway, the thing is, a lot of people on our side are preparing for the safety management certification. I called to ask whether I could borrow the site inspection checklist you used to use, for reference.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Ah, that? Yes, I've got it. It's not urgent, is it?

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: No, just email it whenever you've sorted it out.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Understood, I'll put it together and send it within the week.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Thank you, I think it'll help a lot.

turns.speaker: Self
turns.text: Not at all. I'll be in touch next time I've reason to be in Hwaseong.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Yes, lovely, let's have a meal then.

victim_persona.occupation: Other precious metal and jewellery craftworkers

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mum, it's me. Have you got a minute?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Huh? But what's this number, it's unfamiliar. Have you changed your phone?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Ah, this is a friend's phone. My screen went so I've been without it for days.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Really? Is that really you... tell me what our dog was called.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Mungchi. Honestly, Mum, why ask that?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Haha, that's right, Mungchi. Now I can tell from your voice.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: How are you these days, Mum? Is your wrist better?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, much better. Are you eating properly?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, I eat well, and don't you skip meals.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Yes, yes. Anyway, what's the occasion, calling? Is something the matter?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Nothing much, I'm a bit short for this month's savings payment. Could you lend me 100,000 won for a few days?

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Oh dear, really? I'll send you whatever you need, when do you need it by?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's not urgent, as long as it's within the week.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Understood, I'll go to the bank later and send it. The account's the same one as before?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, send it to that account.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: All right, eat properly. Call again.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, and mind your wrist, Mum, bye now.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's me. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Yes, it's fine. But your voice sounds a bit hoarse, is that the cold you said you had?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, it still hasn't cleared. I've been taking the cold medicine you bought me the other day.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Ah, really? That's good. How's work these days, isn't the secretarial work hard?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Just getting by. I've built a system for organising the schedules lately so it's easier. How are you? Have you got any time?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: I've got some room these days. Drawing and playing with the children. Anyway, is something up, is that why you called?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Nothing much, sorting out that system I need a programme licence. Could you lend me about 50,000 won?

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Ah, that much is fine, shall I send it right now?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: It's not urgent, as long as it's within the week.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Understood, the account's the same one as before, isn't it?

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, that's right, send it there. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Older Sibling
turns.text: Don't be silly, look after yourself and get well soon.

turns.speaker: Family
turns.text: Yes, and enjoy the children. I'll call again.
